import { once } from 'node:events'
import type { AddressInfo } from 'node:net'
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client'
import express from 'express'
import { pinoHttp } from 'pino-http'
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { errorHandler } from './app.js'

describe('API error handling', () => {
  const app = express()
  let server: ReturnType<typeof app.listen>
  let baseUrl: string

  beforeAll(async () => {
    app.use(pinoHttp({ level: 'silent', autoLogging: false }))
    app.use(express.json({ limit: '1kb' }))
    app.get('/schema-mismatch', (_request, _response, next) => {
      next(new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Column missing', {
        code: 'P2022',
        clientVersion: '7.10.1',
      }))
    })
    app.get('/database-unavailable', (_request, _response, next) => {
      next(new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Connection failed', {
        code: 'P1001',
        clientVersion: '7.10.1',
      }))
    })
    app.get('/unexpected', (_request, _response, next) => {
      next(new Error('Sensitive database detail'))
    })
    app.post('/json', (_request, response) => response.json({ ok: true }))
    app.use(errorHandler)
    server = app.listen(0)
    await once(server, 'listening')
    baseUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${(server.address() as AddressInfo).port}`
  })

  afterAll(async () => {
    server.close()
    await once(server, 'close')
  })

  it('returns an actionable 503 for a missing database field without exposing internals', async () => {
    const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/schema-mismatch`)
    const body = await response.json() as { error: { code: string; message: string } }

    expect(response.status).toBe(503)
    expect(body.error.code).toBe('DATABASE_SCHEMA_OUTDATED')
    expect(body.error.message).toContain('database schema needs an update')
    expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.toContain('P2022')
    expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.toContain('Column missing')
  })

  it('returns a safe 503 when PostgreSQL is unreachable', async () => {
    const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/database-unavailable`)
    const body = await response.json() as { error: { code: string; message: string } }

    expect(response.status).toBe(503)
    expect(body.error.code).toBe('DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE')
    expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.toContain('Connection failed')
  })

  it('returns a safe 400 for malformed JSON instead of an internal error', async () => {
    const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/json`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: '{',
    })
    const body = await response.json() as { error: { code: string; message: string } }

    expect(response.status).toBe(400)
    expect(body.error.code).toBe('INVALID_JSON')
    expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.toContain('SyntaxError')
  })

  it('returns 413 when a request body exceeds the parser limit', async () => {
    const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/json`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ value: 'x'.repeat(2048) }),
    })
    const body = await response.json() as { error: { code: string } }

    expect(response.status).toBe(413)
    expect(body.error.code).toBe('PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE')
  })

  it('does not expose internal exception messages in generic errors', async () => {
    const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/unexpected`)
    const body = await response.text()

    expect(response.status).toBe(500)
    expect(body).toContain('unexpected server error')
    expect(body).not.toContain('Sensitive database detail')
  })
})

import cors from 'cors'
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client'
import express, { type ErrorRequestHandler } from 'express'
import { pinoHttp } from 'pino-http'
import { config } from './config.js'
import { getDatabaseStatus } from './db/status.js'
import { authRouter } from './auth/provisionRoute.js'
import { dataRouter } from './data/routes.js'
import { profileRouter } from './profile/routes.js'
import { vaultRouter } from './vault/routes.js'
import { intelligenceRouter } from './intelligence/routes.js'
import { StorageProviderError } from './vault/storage.js'

export const app = express()

app.disable('x-powered-by')
app.use(cors({ origin: config.WEB_ORIGIN, methods: ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'], credentials: false }))
app.use(pinoHttp({
  level: config.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'info' : 'debug',
  redact: ['req.headers.authorization', 'req.headers.cookie'],
}))
app.use(express.json({ limit: '1mb' }))
app.use('/api/auth', authRouter)
app.use('/api/data', dataRouter)
app.use('/api/profile', profileRouter)
app.use('/api/vault', vaultRouter)
app.use('/api/intelligence', intelligenceRouter)

app.get('/api/health', (_request, response) => {
  response.json({
    status: 'ok',
    service: 'careeros-api',
    mode: 'authenticated-api',
    database: getDatabaseStatus(),
  })
})

app.use((_request, response) => {
  response.status(404).json({ error: 'Not found' })
})

export const errorHandler: ErrorRequestHandler = (error: unknown, _request, response, _next) => {
  if (error instanceof StorageProviderError) {
    response.req.log.error({ requestId: response.req.id, code: error.code, err: error.cause }, 'Vault storage operation failed')
    response.status(503).json({ error: { code: error.code, message: error.safeMessage, requestId: response.req.id } })
    return
  }
  if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === 'P2022') {
    response.req.log.error({ prismaCode: error.code }, 'Database schema is missing a field required by this API version')
    response.status(503).json({
      error: {
        code: 'DATABASE_SCHEMA_OUTDATED',
        message: 'Workspace data is temporarily unavailable because the database schema needs an update. Review the pending migrations before trying again.',
      },
    })
    return
  }
  if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError
    && ['P1001', 'P1002', 'P1008', 'P1017', 'P2024'].includes(error.code)) {
    response.req.log.error({ prismaCode: error.code }, 'Database is temporarily unavailable')
    response.status(503).json({
      error: {
        code: 'DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE',
        message: 'Workspace data is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.',
      },
    })
    return
  }
  const parserErrorType = typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'type' in error
    && typeof error.type === 'string' ? error.type : ''
  if (parserErrorType === 'entity.parse.failed') {
    response.req.log.warn({ parserErrorType }, 'Request body contains invalid JSON')
    response.status(400).json({
      error: { code: 'INVALID_JSON', message: 'Request body must be valid JSON.' },
    })
    return
  }
  if (parserErrorType === 'entity.too.large') {
    response.req.log.warn({ parserErrorType }, 'Request body exceeds the allowed size')
    response.status(413).json({
      error: { code: 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE', message: 'Request body exceeds the allowed size.' },
    })
    return
  }
  const errorType = error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'UnknownError'
  const errorCode = typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'code' in error
    && typeof error.code === 'string' ? error.code : undefined
  response.req.log.error({ errorType, ...(errorCode ? { errorCode } : {}) }, 'Unhandled API request error')
  response.status(500).json({ error: 'An unexpected server error occurred.' })
}

app.use(errorHandler)

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { resolveInternalUser, verifySupabaseBearer } from './identity.js'

const confirmedIdentity = {
  id: 'auth-user-1',
  email: 'alex@example.test',
  email_confirmed_at: '2026-10-28T10:00:00.000Z',
}

describe('Supabase bearer verification', () => {
  it('rejects missing and malformed authorization headers without contacting Supabase', async () => {
    const getUser = vi.fn()
    expect(await verifySupabaseBearer(undefined, { getUser })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, status: 401 })
    expect(await verifySupabaseBearer('Basic token', { getUser })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, status: 401 })
    expect(getUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('rejects invalid and expired bearer tokens', async () => {
    const verifier = { getUser: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: { user: null }, error: { status: 401 } }) }
    const result = await verifySupabaseBearer('Bearer expired-token', verifier)
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ ok: false, status: 401, code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' })
    expect(verifier.getUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith('expired-token')
  })

  it('requires confirmed email before accepting identity', async () => {
    const verifier = { getUser: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: { user: { ...confirmedIdentity, email_confirmed_at: null, confirmed_at: null } }, error: null }) }
    expect(await verifySupabaseBearer('Bearer valid-token', verifier)).toMatchObject({
      ok: false,
      status: 403,
      code: 'EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED',
    })
  })

  it('distinguishes upstream rate limiting and outage from rejected credentials', async () => {
    const limited = { getUser: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: { user: null }, error: { status: 429 } }) }
    const outage = { getUser: vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('network unavailable')) }
    expect(await verifySupabaseBearer('Bearer token', limited)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, status: 429 })
    expect(await verifySupabaseBearer('Bearer token', outage)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, status: 503 })
  })

  it('resolves only the internal mapping for the verified Supabase UUID', async () => {
    const user = { id: 'cuid-user-1', email: 'alex@example.test', name: 'Alex' }
    const lookup = { findBySupabaseAuthId: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(user), updateVerifiedEmail: vi.fn() }
    expect(await resolveInternalUser(confirmedIdentity, lookup)).toEqual({ ok: true, user })
    expect(lookup.findBySupabaseAuthId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('auth-user-1')
  })

  it('rejects a valid identity without a provisioned internal mapping', async () => {
    const lookup = { findBySupabaseAuthId: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null), updateVerifiedEmail: vi.fn() }
    expect(await resolveInternalUser(confirmedIdentity, lookup)).toMatchObject({
      ok: false,
      status: 403,
      code: 'ACCOUNT_NOT_PROVISIONED',
    })
  })

  it('updates a mapped email only from the verified identity and reports uniqueness conflicts', async () => {
    const user = { id: 'cuid-user-1', email: 'old@example.test', name: 'Alex' }
    const lookup = {
      findBySupabaseAuthId: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(user),
      updateVerifiedEmail: vi.fn().mockRejectedValue({ code: 'P2002' }),
    }
    const result = await resolveInternalUser({ ...confirmedIdentity, email: 'new@example.test' }, lookup)
    expect(lookup.updateVerifiedEmail).toHaveBeenCalledWith(user.id, 'new@example.test')
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ ok: false, status: 409, code: 'ACCOUNT_MAPPING_CONFLICT' })
  })
})

FILE: backend/src/auth/identity.ts

export interface VerifiedSupabaseIdentity {
  id: string
  email?: string | null
  email_confirmed_at?: string | null
  confirmed_at?: string | null
  user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
}

export interface InternalUserMapping {
  id: string
  email: string
  name: string
}

export interface IdentityVerifier {
  getUser(token: string): Promise<{
    data: { user: VerifiedSupabaseIdentity | null }
    error: { status?: number } | null
  }>
}

export interface IdentityLookup {
  findBySupabaseAuthId(id: string): Promise<InternalUserMapping | null>
  updateVerifiedEmail(userId: string, email: string): Promise<InternalUserMapping>
}

export type IdentityResult =
  | { ok: true; token: string; identity: VerifiedSupabaseIdentity }
  | { ok: false; status: 401 | 403 | 429 | 503; code: string; message: string }

function failure(status: 401 | 403 | 429 | 503, code: string, message: string): IdentityResult {
  return { ok: false, status, code, message }
}

export async function verifySupabaseBearer(authorization: string | undefined, verifier: IdentityVerifier): Promise<IdentityResult> {
  const match = authorization?.match(/^Bearer\s+(\S+)$/i)
  if (!match) return failure(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'A valid bearer token is required.')

  try {
    const result = await verifier.getUser(match[1]!)
    if (result.error) {
      if (result.error.status === 429) return failure(429, 'AUTH_RATE_LIMITED', 'Authentication verification is temporarily rate limited.')
      if (result.error.status === 400 || result.error.status === 401 || result.error.status === 403) {
        return failure(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'The bearer token is invalid or expired.')
      }
      return failure(503, 'AUTH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE', 'Authentication verification is temporarily unavailable.')
    }

    const identity = result.data.user
    if (!identity) return failure(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'The bearer token is invalid or expired.')
    if (!identity.email?.trim()) return failure(403, 'EMAIL_REQUIRED', 'A confirmed email address is required for CareerOS.')
    if (!identity.email_confirmed_at && !identity.confirmed_at) {
      return failure(403, 'EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED', 'Confirm your email before accessing CareerOS.')
    }
    return { ok: true, token: match[1]!, identity }
  } catch {
    return failure(503, 'AUTH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE', 'Authentication verification is temporarily unavailable.')
  }
}

export async function resolveInternalUser(
  identity: VerifiedSupabaseIdentity,
  lookup: IdentityLookup,
): Promise<{ ok: true; user: InternalUserMapping } | { ok: false; status: 403 | 409 | 503; code: string; message: string }> {
  try {
    let user = await lookup.findBySupabaseAuthId(identity.id)
    if (!user) return { ok: false, status: 403, code: 'ACCOUNT_NOT_PROVISIONED', message: 'This account is not provisioned for CareerOS.' }
    if (identity.email && identity.email !== user.email) {
      try {
        user = await lookup.updateVerifiedEmail(user.id, identity.email)
      } catch (error) {
        if (typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'code' in error && error.code === 'P2002') {
          return { ok: false, status: 409, code: 'ACCOUNT_MAPPING_CONFLICT', message: 'This account cannot be linked automatically. Contact support to resolve the account conflict.' }
        }
        throw error
      }
    }
    return { ok: true, user }
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, status: 503, code: 'DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'The application account could not be verified right now.' }
  }
}

import type { AddressInfo } from 'node:net'

    }))

    mocks.supabase.auth.getUser.mockResolvedValueOnce({

  })

  it('rejects unauthenticated API requests before database access', async () => {
    const response = await fetch(protectedUrl)
    expect(response.status).toBe(401)
    expect(mocks.supabase.auth.getUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mocks.prisma.user.findUnique).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('maps two verified Supabase identities to separate internal users', async () => {

    const userB = await fetch(protectedUrl, { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer user-b' } })

    expect(mocks.prisma.user.findUnique).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, expect.objectContaining({
      where: { supabaseAuthId: 'auth-user-a' },
    }))
    expect(mocks.prisma.user.findUnique).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, expect.objectContaining({
      where: { supabaseAuthId: 'auth-user-b' },
    }))
  })
})

import type { RequestHandler } from 'express'
import { getPrismaClient } from '../db/client.js'
import { resolveInternalUser, verifySupabaseBearer } from './identity.js'
import { getSupabaseAuthClient } from './supabaseClient.js'

export const requireAuth: RequestHandler = async (request, response, next) => {
  let supabase
  try {
    supabase = getSupabaseAuthClient()
  } catch {
    response.status(503).json({ error: { code: 'AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED', message: 'Authentication is not configured on this server.' } })
    return
  }

  const verified = await verifySupabaseBearer(request.get('authorization'), {
    getUser: (token) => supabase.auth.getUser(token),
  })
  if (!verified.ok) {
    if (verified.status === 503) request.log.error({ code: verified.code }, 'Supabase identity verification unavailable')
    response.status(verified.status).json({ error: { code: verified.code, message: verified.message } })
    return
  }

  let prisma
  try {
    prisma = getPrismaClient()
  } catch {
    response.status(503).json({ error: { code: 'DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'The application account could not be verified right now.' } })
    return
  }

  const result = await resolveInternalUser(verified.identity, {
    findBySupabaseAuthId: (id) => prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { supabaseAuthId: id },
      select: { id: true, email: true, name: true },
    }),
    updateVerifiedEmail: (userId, email) => prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { email },
      select: { id: true, email: true, name: true },
    }),
  })
  if (!result.ok) {
    response.status(result.status).json({ error: { code: result.code, message: result.message } })
    return
  }
  request.auth = { userId: result.user.id, email: result.user.email, name: result.user.name }
  next()
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { ProvisioningConflictError, provisionInternalUser } from './provisioning.js'

}

describe('internal user provisioning', () => {
  it('is idempotent for an existing Supabase identity mapping', async () => {
    const user = { id: 'cuid-existing', email: identity.email, name: 'Alex', supabaseAuthId: identity.id }
    let creates = 0
    const repository = {
      findBySupabaseAuthId: async () => user,
      create: async () => { creates += 1; return user },
      updateVerifiedEmail: async (_id: string, email: string) => ({ ...user, email }),
    }

    await expect(provisionInternalUser(identity, repository)).resolves.toEqual(user)
    expect(creates).toBe(0)
  })

  it('safely resolves concurrent duplicate provisioning to one internal user', async () => {
    const users = new Map<string, { id: string; email: string; name: string; supabaseAuthId: string }>()
    const repository = {
      findBySupabaseAuthId: async (id: string) => users.get(id) ?? null,
      create: async (input: { supabaseAuthId: string; email: string; name: string }) => {
        if ([...users.values()].some((user) => user.email === input.email)) throw { code: 'P2002' }
        const user = { ...input, id: 'cuid-created' }
        users.set(input.supabaseAuthId, user)
        return user
      },
      updateVerifiedEmail: async (id: string, email: string) => {
        const user = users.get(id)
        if (!user) throw new Error('missing test mapping')
        user.email = email
        return user
      },
    }

    const results = await Promise.all([
      provisionInternalUser(identity, repository),
      provisionInternalUser(identity, repository),
    ])
    expect(results[0]?.id).toBe('cuid-created')
    expect(results[1]?.id).toBe('cuid-created')
    expect(users.size).toBe(1)
  })

  it('does not link a verified identity to an existing account by matching email', async () => {
    const repository = {
      findBySupabaseAuthId: async () => null,
      create: async () => { throw { code: 'P2002' } },
      updateVerifiedEmail: async (_id: string, email: string) => ({ id: 'cuid-existing', email, name: 'Alex' }),
    }
    await expect(provisionInternalUser(identity, repository)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ProvisioningConflictError)
  })

  it('refuses to provision an unconfirmed or email-less identity', async () => {
    const repository = {
      findBySupabaseAuthId: async () => null,
      create: async () => { throw new Error('must not create') },
      updateVerifiedEmail: async (_id: string, email: string) => ({ id: 'id', email, name: 'Test' }),
    }
    await expect(provisionInternalUser({ ...identity, email_confirmed_at: null }, repository)).rejects.toThrow()
    await expect(provisionInternalUser({ ...identity, email: null }, repository)).rejects.toThrow()
  })
})

import type { InternalUserMapping, VerifiedSupabaseIdentity } from './identity.js'

export type ProvisionedUser = InternalUserMapping

export interface ProvisioningRepository {
  findBySupabaseAuthId(id: string): Promise<ProvisionedUser | null>
  create(input: { supabaseAuthId: string; email: string; name: string }): Promise<ProvisionedUser>
  updateVerifiedEmail(userId: string, email: string): Promise<ProvisionedUser>
}

export class ProvisioningConflictError extends Error {
  readonly code = 'ACCOUNT_MAPPING_CONFLICT'

  constructor() {
    super('This identity cannot be provisioned without conflicting with an existing application account.')
    this.name = 'ProvisioningConflictError'
  }
}

function isUniqueConstraintError(error: unknown) {
  return typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'code' in error && error.code === 'P2002'
}

function displayName(identity: VerifiedSupabaseIdentity, email: string) {
  const metadataName = identity.user_metadata?.full_name
  if (typeof metadataName === 'string' && metadataName.trim()) return metadataName.trim().slice(0, 100)
  return email.split('@')[0]!.slice(0, 100)
}

export async function provisionInternalUser(
  identity: VerifiedSupabaseIdentity,
  repository: ProvisioningRepository,
): Promise<ProvisionedUser> {
  const email = identity.email?.trim()
  if (!email || (!identity.email_confirmed_at && !identity.confirmed_at)) {
    throw new Error('Only a confirmed Supabase identity with an email can be provisioned.')
  }

  const existing = await repository.findBySupabaseAuthId(identity.id)
  if (existing) return syncVerifiedEmail(existing, email, repository)

  try {
    return await repository.create({
      supabaseAuthId: identity.id,
      email,
      name: displayName(identity, email),
    })
  } catch (error) {
    if (!isUniqueConstraintError(error)) throw error
    const raced = await repository.findBySupabaseAuthId(identity.id)
    if (raced) return syncVerifiedEmail(raced, email, repository)
    throw new ProvisioningConflictError()
  }
}

async function syncVerifiedEmail(user: ProvisionedUser, email: string, repository: ProvisioningRepository) {
  if (user.email === email) return user
  try {
    return await repository.updateVerifiedEmail(user.id, email)
  } catch (error) {
    if (isUniqueConstraintError(error)) throw new ProvisioningConflictError()
    throw error
  }
}

import { Router } from 'express'
import { getPrismaClient } from '../db/client.js'
import { verifySupabaseBearer } from './identity.js'
import { getSupabaseAuthClient } from './supabaseClient.js'
import { ProvisioningConflictError, provisionInternalUser } from './provisioning.js'

export const authRouter = Router()

authRouter.post('/provision', async (request, response) => {
  let supabase
  try {
    supabase = getSupabaseAuthClient()
  } catch {
    response.status(503).json({ error: { code: 'AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED', message: 'Authentication is not configured on this server.' } })
    return
  }

  const verified = await verifySupabaseBearer(request.get('authorization'), {
    getUser: (token) => supabase.auth.getUser(token),
  })
  if (!verified.ok) {
    if (verified.status === 503) request.log.error({ code: verified.code }, 'Supabase identity verification unavailable')
    response.status(verified.status).json({ error: { code: verified.code, message: verified.message } })
    return
  }

  try {
    const prisma = getPrismaClient()
    const user = await provisionInternalUser(verified.identity, {
      findBySupabaseAuthId: (id) => prisma.user.findUnique({
        where: { supabaseAuthId: id },
        select: { id: true, email: true, name: true },
      }),
      create: (input) => prisma.user.create({ data: input, select: { id: true, email: true, name: true } }),
      updateVerifiedEmail: (userId, email) => prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: userId },
        data: { email },
        select: { id: true, email: true, name: true },
      }),
    })
    response.status(200).json({ user: { id: user.id, name: user.name, email: user.email } })
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ProvisioningConflictError) {
      response.status(409).json({ error: { code: error.code, message: 'This account cannot be linked automatically. Contact support to resolve the account conflict.' } })
      return
    }
    request.log.error({ code: typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'code' in error ? error.code : 'unknown' }, 'CareerOS internal-user provisioning failed')
    response.status(503).json({ error: { code: 'PROVISIONING_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Your application account could not be provisioned right now.' } })
  }
})

import { createClient, type SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
import { config } from '../config.js'

let client: SupabaseClient | undefined

export function getSupabaseAuthClient() {
  if (!config.SUPABASE_URL || !config.SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY) {
    throw new Error('Supabase authentication is not configured.')
  }
  if (!client) {
    client = createClient(config.SUPABASE_URL, config.SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, {
      auth: {
        autoRefreshToken: false,
        persistSession: false,
        detectSessionInUrl: false,
      },
    })
  }
  return client
}

function isPostgreSQLUrl(value: string) {
  try {
    return ['postgres:', 'postgresql:'].includes(new URL(value).protocol)
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

const environmentSchema = z.object({

  WEB_ORIGIN: z.string().url().default('http://localhost:5173'),

function nullable(value: string) {
  return value.trim() ? value.trim() : null
}

function dateOnly(value: string) {
  if (!value) return null
  const parsed = new Date(`${value}T12:00:00.000Z`)
  return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) || parsed.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== value ? null : parsed
}

function dateTime(value: string) {
  return value ? new Date(value) : null
}

function dateString(value: Date | null) {
  return value?.toISOString().slice(0, 10) ?? ''
}

function dateTimeString(value: Date | null) {
  return value?.toISOString() ?? ''
}

function toApplicationStatus(value: string) {
  return value.toUpperCase() as 'SAVED' | 'APPLIED' | 'ASSESSMENT' | 'INTERVIEW' | 'OFFER' | 'REJECTED'
}

function fromApplicationStatus(value: string) {
  return value.charAt(0) + value.slice(1).toLowerCase()
}

function toWorkArrangement(value: string) {
  return value.replace('-', '').replace('Onsite', 'ONSITE').toUpperCase() as 'ONSITE' | 'HYBRID' | 'REMOTE'
}

function toJobType(value: string) {
  return value.replace('-', '_').toUpperCase() as 'FULL_TIME' | 'PART_TIME' | 'CONTRACT' | 'INTERNSHIP' | 'OTHER'
}

function fromEnum(value: string) {
  return value.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, (letter) => letter.toUpperCase())
}

function toContactStatus(value: string): 'NOT_CONNECTED' | 'REQUESTED' | 'CONNECTED' {
  if (value === 'Not connected') return 'NOT_CONNECTED'
  return value === 'Connected' ? 'CONNECTED' : 'REQUESTED'
}

function fromContactStatus(value: string) {
  if (value === 'NOT_CONNECTED') return 'Not connected'
  return value === 'CONNECTED' ? 'Connected' : 'Requested'
}

function toTaskPriority(value: string) {
  return value.toUpperCase() as 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH'
}

function toEventType(value: string) {
  return value.toUpperCase() as 'INTERVIEW' | 'ASSESSMENT' | 'NETWORKING' | 'OTHER'
}

function companyDto(record: {
  id: string; name: string; industry: string | null; location: string | null; website: string | null
  size: string | null; tags: string[]; careersUrl: string | null; linkedinUrl: string | null
  notes: string | null; createdAt: Date
}) {
  return {
    id: record.id, name: record.name, industry: record.industry ?? '', location: record.location ?? '',
    website: record.website ?? '', size: record.size ?? '', tags: record.tags,
    careersUrl: record.careersUrl ?? '', linkedinUrl: record.linkedinUrl ?? '',
    notes: record.notes ?? '', createdAt: record.createdAt.toISOString(),
  }
}

function applicationDto(record: {
  id: string; companyId: string | null; jobTitle: string; status: string; appliedAt: Date | null
  nextAction: string | null; nextFollowUpAt: Date | null; location: string | null
  jobDescription: string | null; prepNotes: string | null; jobUrl: string | null
  applicationUrl: string | null; jobType: string | null; workArrangement: string | null
  resumeReference: string | null; notes: string | null
}) {
  return {
    id: record.id, companyId: record.companyId ?? '', jobTitle: record.jobTitle,
    status: fromApplicationStatus(record.status), appliedAt: dateString(record.appliedAt),
    nextAction: record.nextAction ?? '', nextFollowUpAt: dateString(record.nextFollowUpAt),
    location: record.location ?? '', jobDescription: record.jobDescription ?? '',
    prepNotes: record.prepNotes ?? '', jobUrl: record.jobUrl ?? '', applicationUrl: record.applicationUrl ?? '',
    jobType: record.jobType ? fromEnum(record.jobType).replace('Full Time', 'Full-time').replace('Part Time', 'Part-time') : '',
    workArrangement: record.workArrangement ? fromEnum(record.workArrangement).replace('Onsite', 'On-site') : '',
    resumeReference: record.resumeReference ?? '', notes: record.notes ?? '',
  }
}

function contactDto(record: {
  id: string; companyId: string | null; name: string; jobTitle: string | null
  connectionStatus: string; lastContactedAt: Date | null; tags: string[]
  linkedinUrl: string | null; email: string | null; phone: string | null
  connectionRequestedAt: Date | null; connectionAcceptedAt: Date | null
  nextFollowUpAt: Date | null; notes: string | null
}) {
  return {
    id: record.id, companyId: record.companyId ?? '', name: record.name,
    jobTitle: record.jobTitle ?? '', status: fromContactStatus(record.connectionStatus),
    lastContactedAt: dateString(record.lastContactedAt), tags: record.tags,
    linkedinUrl: record.linkedinUrl ?? '', email: record.email ?? '', phone: record.phone ?? '',
    connectionRequestedAt: dateString(record.connectionRequestedAt),
    connectionAcceptedAt: dateString(record.connectionAcceptedAt),
    nextFollowUpAt: dateString(record.nextFollowUpAt), notes: record.notes ?? '',
  }
}

function taskDto(record: {
  id: string; title: string; companyId: string | null; dueAt: Date | null; priority: string
  status: string; description: string | null; contactId: string | null
  applicationId: string | null; category: string | null
}) {
  return {
    id: record.id, title: record.title, companyId: record.companyId ?? '',
    dueAt: dateString(record.dueAt), priority: fromEnum(record.priority),
    done: record.status === 'COMPLETED', description: record.description ?? '',
    contactId: record.contactId ?? '', applicationId: record.applicationId ?? '',
    category: record.category ?? '',
  }
}

function eventDto(record: {
  id: string; title: string; eventType: string; companyId: string | null; startsAt: Date
  location: string | null; endsAt: Date | null; meetingUrl: string | null; notes: string | null
  contactId: string | null; applicationId: string | null
}) {
  return {
    id: record.id, title: record.title, eventType: fromEnum(record.eventType),
    companyId: record.companyId ?? '', startsAt: dateTimeString(record.startsAt),
    location: record.location ?? '', endsAt: dateTimeString(record.endsAt),
    meetingUrl: record.meetingUrl ?? '', notes: record.notes ?? '',
    contactId: record.contactId ?? '', applicationId: record.applicationId ?? '',
  }
}

async function assertOwnedRelations(
  transaction: Transaction,
  userId: string,
  relationIds: { companyId?: string; contactId?: string; applicationId?: string },
) {
  if (relationIds.companyId && !await transaction.company.findFirst({ where: { id: relationIds.companyId, userId }, select: { id: true } })) throw new InvalidRelationError()
  if (relationIds.contactId && !await transaction.contact.findFirst({ where: { id: relationIds.contactId, userId }, select: { id: true } })) throw new InvalidRelationError()
  if (relationIds.applicationId && !await transaction.jobApplication.findFirst({ where: { id: relationIds.applicationId, userId }, select: { id: true } })) throw new InvalidRelationError()
}

function parseRecord(kind: RecordKind, input: unknown):
  | { success: true; record: ParsedRecord }
  | { success: false; error: z.ZodError } {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'company': {
      const result = schemas.company.safeParse(input)
      return result.success ? { success: true, record: { kind, data: result.data } } : result
    }
    case 'application': {
      const result = schemas.application.safeParse(input)
      return result.success ? { success: true, record: { kind, data: result.data } } : result
    }
    case 'contact': {
      const result = schemas.contact.safeParse(input)
      return result.success ? { success: true, record: { kind, data: result.data } } : result
    }
    case 'task': {
      const result = schemas.task.safeParse(input)
      return result.success ? { success: true, record: { kind, data: result.data } } : result
    }
    case 'event': {
      const result = schemas.event.safeParse(input)
      return result.success ? { success: true, record: { kind, data: result.data } } : result
    }
  }
}

function companyData(data: Extract<ParsedRecord, { kind: 'company' }>['data']) {
  return {
    name: data.name, industry: nullable(data.industry), location: nullable(data.location),
    website: nullable(data.website), size: nullable(data.size),
    tags: data.tags.split(',').map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean),
    careersUrl: nullable(data.careersUrl), linkedinUrl: nullable(data.linkedinUrl), notes: nullable(data.notes),
  }
}

function applicationData(data: Extract<ParsedRecord, { kind: 'application' }>['data']) {
  return {
    jobTitle: data.jobTitle, companyId: data.companyId, status: toApplicationStatus(data.status),
    appliedAt: dateOnly(data.appliedAt), nextAction: nullable(data.nextAction),
    nextFollowUpAt: dateOnly(data.nextFollowUpAt), location: nullable(data.location),
    jobDescription: nullable(data.jobDescription), prepNotes: nullable(data.prepNotes),
    jobUrl: nullable(data.jobUrl), applicationUrl: nullable(data.applicationUrl),
    jobType: toJobType(data.jobType), workArrangement: toWorkArrangement(data.workArrangement),
    resumeReference: nullable(data.resumeReference), notes: nullable(data.notes),
  }
}

function contactData(data: Extract<ParsedRecord, { kind: 'contact' }>['data']) {
  return {
    name: data.name, jobTitle: nullable(data.jobTitle), companyId: nullable(data.companyId),
    connectionStatus: toContactStatus(data.status), lastContactedAt: dateOnly(data.lastContactedAt),
    tags: data.tags.split(',').map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean),
    linkedinUrl: nullable(data.linkedinUrl), email: nullable(data.email), phone: nullable(data.phone),
    connectionRequestedAt: dateOnly(data.connectionRequestedAt),
    connectionAcceptedAt: dateOnly(data.connectionAcceptedAt), nextFollowUpAt: dateOnly(data.nextFollowUpAt),
    notes: nullable(data.notes),
  }
}

function taskData(data: Extract<ParsedRecord, { kind: 'task' }>['data']) {
  return {
    title: data.title, companyId: nullable(data.companyId), dueAt: dateOnly(data.dueAt),
    priority: toTaskPriority(data.priority), ...(data.done === undefined ? {} : { status: data.done ? 'COMPLETED' as const : 'TODO' as const }),
    description: nullable(data.description), contactId: nullable(data.contactId),
    applicationId: nullable(data.applicationId), category: nullable(data.category),
  }
}

function eventData(data: Extract<ParsedRecord, { kind: 'event' }>['data']) {
  return {
    title: data.title, eventType: toEventType(data.eventType), companyId: nullable(data.companyId),
    startsAt: dateTime(data.startsAt)!, endsAt: dateTime(data.endsAt),
    location: nullable(data.location), meetingUrl: nullable(data.meetingUrl), notes: nullable(data.notes),
    contactId: nullable(data.contactId), applicationId: nullable(data.applicationId),
  }
}

function relationIds(record: ParsedRecord) {
  switch (record.kind) {
    case 'company': return {}
    case 'application': return { companyId: record.data.companyId }
    case 'contact': return { companyId: record.data.companyId }
    case 'task': return { companyId: record.data.companyId, contactId: record.data.contactId, applicationId: record.data.applicationId }
    case 'event': return { companyId: record.data.companyId, contactId: record.data.contactId, applicationId: record.data.applicationId }
  }
}

export const dataRouter = Router()
dataRouter.use(requireAuth)

dataRouter.get('/', async (request, response) => {
  const userId = request.auth?.userId
  if (!userId) {
    response.status(401).json({ error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'A valid account is required.' } })
    return
  }
  const prisma = getPrismaClient()
  const [companies, applications, contacts, tasks, events, activities] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.company.findMany({ where: { userId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } }),
    prisma.jobApplication.findMany({ where: { userId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } }),
    prisma.contact.findMany({ where: { userId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } }),
    prisma.task.findMany({ where: { userId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } }),
    prisma.event.findMany({ where: { userId }, orderBy: { startsAt: 'asc' } }),
    prisma.activity.findMany({ where: { userId }, orderBy: { occurredAt: 'desc' } }),
  ])
  response.json({
    companies: companies.map(companyDto),
    applications: applications.map(applicationDto),
    contacts: contacts.map(contactDto),
    tasks: tasks.map(taskDto),
    events: events.map(eventDto),
    activities: activities.map((item) => ({
      id: item.id, type: item.type, description: item.description,
      occurredAt: item.occurredAt.toISOString(), companyId: item.companyId ?? '',
      contactId: item.contactId ?? '', applicationId: item.applicationId ?? '',
    })),
  })
})

dataRouter.post('/:kind', async (request, response) => {
  const userId = request.auth?.userId
  const kindResult = z.enum(['company', 'application', 'contact', 'task', 'event']).safeParse(request.params.kind)
  if (!userId) {
    response.status(401).json({ error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'A valid account is required.' } })
    return
  }
  if (!kindResult.success) {
    response.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Record type not found.' } })
    return
  }
  const kind = kindResult.data
  const parsed = parseRecord(kind, request.body)
  if (!parsed.success) {
    response.status(400).json({ error: { code: 'INVALID_RECORD', message: 'The record data is invalid.', issues: parsed.error.issues } })
    return
  }
  const prisma = getPrismaClient()
  try {
    const record = await prisma.$transaction(async (transaction) => {
      const { record } = parsed
      await assertOwnedRelations(transaction, userId, relationIds(record))
      switch (record.kind) {
        case 'company': return transaction.company.create({ data: { ...companyData(record.data), userId } })
        case 'application': return transaction.jobApplication.create({ data: { ...applicationData(record.data), userId } })
        case 'contact': return transaction.contact.create({ data: { ...contactData(record.data), userId } })
        case 'task': return transaction.task.create({ data: { ...taskData(record.data), status: record.data.done ? 'COMPLETED' : 'TODO', userId } })
        case 'event': return transaction.event.create({ data: { ...eventData(record.data), userId } })
      }
    })
    response.status(201).json({ id: record.id })
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof InvalidRelationError) {
      response.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'RELATED_RECORD_NOT_FOUND', message: 'A related record was not found.' } })
      return
    }
    throw error
  }
})

dataRouter.patch('/:kind/:id', async (request, response) => {
  const userId = request.auth?.userId
  const kindResult = z.enum(['company', 'application', 'contact', 'task', 'event']).safeParse(request.params.kind)
  if (!userId) {
    response.status(401).json({ error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'A valid account is required.' } })
    return
  }
  if (!kindResult.success) {
    response.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Record type not found.' } })
    return
  }
  const kind = kindResult.data
  const parsed = parseRecord(kind, request.body)
  if (!parsed.success) {
    response.status(400).json({ error: { code: 'INVALID_RECORD', message: 'The record data is invalid.', issues: parsed.error.issues } })
    return
  }
  const prisma = getPrismaClient()
  try {
    await prisma.$transaction(async (transaction) => {
      const { record } = parsed
      await assertOwnedRelations(transaction, userId, relationIds(record))
      const where = { id: request.params.id!, userId }
      let updated: { count: number }
      switch (record.kind) {
        case 'company': updated = await transaction.company.updateMany({ where, data: companyData(record.data) }); break
        case 'application': updated = await transaction.jobApplication.updateMany({ where, data: applicationData(record.data) }); break
        case 'contact': updated = await transaction.contact.updateMany({ where, data: contactData(record.data) }); break
        case 'task': {
          const current = await transaction.task.findFirst({ where, select: { status: true } })
          if (!current) throw new NotFoundError()
          updated = await transaction.task.updateMany({
            where,
            data: { ...taskData(record.data), status: record.data.done === undefined ? current.status : record.data.done ? 'COMPLETED' : 'TODO' },
          })
          break
        }
        case 'event': updated = await transaction.event.updateMany({ where, data: eventData(record.data) }); break
      }
      if (!updated.count) throw new NotFoundError()
    })
    response.status(204).end()
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof InvalidRelationError) {
      response.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'RELATED_RECORD_NOT_FOUND', message: 'A related record was not found.' } })
      return
    }
    if (error instanceof NotFoundError) {
      response.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Record not found.' } })
      return
    }
    throw error
  }
})

dataRouter.delete('/:kind/:id', async (request, response) => {
  const userId = request.auth?.userId
  const kindResult = z.enum(['company', 'application', 'contact', 'task', 'event']).safeParse(request.params.kind)
  if (!userId) {
    response.status(401).json({ error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'A valid account is required.' } })
    return
  }
  if (!kindResult.success) {
    response.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Record type not found.' } })
    return
  }
  const prisma = getPrismaClient()
  await prisma.$transaction(async (transaction) => {
    const id = request.params.id!
    if (kindResult.data === 'company') {
      await transaction.contact.updateMany({ where: { userId, companyId: id }, data: { companyId: null } })
      await transaction.jobApplication.updateMany({ where: { userId, companyId: id }, data: { companyId: null } })
      await transaction.task.updateMany({ where: { userId, companyId: id }, data: { companyId: null } })
      await transaction.event.updateMany({ where: { userId, companyId: id }, data: { companyId: null } })
      await transaction.activity.updateMany({ where: { userId, companyId: id }, data: { companyId: null } })
    } else if (kindResult.data === 'contact') {
      await transaction.task.updateMany({ where: { userId, contactId: id }, data: { contactId: null } })
      await transaction.event.updateMany({ where: { userId, contactId: id }, data: { contactId: null } })
      await transaction.activity.updateMany({ where: { userId, contactId: id }, data: { contactId: null } })
    } else if (kindResult.data === 'application') {
      await transaction.task.updateMany({ where: { userId, applicationId: id }, data: { applicationId: null } })
      await transaction.event.updateMany({ where: { userId, applicationId: id }, data: { applicationId: null } })
      await transaction.activity.updateMany({ where: { userId, applicationId: id }, data: { applicationId: null } })
    }
    let deleted: { count: number }
    switch (kindResult.data) {
      case 'company': deleted = await transaction.company.deleteMany({ where: { id, userId } }); break
      case 'application': deleted = await transaction.jobApplication.deleteMany({ where: { id, userId } }); break
      case 'contact': deleted = await transaction.contact.deleteMany({ where: { id, userId } }); break
      case 'task': deleted = await transaction.task.deleteMany({ where: { id, userId } }); break
      case 'event': deleted = await transaction.event.deleteMany({ where: { id, userId } }); break
    }
    if (!deleted.count) throw new NotFoundError()
  }).catch((error: unknown) => {
    if (error instanceof NotFoundError) {
      response.status(404).json({ error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Record not found.' } })
      return
    }
    throw error
  })
  if (!response.headersSent) response.status(204).end()
})

import { disconnectPrismaClient, getPrismaClient } from './client.js'

async function checkConnection() {
  const prisma = getPrismaClient()
  try {
    await prisma.$connect()
    const tables = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ table_name: string }>>`
      SELECT table_name
      FROM information_schema.tables
      WHERE table_schema = 'public'
        AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
        AND table_name <> '_prisma_migrations'
      ORDER BY table_name
    `
    console.info('PostgreSQL connection succeeded.')
    console.info(tables.length
      ? `Existing public tables: ${tables.map(({ table_name }) => table_name).join(', ')}`
      : 'No non-Prisma tables found in the public schema.')
  } finally {
    await disconnectPrismaClient()
  }
}

checkConnection().catch((error: unknown) => {
  const code = error instanceof Error && 'code' in error && typeof error.code === 'string' ? error.code : 'unknown'
  const databaseCode = error instanceof Error && 'meta' in error && error.meta && typeof error.meta === 'object' && 'code' in error.meta && typeof error.meta.code === 'string'
    ? error.meta.code
    : undefined
  console.error(`PostgreSQL connection check failed (${code}${databaseCode ? `/${databaseCode}` : ''}). Verify backend/.env without sharing its secret.`)
  process.exitCode = 1
})

import fs from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { PrismaPg } from '@prisma/adapter-pg'
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'
import pg from 'pg'
import { config } from '../config.js'

let prisma: PrismaClient | undefined
let pool: pg.Pool | undefined

export function getPrismaClient() {
  if (!config.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL must be configured before database access.')
  if (prisma) return prisma

  const parsed = new URL(config.DATABASE_URL)
  const isSupabase = ['.supabase.co', '.supabase.com'].some((suffix) => parsed.hostname.endsWith(suffix))

  if (isSupabase) {
    const moduleDirectory = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
    const certPaths = [
      resolve(moduleDirectory, '../prod-ca-2021.crt'),
      resolve(moduleDirectory, '../../prod-ca-2021.crt'),
    ]
    const certPath = certPaths.find(fs.existsSync)
    if (!certPath) {
      throw new Error('The Supabase PostgreSQL CA certificate is missing; refusing an unverified TLS connection.')
    }

    pool = new pg.Pool({
      host: parsed.hostname,
      port: Number(parsed.port) || 5432,
      user: decodeURIComponent(parsed.username),
      password: decodeURIComponent(parsed.password),
      database: parsed.pathname.replace(/^\//, '') || 'postgres',
      ssl: {
        rejectUnauthorized: true,
        ca: fs.readFileSync(certPath, 'utf8'),
        servername: parsed.hostname,
      },
    })
    prisma = new PrismaClient({
      adapter: new PrismaPg(pool),
    })
  } else {
    pool = new pg.Pool({
      connectionString: config.DATABASE_URL,
    })
    prisma = new PrismaClient({
      adapter: new PrismaPg(pool),
    })
  }

  return prisma
}

export async function disconnectPrismaClient() {
  if (!prisma) return
  const currentPrisma = prisma
  const currentPool = pool
  prisma = undefined
  pool = undefined
  await currentPrisma.$disconnect()
  if (currentPool) {
    await currentPool.end()
  }
}

import path from 'node:path'

export interface DocumentExtractionResult {
  text: string
  pageCount?: number
  status: 'COMPLETED' | 'UNSUPPORTED' | 'FAILED' | 'EMPTY'
  message?: string
}

export async function extractTextFromBuffer(
  buffer: Buffer,
  filename: string,
  _declaredMimeType?: string
): Promise<DocumentExtractionResult> {
  if (!buffer || buffer.length === 0) {
    return {
      text: '',
      status: 'EMPTY',
      message: 'The file buffer is empty (0 bytes).',
    }
  }

  const ext = path.extname(filename).toLowerCase()

  try {
    switch (ext) {
      case '.txt': {
        const text = buffer.toString('utf-8').trim()
        if (!text) {
          return { text: '', status: 'EMPTY', message: 'Plain text file contains no text.' }
        }
        return { text, status: 'COMPLETED' }
      }

      case '.docx': {
        try {
          // Dynamic import of mammoth to keep module lightweight
          const mammoth = await import('mammoth')
          const result = await mammoth.extractRawText({ buffer })
          const text = (result.value || '').trim()
          if (!text) {
            return {
              text: '',
              status: 'EMPTY',
              message: 'DOCX file contains no extractable text.',
            }
          }
          return { text, status: 'COMPLETED' }
        } catch (docxErr: any) {
          return {
            text: '',
            status: 'FAILED',
            message: `Failed to extract text from DOCX: ${docxErr.message || 'Corrupt or unreadable document.'}`,
          }
        }
      }

      case '.pdf': {
        try {
          // Dynamic import of pdf-parse
          const pdfParseModule = await import('pdf-parse')
          // pdf-parse default export or commonjs export
          const pdfParse = (pdfParseModule as any).default || pdfParseModule
          const data = await pdfParse(buffer)
          const rawText = (data.text || '').replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').trim()

          // Check if PDF is essentially empty (scanned image or empty)
          if (!rawText || rawText.length < 15) {
            return {
              text: '',
              pageCount: data.numpages || 1,
              status: 'EMPTY',
              message: 'This PDF appears to be a scanned document or has no selectable text layer. Text extraction cannot proceed without OCR.',
            }
          }

          return {
            text: rawText,
            pageCount: data.numpages,
            status: 'COMPLETED',
          }
        } catch (pdfErr: any) {
          return {
            text: '',
            status: 'FAILED',
            message: `Failed to parse PDF document: ${pdfErr.message || 'Corrupt or encrypted PDF.'}`,
          }
        }
      }

      default:
        return {
          text: '',
          status: 'UNSUPPORTED',
          message: `Text extraction is not supported for ${ext || 'this format'}. Supported formats are .pdf, .docx, and .txt.`,
        }
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return {
      text: '',
      status: 'FAILED',
      message: `Extraction encountered an error: ${err.message || 'Unknown error'}`,
    }
  }
}

import type { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'
import type { DocumentSearchResultItem } from './types.js'

export interface DocumentSearchParams {
  query: string
  category?: string
  extension?: string
  companyId?: string
  applicationId?: string
  page?: number
  limit?: number
}

function extractSearchSnippet(text: string, term: string, radius = 50): string {
  if (!text || !term) return ''
  const lowerText = text.toLowerCase()
  const lowerTerm = term.toLowerCase()
  const idx = lowerText.indexOf(lowerTerm)
  if (idx === -1) return text.slice(0, 100) + '...'

  const start = Math.max(0, idx - radius)
  const end = Math.min(text.length, idx + term.length + radius)
  let snippet = text.slice(start, end).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
  if (start > 0) snippet = '...' + snippet
  if (end < text.length) snippet = snippet + '...'
  return snippet
}

export async function searchUserVaultDocuments(
  prisma: PrismaClient,
  userId: string,
  params: DocumentSearchParams
): Promise<{ items: DocumentSearchResultItem[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {
  const query = (params.query || '').trim().toLowerCase()
  const page = Math.max(1, params.page || 1)
  const limit = Math.min(50, Math.max(1, params.limit || 20))
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit

  // Base where clause strictly scoped to user
  const where: any = {
    userId,
    status: 'ACTIVE',
  }

  if (params.category && params.category !== 'ALL') {
    where.category = params.category
  }

  if (params.extension && params.extension !== 'ALL') {
    where.extension = params.extension.startsWith('.') ? params.extension : `.${params.extension}`
  }

  if (params.companyId) {
    where.companyDocuments = {
      some: { companyId: params.companyId },
    }
  }

  if (params.applicationId) {
    where.applicationDocuments = {
      some: { applicationId: params.applicationId },
    }
  }

  // Fetch candidate files for this user
  const files = await prisma.vaultFile.findMany({
    where,
    include: {
      jobDescriptions: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          title: true,
          descriptionText: true,
          responsibilities: true,
          requiredSkills: true,
          preferredSkills: true,
        },
      },
      resumeVersions: {
        include: {
          resumeGroup: { select: { id: true, name: true, targetRole: true } },
        },
      },
      companyDocuments: {
        include: {
          company: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
        },
      },
      applicationDocuments: {
        include: {
          application: { select: { id: true, jobTitle: true } },
        },
      },
    },
    orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  })

  const results: DocumentSearchResultItem[] = []

  for (const file of files) {
    if (!query) {
      // If no query string, return all matching filtered files
      results.push({
        id: file.id,
        displayName: file.displayName,
        originalFilename: file.originalFilename,
        category: file.category,
        mimeType: file.mimeType,
        fileSizeBytes: file.fileSizeBytes,
        createdAt: file.createdAt.toISOString(),
        updatedAt: file.updatedAt.toISOString(),
        matchType: 'metadata',
        matchHighlights: [],
        companyName: file.companyDocuments[0]?.company?.name,
        jobTitle: file.applicationDocuments[0]?.application?.jobTitle || file.jobDescriptions[0]?.title,
      })
      continue
    }

    // Check Metadata
    const metadataFields = [
      file.displayName,
      file.originalFilename,
      file.description || '',
      ...(file.tags || []),
      file.category,
      file.companyDocuments[0]?.company?.name || '',
      file.applicationDocuments[0]?.application?.jobTitle || '',
      file.resumeVersions[0]?.resumeGroup?.name || '',
      file.resumeVersions[0]?.resumeGroup?.targetRole || '',
      file.resumeVersions[0]?.versionLabel || '',
      file.jobDescriptions[0]?.title || '',
    ]

    const matchedMetadata = metadataFields.some((f) => f.toLowerCase().includes(query))

    // Check Document Content (linked JD texts, responsibilities, skills)
    let contentMatched = false
    let contentSnippet = ''
    const contentTextParts: string[] = []

    for (const jd of file.jobDescriptions) {
      if (jd.descriptionText) contentTextParts.push(jd.descriptionText)
      if (jd.responsibilities) contentTextParts.push(jd.responsibilities)
      if (jd.requiredSkills?.length) contentTextParts.push(jd.requiredSkills.join(' '))
      if (jd.preferredSkills?.length) contentTextParts.push(jd.preferredSkills.join(' '))
    }

    const fullContent = contentTextParts.join(' ')
    if (fullContent.toLowerCase().includes(query)) {
      contentMatched = true
      contentSnippet = extractSearchSnippet(fullContent, query)
    }

    if (matchedMetadata || contentMatched) {
      const matchType: 'content' | 'metadata' | 'both' =
        matchedMetadata && contentMatched ? 'both' : contentMatched ? 'content' : 'metadata'

      const matchHighlights: string[] = []
      if (matchedMetadata) matchHighlights.push('Filename or Metadata')
      if (contentMatched) matchHighlights.push('Document Content')

      results.push({
        id: file.id,
        displayName: file.displayName,
        originalFilename: file.originalFilename,
        category: file.category,
        mimeType: file.mimeType,
        fileSizeBytes: file.fileSizeBytes,
        createdAt: file.createdAt.toISOString(),
        updatedAt: file.updatedAt.toISOString(),
        snippet: contentSnippet || (file.description ? extractSearchSnippet(file.description, query) : undefined),
        matchType,
        matchHighlights,
        companyName: file.companyDocuments[0]?.company?.name,
        jobTitle: file.applicationDocuments[0]?.application?.jobTitle || file.jobDescriptions[0]?.title,
      })
    }
  }

  const paginated = results.slice(skip, skip + limit)

  return {
    items: paginated,
    total: results.length,
    page,
    limit,
  }
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
import { computeSha256, checkFileDuplicate } from './file-hash.js'

describe('File Hash & Duplicate Detection', () => {
  it('computes deterministic SHA-256 hash for buffer', () => {
    const buffer1 = Buffer.from('CareerOS Resume File Content v1')
    const buffer2 = Buffer.from('CareerOS Resume File Content v1')
    const buffer3 = Buffer.from('Different Content')

    const hash1 = computeSha256(buffer1)
    const hash2 = computeSha256(buffer2)
    const hash3 = computeSha256(buffer3)

    expect(hash1).toBe(hash2)
    expect(hash1).not.toBe(hash3)
    expect(hash1.length).toBe(64)
  })

  it('queries database for existing active file under the authenticated user only', async () => {
    const mockPrisma = {
      vaultFile: {
        findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
          id: 'file-123',
          displayName: 'Existing Resume.pdf',
          originalFilename: 'Existing Resume.pdf',
          fileSizeBytes: 1024,
          createdAt: new Date('2026-01-01'),
          category: 'RESUME',
          resumeVersions: [{ resumeGroup: { id: 'rg-1', name: 'Software Engineer' } }],
          companyDocuments: [],
          applicationDocuments: [{ application: { id: 'app-1', jobTitle: 'Full Stack Dev' } }],
        }),
      },
    } as any

    const result = await checkFileDuplicate(mockPrisma, 'user-a', 'abc123hash')

    expect(result.isDuplicate).toBe(true)
    expect(result.existingFile?.id).toBe('file-123')
    expect(result.existingFile?.displayName).toBe('Existing Resume.pdf')
    expect(result.existingFile?.resumeGroup?.name).toBe('Software Engineer')
    expect(result.existingFile?.applications?.[0]?.jobTitle).toBe('Full Stack Dev')

    // Verify isolation: query filtered strictly by userId and status: ACTIVE
    expect(mockPrisma.vaultFile.findFirst).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      where: {
        userId: 'user-a',
        sha256Hash: 'abc123hash',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      },
      include: expect.any(Object),
    })
  })

  it('returns false when no duplicate exists', async () => {
    const mockPrisma = {
      vaultFile: {
        findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null),
      },
    } as any

    const result = await checkFileDuplicate(mockPrisma, 'user-a', 'nonexistenthash')
    expect(result.isDuplicate).toBe(false)
  })
})

import crypto from 'node:crypto'
import type { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'
import type { DuplicateFileCheckResult } from './types.js'

export function computeSha256(buffer: Buffer): string {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex')
}

export async function checkFileDuplicate(
  prisma: PrismaClient,
  userId: string,
  sha256Hash: string
): Promise<DuplicateFileCheckResult> {
  if (!sha256Hash || !userId) {
    return { isDuplicate: false, sha256Hash: '' }
  }

  // Strict user isolation: only check files owned by this authenticated user
  const existing = await prisma.vaultFile.findFirst({
    where: {
      userId,
      sha256Hash,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    },
    include: {
      resumeVersions: {
        include: { resumeGroup: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
        take: 1,
      },
      companyDocuments: {
        include: { company: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
        take: 3,
      },
      applicationDocuments: {
        include: { application: { select: { id: true, jobTitle: true } } },
        take: 3,
      },
    },
  })

  if (!existing) {
    return {
      isDuplicate: false,
      sha256Hash,
    }
  }

  return {
    isDuplicate: true,
    sha256Hash,
    existingFile: {
      id: existing.id,
      displayName: existing.displayName,
      originalFilename: existing.originalFilename,
      fileSizeBytes: existing.fileSizeBytes,
      createdAt: existing.createdAt.toISOString(),
      category: existing.category,
      resumeGroup: existing.resumeVersions[0]?.resumeGroup
        ? {
            id: existing.resumeVersions[0].resumeGroup.id,
            name: existing.resumeVersions[0].resumeGroup.name,
          }
        : undefined,
      companies: existing.companyDocuments
        .map((cd) => cd.company)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map((c) => ({ id: c.id, name: c.name })),
      applications: existing.applicationDocuments
        .map((ad) => ad.application)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map((a) => ({ id: a.id, jobTitle: a.jobTitle })),
    },
  }
}

import type { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'
import type { SmartInsightsSummary, SmartReminderItem } from './types.js'

export async function generateSmartInsights(
  prisma: PrismaClient,
  userId: string
): Promise<SmartInsightsSummary> {
  const now = new Date()
  const sevenDaysFromNow = new Date(now.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
  const threeDaysFromNow = new Date(now.getTime() + 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)

  // 1. Fetch user's applications
  const applications = await prisma.jobApplication.findMany({
    where: { userId },
    include: {
      company: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
      events: { where: { startsAt: { gte: now } } },
      tasks: true,
    },
    orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' },
  })

  // 2. Fetch user's tasks
  const tasks = await prisma.task.findMany({
    where: { userId },
    include: {
      company: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
      application: { select: { id: true, jobTitle: true } },
    },
    orderBy: { dueAt: 'asc' },
  })

  // 3. Fetch user's upcoming events
  const events = await prisma.event.findMany({
    where: {
      userId,
      startsAt: { gte: now, lte: sevenDaysFromNow },
    },
    include: {
      company: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
      application: { select: { id: true, jobTitle: true } },
    },
    orderBy: { startsAt: 'asc' },
  })

  // 4. Fetch user's contacts needing follow-up
  const contacts = await prisma.contact.findMany({
    where: {
      userId,
      nextFollowUpAt: { lte: threeDaysFromNow },
    },
    include: {
      company: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
    },
  })

  const reminders: SmartReminderItem[] = []

  // Reminder Rule 1: Upcoming Interviews
  for (const event of events) {
    if (event.eventType === 'INTERVIEW') {
      const companyName = event.company?.name || 'Company'
      const role = event.application?.jobTitle || 'Role'
      reminders.push({
        id: `event-${event.id}`,
        type: 'interview',
        title: `Interview with ${companyName}`,
        description: `Scheduled for ${event.startsAt.toLocaleDateString()} for ${role}.`,
        severity: 'urgent',
        date: event.startsAt.toISOString(),
        recordId: event.id,
        recordType: 'event',
        actionUrl: `/calendar`,
        actionLabel: 'View Schedule',
        reason: 'Interview is scheduled within the next 7 days.',
      })
    }
  }

  // Reminder Rule 2: Overdue Tasks
  for (const task of tasks) {
    if (task.status !== 'COMPLETED' && task.dueAt && task.dueAt < now) {
      reminders.push({
        id: `task-overdue-${task.id}`,
        type: 'overdue_task',
        title: `Overdue Task: ${task.title}`,
        description: `Due on ${task.dueAt.toLocaleDateString()}.${task.company ? ` Related to ${task.company.name}.` : ''}`,
        severity: 'urgent',
        date: task.dueAt.toISOString(),
        recordId: task.id,
        recordType: 'task',
        actionUrl: `/tasks`,
        actionLabel: 'Review Tasks',
        reason: 'Task deadline has passed.',
      })
    }
  }

  // Reminder Rule 3: Pending Contact Follow-ups
  for (const contact of contacts) {
    if (contact.nextFollowUpAt) {
      const isPast = contact.nextFollowUpAt < now
      reminders.push({
        id: `contact-fu-${contact.id}`,
        type: 'follow_up',
        title: `Follow up with ${contact.name}`,
        description: `${contact.jobTitle ? `${contact.jobTitle} ` : ''}${contact.company ? `at ${contact.company.name}` : ''}. Follow-up ${isPast ? 'was due' : 'due'} on ${contact.nextFollowUpAt.toLocaleDateString()}.`,
        severity: isPast ? 'warning' : 'info',
        date: contact.nextFollowUpAt.toISOString(),
        recordId: contact.id,
        recordType: 'company',
        actionUrl: `/contacts`,
        actionLabel: 'Open Contacts',
        reason: 'Scheduled networking follow-up date reached.',
      })
    }
  }

  // Reminder Rule 4: Applications without updates (> 10 days since applied, no interviews)
  for (const app of applications) {
    if (app.status === 'APPLIED' && app.appliedAt) {
      const daysSinceApplied = Math.floor((now.getTime() - app.appliedAt.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24))
      if (daysSinceApplied >= 10 && app.events.length === 0) {
        reminders.push({
          id: `app-stale-${app.id}`,
          type: 'stale_application',
          title: `Check in on ${app.jobTitle}`,
          description: `Applied ${daysSinceApplied} days ago${app.company ? ` to ${app.company.name}` : ''} with no recent activity recorded.`,
          severity: 'info',
          recordId: app.id,
          recordType: 'application',
          actionUrl: `/applications`,
          actionLabel: 'View Application',
          reason: 'More than 10 days have elapsed since submission without follow-up.',
        })
      }
    }
  }

  // Reminder Rule 5: Preparation tasks due soon
  const prepCategories = ['Technical Prep', 'System Design', 'DSA Practice', 'Behavioral Prep']
  for (const task of tasks) {
    if (
      task.status !== 'COMPLETED' &&
      task.dueAt &&
      task.dueAt >= now &&
      task.dueAt <= threeDaysFromNow &&
      task.category &&
      prepCategories.includes(task.category)
    ) {
      reminders.push({
        id: `task-prep-${task.id}`,
        type: 'preparation_due',
        title: `Interview Prep: ${task.title}`,
        description: `Due in ${Math.ceil((task.dueAt.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24))} days.`,
        severity: 'warning',
        date: task.dueAt.toISOString(),
        recordId: task.id,
        recordType: 'task',
        actionUrl: `/tasks`,
        actionLabel: 'Practice Now',
        reason: 'Target interview preparation task deadline is approaching.',
      })
    }
  }

  // Aggregate Stats
  const activeApplications = applications.filter((a) => !['REJECTED', 'OFFER'].includes(a.status)).length

  const applicationsByStatus: Record<string, number> = {}
  for (const a of applications) {
    applicationsByStatus[a.status] = (applicationsByStatus[a.status] || 0) + 1
  }

  const prepTasks = tasks.filter((t) => t.category && prepCategories.includes(t.category))
  const completedPrepTasks = prepTasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'COMPLETED')
  const preparationProgressPercentage =
    prepTasks.length > 0 ? Math.round((completedPrepTasks.length / prepTasks.length) * 100) : 100

  // Suggested actions prioritizes urgent items first
  const suggestedActions = [...reminders].sort((a, b) => {
    const priorityMap: Record<string, number> = { urgent: 3, warning: 2, info: 1 }
    const pB = priorityMap[b.severity] ?? 0
    const pA = priorityMap[a.severity] ?? 0
    return pB - pA
  })

  return {
    reminders,
    stats: {
      activeApplications,
      applicationsByStatus,
      upcomingInterviewsCount: events.filter((e) => e.eventType === 'INTERVIEW').length,
      pendingFollowUpsCount: contacts.length,
      overdueTasksCount: reminders.filter((r) => r.type === 'overdue_task').length,
      preparationProgressPercentage,
    },
    suggestedActions: suggestedActions.slice(0, 6),
  }
}
