#requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Generates an AI-readable snapshot of a software repository.

.DESCRIPTION
    - Detects the project root using $PSScriptRoot.
    - Creates project-context/project-context.txt.
    - Includes a directory tree, metadata, and relevant text files.
    - Excludes dependencies, generated output, environment files, and binaries.
    - Skips files suspected of containing hardcoded secrets.
    - Applies per-file and total-output size limits.
    - Does not execute project code, install packages, or modify source files.

.COMPATIBILITY
    Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7+.
#>

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# ----------------------------- Configuration -----------------------------

$OutputDirectoryName = 'project-context'
$OutputFileName = 'project-context.txt'

# Maximum size of an individual source file to include.
$MaxFileSizeBytes = 256KB

# Maximum approximate output size before a warning is displayed.
$MaxOutputSizeBytes = 5MB

# Set to $true to include hidden text files, excluding protected paths.
$IncludeHiddenFiles = $true

# Directory names that are never traversed.
$ExcludedDirectoryNames = @(
    '.git', '.svn', '.hg',
    'node_modules', 'bower_components',
    '.next', '.nuxt', '.output', '.turbo',
    'dist', 'build', 'out', 'release',
    'coverage', '.nyc_output',
    '__pycache__', '.pytest_cache', '.mypy_cache',
    '.ruff_cache', '.tox', '.venv', 'venv', 'env',
    'vendor', 'target', 'bin', 'obj',
    '.idea', '.vscode-test',
    'playwright-report', 'test-results',
    'storybook-static',
    $OutputDirectoryName
)

# Extensions commonly useful for software architecture and debugging.
$IncludedExtensions = @(
    '.ts', '.tsx', '.mts', '.cts',
    '.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs',
    '.py', '.pyi',
    '.java', '.kt', '.kts', '.scala',
    '.c', '.h', '.cpp', '.hpp', '.cc',
    '.cs', '.fs', '.go', '.rs', '.php',
    '.rb', '.rake', '.swift', '.dart',
    '.vue', '.svelte', '.astro',
    '.html', '.htm', '.css', '.scss', '.sass', '.less',
    '.json', '.jsonc', '.json5',
    '.yaml', '.yml', '.toml', '.ini', '.cfg', '.conf',
    '.xml', '.xsd', '.xsl',
    '.sql', '.prisma', '.graphql', '.gql',
    '.md', '.mdx', '.rst', '.txt',
    '.ps1', '.psm1', '.psd1', '.sh', '.bash',
    '.bat', '.cmd',
    '.dockerfile', '.tf', '.hcl',
    '.properties', '.gradle',
    '.make', '.mk', '.cmake',
    '.proto', '.ipynb',
    '.editorconfig', '.gitignore', '.gitattributes',
    '.npmrc', '.nvmrc', '.prettierrc', '.eslintrc',
    '.lock'
)

# Important extensionless or specially named files.
$IncludedFileNames = @(
    'README', 'README.md', 'README.txt',
    'LICENSE', 'LICENSE.md', 'NOTICE',
    'CHANGELOG', 'CHANGELOG.md',
    'CONTRIBUTING.md', 'CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md',
    'SECURITY.md', 'SUPPORT.md',

    'Jenkinsfile', 'Vagrantfile',

    'package.json', 'package-lock.json',
    'npm-shrinkwrap.json', 'yarn.lock',
    'pnpm-lock.yaml', 'bun.lock', 'bun.lockb',
    'composer.json', 'composer.lock',
    'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock',

    'requirements.txt', 'Pipfile', 'Pipfile.lock',
    'poetry.lock', 'pyproject.toml',

    'mix.exs', 'mix.lock',

    'settings.gradle', 'settings.gradle.kts',
    'gradlew', 'mvnw',
    'global.json', 'NuGet.config',
    'Directory.Build.props', 'Directory.Build.targets',
    'tsconfig', 'jsconfig',
    '.gitignore', '.gitattributes', '.gitmodules',
    '.dockerignore', '.npmrc', '.nvmrc',
    '.editorconfig', '.prettierrc', '.eslintrc',
    '.env.example', '.env.sample', '.env.template',
    '.env.development.example', '.env.production.example',
    'LICENSE-MIT', 'LICENSE-APACHE'
)

# Never include real environment files, private keys, or certificate files.
$ExcludedFileNames = @(
    '.env', '.env.local', '.env.development', '.env.production',
    '.env.test', '.env.development.local', '.env.production.local',
    '.env.test.local', '.env.staging', '.env.staging.local',
    'id_rsa', 'id_dsa', 'id_ecdsa', 'id_ed25519',
    'known_hosts', 'authorized_keys',
    'credentials', 'credentials.json',
    'secrets.json', 'service-account.json',
    'serviceaccount.json'
)

$ExcludedExtensions = @(
    '.exe', '.dll', '.so', '.dylib', '.bin', '.dat',
    '.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.bmp', '.ico',
    '.webp', '.avif', '.tif', '.tiff',
    '.pdf', '.doc', '.docx', '.xls', '.xlsx',
    '.ppt', '.pptx', '.zip', '.7z', '.rar', '.tar',
    '.gz', '.bz2', '.xz', '.woff', '.woff2', '.ttf',
    '.otf', '.eot', '.mp3', '.mp4', '.mov', '.avi',
    '.wav', '.sqlite', '.db', '.class', '.jar', '.war',
    '.pyc', '.pyo', '.pyd', '.pem', '.key', '.p12',
    '.pfx', '.cer', '.crt', '.der'
)

# ----------------------------- Initialization -----------------------------

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($PSScriptRoot)) {
    throw 'Cannot determine the script directory. Save this script as a .ps1 file and run it from PowerShell.'
}

$ProjectRoot = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($PSScriptRoot).TrimEnd(
    [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,
    [System.IO.Path]::AltDirectorySeparatorChar
)

$OutputDirectory = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $OutputDirectoryName
$OutputPath = Join-Path $OutputDirectory $OutputFileName

$IncludedFiles = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[object]'
$SkippedFiles = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[object]'
$ManualReviewFiles = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[string]'
$Errors = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[string]'

$Utf8Strict = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false, $true)
$Utf8Output = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($true)

$GeneratedAt = Get-Date
$OutputBuffer = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder

# ----------------------------- Helper functions -----------------------------

function Write-ProgressMessage {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host ('[Context] ' + $Message) -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Get-RelativePathCompat {
    param(
        [string]$BasePath,
        [string]$FullPath
    )

    # Avoid Path.GetRelativePath because it is unavailable on older .NET.
    $Base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($BasePath).TrimEnd(
        [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,
        [System.IO.Path]::AltDirectorySeparatorChar
    ) + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar

    $Full = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($FullPath)

    if ($Full.StartsWith($Base, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return $Full.Substring($Base.Length).Replace('\', '/')
    }

    if ($Full.Equals($Base.TrimEnd('\'), [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return '.'
    }

    return $Full.Replace('\', '/')
}

function Test-IsUnderPath {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$ParentPath
    )

    $Parent = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ParentPath).TrimEnd(
        [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,
        [System.IO.Path]::AltDirectorySeparatorChar
    ) + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar

    $Full = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)

    return $Full.StartsWith(
        $Parent,
        [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
    )
}

function Test-IsEnvironmentFile {
    param([string]$Name)

    # Allow only explicitly named example/sample/template environment files.
    if ($Name -match '^\.env(\..+)?$') {
        return ($Name -notmatch '\.(example|sample|template)$')
    }

    return $false
}

function Test-IsExcludedPath {
    param([System.IO.FileInfo]$File)

    $Relative = Get-RelativePathCompat $ProjectRoot $File.FullName
    $Parts = $Relative -split '/'

    foreach ($Part in $Parts) {
        if ($Part -eq $OutputDirectoryName) {
            return $true
        }
    }

    if ($ExcludedFileNames -contains $File.Name) {
        return $true
    }

    if (Test-IsEnvironmentFile $File.Name) {
        return $true
    }

    if ($ExcludedExtensions -contains $File.Extension.ToLowerInvariant()) {
        return $true
    }

    # Private-key blocks are never suitable for an AI context snapshot.
    if ($File.Name -match '(?i)\.(pem|key|p12|pfx|keystore|jks)$') {
        return $true
    }

    # Common credential or secret file names.
    if ($File.Name -match '(?i)(secret|credential|private.?key|service.?account)' -and
        $File.Name -notmatch '(?i)(example|sample|template|schema|test)') {
        return $true
    }

    return $false
}

function Test-IsLikelyBinary {
    param([byte[]]$Bytes)

    if ($null -eq $Bytes -or $Bytes.Length -eq 0) {
        return $false
    }

    $CheckLength = [Math]::Min($Bytes.Length, 8192)

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $CheckLength; $i++) {
        if ($Bytes[$i] -eq 0) {
            return $true
        }
    }

    return $false
}

function Get-TextFromBytes {
    param([byte[]]$Bytes)

    if ($null -eq $Bytes -or $Bytes.Length -eq 0) {
        return ''
    }

    # Recognize common Unicode byte-order marks first.
    if ($Bytes.Length -ge 3 -and
        $Bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $Bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $Bytes[2] -eq 0xBF) {
        return [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($Bytes, 3, $Bytes.Length - 3)
    }

    if ($Bytes.Length -ge 2 -and $Bytes[0] -eq 0xFF -and $Bytes[1] -eq 0xFE) {
        return [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString($Bytes, 2, $Bytes.Length - 2)
    }

    if ($Bytes.Length -ge 2 -and $Bytes[0] -eq 0xFE -and $Bytes[1] -eq 0xFF) {
        return [System.Text.Encoding]::BigEndianUnicode.GetString($Bytes, 2, $Bytes.Length - 2)
    }

    try {
        return $Utf8Strict.GetString($Bytes)
    }
    catch {
        # Fallback for older Windows files saved using the active code page.
        return [System.Text.Encoding]::Default.GetString($Bytes)
    }
}

function Test-LikelySecretContent {
    param([string]$Content)

    # Heuristic patterns only. This is not a complete secret scanner.
    $Patterns = @(
        '(?im)-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH |DSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----',
        '(?im)\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b',
        '(?im)\bASIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b',
        '(?im)\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}\b',
        '(?im)\bgithub_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}\b',
        '(?im)\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\b',
        '(?im)\bAIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{30,}\b',
        '(?im)\bxox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}\b',
        '(?im)\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\b',
        '(?im)\b(password|passwd|secret|api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|client[_-]?secret|private[_-]?key)\b\s*[:=]\s*["''][^"'']{8,}["'']',
        '(?im)\bBearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{20,}',
        '(?im)\bpostgres(?:ql)?://[^/\s:]+:[^@\s]+@[^/\s]+',
        '(?im)\bmongodb(?:\+srv)?://[^/\s:]+:[^@\s]+@[^/\s]+'
    )

    foreach ($Pattern in $Patterns) {
        if ($Content -match $Pattern) {
            return $true
        }
    }

    return $false
}

function Add-OutputLine {
    param([string]$Line)

    [void]$OutputBuffer.AppendLine($Line)
}

function Add-Section {
    param([string]$Title)

    Add-OutputLine ''
    Add-OutputLine ('=' * 88)
    Add-OutputLine $Title
    Add-OutputLine ('=' * 88)
}

function Get-TreeLines {
    param([string]$Root)

    $Lines = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[string]'
    $Queue = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.Queue[object]'
    $Queue.Enqueue(@{ Path = $Root; Prefix = '' })

    while ($Queue.Count -gt 0) {
        $Item = $Queue.Dequeue()
        $CurrentPath = [string]$Item.Path
        $Prefix = [string]$Item.Prefix

        try {
            $Children = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $CurrentPath -Force -ErrorAction Stop |
                Where-Object {
                    $ExcludedDirectoryNames -notcontains $_.Name -and
                    -not ($_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Name -eq $OutputDirectoryName) -and
                    -not (Test-IsEnvironmentFile $_.Name) -and
                    ($IncludeHiddenFiles -or $_.Name -notlike '.*')
                } |
                Sort-Object @{ Expression = { if ($_.PSIsContainer) { 0 } else { 1 } } }, Name)
        }
        catch {
            [void]$Lines.Add($Prefix + '[Unable to read directory]')
            continue
        }

        foreach ($Child in $Children) {
            if ($Child.PSIsContainer) {
                [void]$Lines.Add($Prefix + '+-- ' + $Child.Name + '/')
                $Queue.Enqueue(@{
                    Path = $Child.FullName
                    Prefix = $Prefix + '    '
                })
            }
            else {
                $LengthLabel = ''
                try {
                    $LengthLabel = ' (' + $Child.Length + ' bytes)'
                }
                catch {}

                [void]$Lines.Add($Prefix + '+-- ' + $Child.Name + $LengthLabel)
            }
        }
    }

    return $Lines
}

# ----------------------------- File collection -----------------------------

try {
    Write-ProgressMessage ('Project root: ' + $ProjectRoot)
    Write-ProgressMessage 'Preparing output directory...'

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $OutputDirectory -PathType Container)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutputDirectory -Force | Out-Null
    }

    # Resolve output paths before enumeration to avoid accidental self-inclusion.
    $OutputFullPath = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($OutputPath)

    Write-ProgressMessage 'Scanning repository files...'

    $AllFiles = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[System.IO.FileInfo]'
    $DirectoryQueue = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.Queue[string]'
    $DirectoryQueue.Enqueue($ProjectRoot)

    while ($DirectoryQueue.Count -gt 0) {
        $CurrentDirectory = $DirectoryQueue.Dequeue()

        try {
            $Children = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $CurrentDirectory -Force -ErrorAction Stop |
                Sort-Object Name)

            foreach ($Child in $Children) {
                if ($Child.PSIsContainer) {
                    if ($ExcludedDirectoryNames -contains $Child.Name) {
                        continue
                    }

                    if (-not $IncludeHiddenFiles -and $Child.Name.StartsWith('.')) {
                        continue
                    }

                    if (Test-IsUnderPath $Child.FullName $OutputDirectory) {
                        continue
                    }

                    $DirectoryQueue.Enqueue($Child.FullName)
                }
                else {
                    if ($Child.FullName -eq $OutputFullPath) {
                        continue
                    }

                    if (-not $IncludeHiddenFiles -and $Child.Name.StartsWith('.')) {
                        continue
                    }

                    if (Test-IsExcludedPath $Child) {
                        $SkippedFiles.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
                            Path = Get-RelativePathCompat $ProjectRoot $Child.FullName
                            Reason = 'Excluded by safety or file-type rules'
                        }) | Out-Null
                        continue
                    }

                    $IsNamed = $IncludedFileNames -contains $Child.Name
                    $IsExtensionIncluded = $IncludedExtensions -contains $Child.Extension.ToLowerInvariant()

                    if ($IsNamed -or $IsExtensionIncluded) {
                        $AllFiles.Add($Child)
                    }
                    else {
                        $SkippedFiles.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
                            Path = Get-RelativePathCompat $ProjectRoot $Child.FullName
                            Reason = 'File type not selected'
                        }) | Out-Null
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        catch {
            $RelativeDirectory = Get-RelativePathCompat $ProjectRoot $CurrentDirectory
            $Message = 'Cannot enumerate directory "' + $RelativeDirectory + '": ' + $_.Exception.Message
            $Errors.Add($Message) | Out-Null
            Write-Warning $Message
        }
    }

    # Stable ordering makes repeated runs predictable.
    $AllFiles = @($AllFiles | Sort-Object {
        Get-RelativePathCompat $ProjectRoot $_.FullName
    })

    Write-ProgressMessage ('Found ' + $AllFiles.Count + ' candidate text files.')

    # ----------------------------- Build snapshot -----------------------------

    Add-OutputLine 'PROJECT CONTEXT SNAPSHOT'
    Add-OutputLine ('Generated: ' + $GeneratedAt.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss zzz'))
    Add-OutputLine ('Project root: ' + $ProjectRoot)
    Add-OutputLine ('Output file: ' + $OutputDirectoryName + '/' + $OutputFileName)
    Add-OutputLine ('PowerShell version: ' + $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString())
    Add-OutputLine ('Operating system: ' + [System.Environment]::OSVersion.VersionString)
    Add-OutputLine ''
    Add-OutputLine 'SECURITY NOTICE'
    Add-OutputLine 'Real .env files, common private-key files, binary files, and files matching'
    Add-OutputLine 'secret heuristics are excluded. Detection is heuristic and cannot guarantee'
    Add-OutputLine 'that every secret is found. Review the generated snapshot before uploading.'
    Add-OutputLine ''
    Add-OutputLine 'REPOSITORY OVERVIEW'
    Add-OutputLine ('Candidate files: ' + $AllFiles.Count)
    Add-OutputLine ('Excluded/skipped files so far: ' + $SkippedFiles.Count)

    Add-Section 'PROJECT DIRECTORY TREE'

    $TreeLines = @(Get-TreeLines -Root $ProjectRoot)
    foreach ($TreeLine in $TreeLines) {
        Add-OutputLine $TreeLine
    }

    Add-Section 'FILE CONTENTS'

    $IncludedCount = 0
    $IncludedBytes = 0
    $TotalSkippedForSize = 0

    foreach ($File in $AllFiles) {
        $RelativePath = Get-RelativePathCompat $ProjectRoot $File.FullName

        Write-ProgressMessage ('Inspecting: ' + $RelativePath)

        try {
            $CurrentFile = Get-Item -LiteralPath $File.FullName -ErrorAction Stop

            if ($CurrentFile.Length -gt $MaxFileSizeBytes) {
                $SkippedFiles.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
                    Path = $RelativePath
                    Reason = 'File exceeds per-file limit of ' + $MaxFileSizeBytes + ' bytes'
                }) | Out-Null
                $TotalSkippedForSize++
                continue
            }

            # Avoid reading the generated snapshot or any other file under output.
            if (([System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($CurrentFile.FullName)) -eq $OutputFullPath) {
                continue
            }

            $Bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($CurrentFile.FullName)

            if (Test-IsLikelyBinary -Bytes $Bytes) {
                $SkippedFiles.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
                    Path = $RelativePath
                    Reason = 'Binary content detected'
                }) | Out-Null
                continue
            }

            $Content = Get-TextFromBytes -Bytes $Bytes

            if (Test-LikelySecretContent -Content $Content) {
                $ManualReviewFiles.Add($RelativePath) | Out-Null
                $SkippedFiles.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
                    Path = $RelativePath
                    Reason = 'Possible hardcoded secret; excluded for manual review'
                }) | Out-Null
                continue
            }

            # Enforce the overall output budget before adding each file.
            $FileHeader = @(
                ''
                ('-' * 88)
                ('FILE: ' + $RelativePath)
                ('SIZE: ' + $CurrentFile.Length + ' bytes')
                ('-' * 88)
            ) -join [Environment]::NewLine

            $EstimatedAddition = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetByteCount(
                $FileHeader + [Environment]::NewLine + $Content + [Environment]::NewLine
            )

            $CurrentOutputBytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetByteCount(
                $OutputBuffer.ToString()
            )

            if (($CurrentOutputBytes + $EstimatedAddition) -gt $MaxOutputSizeBytes) {
                $SkippedFiles.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
                    Path = $RelativePath
                    Reason = 'Total output size limit reached'
                }) | Out-Null
                $TotalSkippedForSize++
                continue
            }

            [void]$OutputBuffer.AppendLine($FileHeader)
            [void]$OutputBuffer.AppendLine($Content)
            [void]$OutputBuffer.AppendLine('')

            $IncludedCount++
            $IncludedBytes += $CurrentFile.Length
        }
        catch {
            $ErrorMessage = 'Could not process "' + $RelativePath + '": ' + $_.Exception.Message
            $Errors.Add($ErrorMessage) | Out-Null
            $SkippedFiles.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
                Path = $RelativePath
                Reason = 'Read/processing error'
            }) | Out-Null
            Write-Warning $ErrorMessage
        }
    }

    # ----------------------------- Final report -----------------------------

    Add-Section 'GENERATION REPORT'
    Add-OutputLine ('Generation time: ' + $GeneratedAt.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss zzz'))
    Add-OutputLine ('Project root: ' + $ProjectRoot)
    Add-OutputLine ('Included file count: ' + $IncludedCount)
    Add-OutputLine ('Skipped file count: ' + $SkippedFiles.Count)
    Add-OutputLine ('Included source bytes: ' + $IncludedBytes)
    Add-OutputLine ('Per-file size limit: ' + $MaxFileSizeBytes + ' bytes')
    Add-OutputLine ('Configured total-output limit: ' + $MaxOutputSizeBytes + ' bytes')
    Add-OutputLine ('Files skipped because of size limits: ' + $TotalSkippedForSize)
    Add-OutputLine ('Files requiring manual secret review: ' + $ManualReviewFiles.Count)
    Add-OutputLine ('Processing errors: ' + $Errors.Count)

    if ($ManualReviewFiles.Count -gt 0) {
        Add-OutputLine ''
        Add-OutputLine 'FILES EXCLUDED FOR POSSIBLE SECRETS - REVIEW MANUALLY'
        foreach ($ReviewPath in ($ManualReviewFiles | Sort-Object -Unique)) {
            Add-OutputLine (' - ' + $ReviewPath)
        }
        Add-OutputLine 'These files were not copied into the snapshot.'
    }

    if ($SkippedFiles.Count -gt 0) {
        Add-OutputLine ''
        Add-OutputLine 'SKIPPED FILES'
        foreach ($Skipped in ($SkippedFiles | Sort-Object Path)) {
            Add-OutputLine (' - ' + $Skipped.Path + ' :: ' + $Skipped.Reason)
        }
    }

    if ($Errors.Count -gt 0) {
        Add-OutputLine ''
        Add-OutputLine 'PROCESSING ERRORS'
        foreach ($ErrorEntry in $Errors) {
            Add-OutputLine (' - ' + $ErrorEntry)
        }
    }

    # Write once, replacing the previous snapshot instead of appending.
    $FinalText = $OutputBuffer.ToString()
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($OutputFullPath, $FinalText, $Utf8Output)

    $FinalSize = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $OutputFullPath).Length

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'Context generation complete.' -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ('Output: ' + $OutputFullPath)
    Write-Host ('Included files: ' + $IncludedCount)
    Write-Host ('Skipped files: ' + $SkippedFiles.Count)
    Write-Host ('Files flagged for manual review: ' + $ManualReviewFiles.Count)
    Write-Host ('Final output size: ' + [Math]::Round($FinalSize / 1KB, 2) + ' KB')

    if ($FinalSize -gt $MaxOutputSizeBytes) {
        Write-Warning ('Final snapshot exceeds the configured total-output limit of ' +
            $MaxOutputSizeBytes + ' bytes. Consider lowering the limit or splitting the context.')
    }

    if ($ManualReviewFiles.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Warning 'Some files were excluded because they may contain secrets. Review the report in the snapshot.'
    }

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'Important: manually review the snapshot before uploading it to an AI service.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
catch {
    Write-Error ('Context generation failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
    exit 1
}

# CareerOS

CareerOS is a career-management workspace for applications, companies, contacts, tasks, and scheduled events. It supports browser-local demo data and an optional authenticated, user-scoped PostgreSQL API mode.

## Features

- Responsive overview with data-derived metrics, a compact monthly calendar, upcoming tasks, and recent applications.
- Shared monthly calendar on the Overview and Calendar pages, with local-date-safe navigation, event/task indicators, selected-day details, and create/edit/delete actions.
- Editable Applications, Companies, Contacts, Tasks, and Events with browser-local persistence.
- Light and dark themes, persisted in this browser.
- Explicit demo mode and a user-triggered JSON export from Settings.
- Supabase email authentication and server-verified API access.
- Owner-scoped API CRUD for companies, applications, contacts, tasks, and events, with activity history reads.
- Express health endpoint with database connection status; record routes require authentication.

## Stack

- React 19, strict TypeScript, Vite 7, Tailwind CSS 4, React Router 7
- TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, date-fns, Lucide React
- Node.js, Express 5, Pino HTTP logging
- PostgreSQL, Prisma 7.10, `@prisma/adapter-pg`, and `pg`
- Vitest and Oxlint

## Project layout

```text
backend/
  src/auth/            Supabase verification, internal-user mapping, and provisioning
  src/data/             Authenticated owner-scoped record API
  src/db/              Prisma singleton and read-only connection check
  src/                 Express app, configuration, and server lifecycle
  prisma.config.ts     Prisma 7 CLI configuration
  .env.example         Backend environment template
prisma/
  schema.prisma        PostgreSQL domain schema
  migrations/          Reviewed SQL migrations
src/
  components/          App shell, forms, and reusable monthly calendar
  context/             Demo/API data, auth, and persisted theme providers
  data/                Demo records and tests
  lib/                 Calendar date helpers
  pages/               Overview, directories, tasks, calendar, settings
```

## Local development

Requirements: Node.js 22+ and npm 10+.

```powershell
npm install
npm run dev
```

The frontend runs at `http://localhost:5173`; Express runs at `http://localhost:3001`. The frontend is proxied to the API for `/api` requests. Configure backend settings in `backend/.env`; see [DATABASE_SETUP.md](./DATABASE_SETUP.md) for Supabase and Prisma instructions.

Useful checks:

```powershell
npm test
npm run lint
npm run build
npm run build:api
npm run prisma:validate
npm run prisma:generate
npm run db:check
```

## Data modes and preservation

`VITE_DATA_MODE` defaults to `demo`. In demo mode, editable records are saved to this browser's `localStorage` under `careeros-demo-v1`; existing browser data is retained and can be downloaded from Settings. Nothing is uploaded automatically. There is no import or cloud migration flow yet.

In the profile menu, signed-out users can open **Sign in** or **Create account** even while demo mode is active. To use real Supabase authentication, add the project URL and publishable key as `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` and `VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` in the frontend environment, and as `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` in `backend/.env`. Set `VITE_DATA_MODE=api` to select the authenticated API provider; the default remains `demo`. API mode does not import demo records. Confirmed Supabase identities are mapped to internal users by Supabase UUID; email alone is never used to link accounts. The server verifies each bearer token with `supabase.auth.getUser(token)` and rejects unconfirmed identities. No service-role key is required for token verification.

The frontend calls relative `/api` endpoints. Vite proxies these requests to `http://localhost:3001` in development; production hosting must provide a same-origin `/api` reverse proxy. There is no separate API base URL setting.

## Deployment

- **Vercel:** Keep the project Root Directory at the repository root. Use `npm run build:web` as the build command and `dist` as the output directory. `vercel.json` forwards `/api/*` to Render. The backend lives in `backend/`, not Vercel's reserved root `api/` functions directory.
- **Render:** Update the existing service Root Directory from `api` to `backend` if it was set to the old folder. Use `npm run build` for the build command and `npm run start` for the start command. Keep the existing backend environment variables configured in Render; no database or auth settings need to change.

For local Supabase Auth, set the dashboard Site URL to `http://localhost:5173` and allow redirects to `http://localhost:5173/auth/confirm` and `http://localhost:5173/auth/recovery`. Sign-up requires email confirmation before API access.

## Database architecture

Prisma models users, companies, contacts, job applications, tasks, events, and activity. Related records carry `userId`; composite foreign keys also enforce same-user company/contact/application ownership. User-owned records cascade only when the user is deleted. Deleting a referenced company, contact, or application is restricted until dependent links are removed or reassigned. Dates use PostgreSQL `timestamptz`; IDs use consistent CUIDs.

Events and tasks remain separate records. The shared calendar derives day indicators and selected-day details from both collections; completed tasks are omitted. The schema and reviewed SQL migrations are in `prisma/`. A new additive profile migration, `20261105000000_add_user_profile_fields`, adds personal and professional fields to `User`; it has not been applied. Profile editing in API mode requires approval and application of this migration.

## API and authentication boundary

`GET /api/health` reports API status and database connection state. `POST /api/auth/provision` verifies a confirmed Supabase identity before creating its internal mapping. `GET /api/data` returns the authenticated user's records; `POST /api/data/:kind` and `PATCH`/`DELETE /api/data/:kind/:id` perform owner-scoped operations for the singular kinds `company`, `application`, `contact`, `task`, and `event`. The server derives the owner from the verified internal mapping, checks every related record against that owner, and unlinks optional references transactionally before deleting referenced records. Client-supplied `userId` is never accepted as proof of ownership.

Authenticated profile routes `GET /api/profile` and `PATCH /api/profile` use the same verified internal-user mapping and accept no client-supplied owner ID. They validate profile data server-side and do not expose internal authentication identifiers. Profile avatars use initials because Supabase Storage is not configured.

## Limitations

- Last verified on 2026-10-29: after explicit project-owner approval, both feature migrations were deployed. Read-only status reported all four then-existing migrations applied with no schema difference. The profile migration added afterward has not been applied.
- Live signup/login/email delivery and authenticated user-data CRUD have not been tested end-to-end. Use authorized test accounts before relying on live persistence or cross-user isolation.
- Demo data is not imported into PostgreSQL.
- Supabase environment variable names are configured locally for the frontend and API, but live signup/login/email delivery and user-data CRUD have not been tested. The database schema is current; authenticated CRUD still needs live verification.
- No seed script, automated demo-data importer, calendar sync, or external reminders are implemented.
- Public deployment still requires production auth/project configuration, rate limiting, CORS/secrets review, migration/backup procedures, and API integration tests.
- Profile API persistence and avatar uploads require additional setup: apply the reviewed profile migration to an explicitly approved database; configure Supabase Storage only if avatar upload is later enabled.

import { Suspense, lazy, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { BrowserRouter, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom'
import { AppShell } from './components/AppShell'
import { RequireAuth } from './components/RequireAuth'
import { ErrorBoundary } from './components/ErrorBoundary'
import { DemoCareerDataProvider } from './context/CareerData'
import { AuthProvider } from './context/AuthContext'
import { ApiCareerDataProvider } from './context/ApiCareerData'
import { ThemeProvider } from './context/ThemeProvider'
import { AuthPage } from './pages/AuthPage'
import { getDataMode } from './lib/supabase'

const Dashboard = lazy(() => import('./pages/Dashboard').then((module) => ({ default: module.Dashboard })))
const DirectoryPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/DirectoryPages').then((module) => ({ default: module.DirectoryPage })))
const TasksPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/DirectoryPages').then((module) => ({ default: module.TasksPage })))
const CalendarPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/DirectoryPages').then((module) => ({ default: module.CalendarPage })))
const SettingsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/DirectoryPages').then((module) => ({ default: module.SettingsPage })))
const ProfilePage = lazy(() => import('./pages/ProfilePage').then((module) => ({ default: module.ProfilePage })))
const VaultPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/VaultPage').then((module) => ({ default: module.VaultPage })))

const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: 1, refetchOnWindowFocus: false } },
})

function CareerDataProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return getDataMode() === 'api'
    ? <ApiCareerDataProvider>{children}</ApiCareerDataProvider>
    : <DemoCareerDataProvider>{children}</DemoCareerDataProvider>
}

function NotFoundPage() {
  return <section className="directory-empty not-found"><span>404</span><h1>Page not found</h1><p>This page doesn’t exist in your CareerOS workspace.</p><a className="button button-secondary" href="/">Back to overview</a></section>
}

export default function App() {
  return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
    <ThemeProvider>
      <AuthProvider>
        <CareerDataProvider>
          <BrowserRouter>
            <ErrorBoundary>
              <Suspense fallback={<div className="route-loading">Opening your workspace…</div>}>
                <Routes>
                  <Route path="/auth/login" element={<AuthPage page="login" />} />
                  <Route path="/auth/signup" element={<AuthPage page="signup" />} />
                  <Route path="/auth/forgot-password" element={<AuthPage page="forgot-password" />} />
                  <Route path="/auth/recovery" element={<AuthPage page="recovery" />} />
                  <Route path="/auth/confirm" element={<AuthPage page="confirm" />} />
                  <Route element={<RequireAuth><AppShell /></RequireAuth>}>
                    <Route index element={<Dashboard />} />
                    <Route path="applications" element={<DirectoryPage />} />
                    <Route path="companies" element={<DirectoryPage />} />
                    <Route path="contacts" element={<DirectoryPage />} />
                    <Route path="tasks" element={<TasksPage />} />
                    <Route path="calendar" element={<CalendarPage />} />
                    <Route path="settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />
                    <Route path="profile" element={<ProfilePage />} />
                    <Route path="vault" element={<VaultPage />} />
                    <Route path="vault/:tab" element={<VaultPage />} />
                    <Route path="*" element={<NotFoundPage />} />
                  </Route>
                </Routes>
              </Suspense>
            </ErrorBoundary>
          </BrowserRouter>
        </CareerDataProvider>
      </AuthProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
  </QueryClientProvider>
}

  const [isSubmittingAttach, setIsSubmittingAttach] = useState(false)

  // Upload New State
  const [uploadFile, setUploadFile] = useState<File | null>(null)
  const [uploadDisplayName, setUploadDisplayName] = useState('')
  const [uploadRole, setUploadRole] = useState<DocumentRole>('SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT')
  const [isSubmittingUpload, setIsSubmittingUpload] = useState(false)
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState('')

  const loadDocs = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      const data = await vaultApi.getApplicationDocuments(applicationId, token)
      setDocuments(data)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load application documents', err)
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const loadVaultFiles = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await vaultApi.getFiles({ token })
      setAllVaultFiles(res.files || [])
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load vault files', err)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDocs()
    loadVaultFiles()
  }, [applicationId, token])

  const handleAttachExisting = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!selectedVaultFileId) return

    setIsSubmittingAttach(true)
    try {
      await vaultApi.linkApplicationDocument(
        applicationId,
        {
          vaultFileId: selectedVaultFileId,
          documentRole: attachRole,
          notes: attachNotes.trim() || null,
        },
        token
      )
      await loadDocs()
      setIsAttaching(false)
      setSelectedVaultFileId('')
      setAttachNotes('')
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to attach document')
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingAttach(false)
    }
  }

  const handleUploadAndAttach = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!uploadFile) return

    setIsSubmittingUpload(true)
    setUploadError('')

    try {
      // 1. Upload to Vault
      const categoryMap: Record<DocumentRole, any> = {
        SUBMITTED_RESUME: 'RESUME',
        COVER_LETTER: 'COVER_LETTER',
        JOB_DESCRIPTION: 'JOB_DESCRIPTION',
        PORTFOLIO: 'PORTFOLIO',
        CERTIFICATE: 'CERTIFICATE',
        SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT: 'SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT',
        OTHER: 'OTHER',
      }

      const file = await vaultApi.uploadFile(uploadFile, {
        displayName: uploadDisplayName.trim() || uploadFile.name,
        category: categoryMap[uploadRole] || 'SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT',
        applicationId,
        token,
      })

      // 2. Link specifically to application documents table
      await vaultApi.linkApplicationDocument(
        applicationId,
        {
          vaultFileId: file.id,
          documentRole: uploadRole,
        },
        token
      )

      await loadDocs()
      setIsUploading(false)
      setUploadFile(null)
      setUploadDisplayName('')
    } catch (err: any) {
      setUploadError(err.message || 'Failed to upload document')
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingUpload(false)
    }
  }

  const handleDetachDoc = async (documentId: string) => {
    const ok = window.confirm('Unlink this document from the application? The file will remain in your Career Vault.')
    if (!ok) return
    try {
      await vaultApi.unlinkApplicationDocument(applicationId, documentId, token)
      setDocuments((prev) => prev.filter((d) => d.id !== documentId))
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to unlink document')
    }
  }

  const roleBadge = (role: string) => {
    const clean = role.replace(/_/g, ' ')
    return (
      <span
        style={{
          display: 'inline-block',
          fontSize: '10px',
          fontWeight: 600,
          textTransform: 'uppercase',
          letterSpacing: '0.04em',
          padding: '2px 6px',
          borderRadius: '4px',
          background: 'var(--surface-muted)',
          color: 'var(--ink)',
          border: '1px solid var(--line)',
        }}
      >
        {clean}
      </span>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="application-documents-tab" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '16px' }}>
      {/* Historical Resume Banner */}
      {resumeReference && (
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            padding: '10px 14px',
            background: 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.08)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25)',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            fontSize: '12px',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
            <FileBadge size={16} style={{ color: '#4f46e5' }} />
            <span>
              Submitted Resume Snapshot: <strong>{resumeReference}</strong>
            </span>
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Immutable historical record</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header with actions */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <div>
          <h4 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--ink)' }}>
            Application Documents ({documents.length})
          </h4>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
            Files connected to {jobTitle}. Stored once in Vault and referenced here.
          </span>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px' }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-secondary"
            style={{ height: '30px', fontSize: '12px' }}
            onClick={() => setIsAttaching(true)}
          >
            <Paperclip size={13} /> Attach Vault File
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-primary"
            style={{ height: '30px', fontSize: '12px' }}
            onClick={() => setIsUploading(true)}
          >
            <UploadCloud size={13} /> Upload New
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Documents List */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div style={{ padding: '24px', textAlign: 'center', fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
          Loading documents...
        </div>
      ) : documents.length > 0 ? (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '8px' }}>
          {documents.map((doc) => {
            const file = doc.vaultFile
            return (
              <div
                key={doc.id}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  padding: '10px 14px',
                  border: '1px solid var(--line)',
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  background: 'var(--surface)',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px' }}>
                  <FileText size={18} style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }} />
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                      <strong style={{ fontSize: '13px', color: 'var(--ink)' }}>
                        {file?.displayName || 'Document'}
                      </strong>
                      {roleBadge(doc.documentRole || 'SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT')}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                      {file?.originalFilename} {file?.fileSizeBytes && `• ${(file.fileSizeBytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                  {file && (
                    <>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="row-action-button"
                        title="Preview Document"
                        onClick={() => setActivePreviewFile(file)}
                      >
                        <Eye size={14} />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="row-action-button"
                        title="Download Document"
                        onClick={() =>
                          vaultApi.downloadFile(file.id, file.originalFilename || file.displayName, token)
                        }
                      >
                        <Download size={14} />
                      </button>
                    </>
                  )}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="row-delete-button"
                    title="Unlink Document (File remains in Vault)"
                    onClick={() => handleDetachDoc(doc.id)}
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={14} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '32px 16px',
            textAlign: 'center',
            background: 'var(--surface-muted)',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            border: '1px dashed var(--line)',
          }}
        >
          <FileText size={28} style={{ color: 'var(--subtle)', margin: '0 auto 8px' }} />
          <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '13px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
            No documents linked to this application yet.
          </p>
          <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 12px', fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
            Attach your submitted resume version, tailored cover letter, or portfolio.
          </p>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-secondary"
            style={{ fontSize: '12px' }}
            onClick={() => setIsAttaching(true)}
          >
            <Paperclip size={13} /> Attach from Vault
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Attach Existing Modal */}
      {isAttaching && (
        <div className="vault-modal-scrim" onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && setIsAttaching(false)}>
          <div className="vault-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
            <div className="vault-modal-header">
              <h2>Attach Existing Vault File</h2>
              <button type="button" className="row-action-button" onClick={() => setIsAttaching(false)}>
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleAttachExisting} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <div className="vault-modal-body">
                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label">Select Vault Document *</label>
                  <select
                    className="vault-select-full"
                    required
                    value={selectedVaultFileId}
                    onChange={(e) => setSelectedVaultFileId(e.target.value)}
                  >
                    <option value="">-- Choose a document from your Vault --</option>
                    {allVaultFiles
                      .filter((f) => f.status === 'ACTIVE')
                      .map((f) => (
                        <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                          {f.displayName} ({f.category})
                        </option>
                      ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label">Document Role *</label>
                  <select
                    className="vault-select-full"
                    value={attachRole}
                    onChange={(e) => setAttachRole(e.target.value as DocumentRole)}
                  >
                    <option value="SUBMITTED_RESUME">Submitted Resume</option>
                    <option value="COVER_LETTER">Cover Letter</option>
                    <option value="JOB_DESCRIPTION">Job Description</option>
                    <option value="PORTFOLIO">Portfolio</option>
                    <option value="CERTIFICATE">Certificate</option>
                    <option value="SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT">Supporting Document</option>
                    <option value="OTHER">Other</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label">Notes (Optional)</label>
                  <input
                    className="vault-input"
                    placeholder="e.g. Tailored specifically for this engineering role"
                    value={attachNotes}
                    onChange={(e) => setAttachNotes(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="vault-modal-footer">
                <button type="button" className="button button-secondary" onClick={() => setIsAttaching(false)}>
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="button button-primary"
                  disabled={isSubmittingAttach || !selectedVaultFileId}
                >
                  {isSubmittingAttach ? 'Attaching…' : 'Attach to Application'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Upload and Attach Modal */}
      {isUploading && (
        <div className="vault-modal-scrim" onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && setIsUploading(false)}>
          <div className="vault-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
            <div className="vault-modal-header">
              <h2>Upload Document for {jobTitle}</h2>
              <button type="button" className="row-action-button" onClick={() => setIsUploading(false)}>
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleUploadAndAttach} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <div className="vault-modal-body">
                {uploadError && (
                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: '8px',
                      padding: '10px 14px',
                      borderRadius: '8px',
                      background: '#fef2f2',
                      color: '#b91c1c',
                      fontSize: '12px',
                    }}
                  >
                    <AlertCircle size={15} />
                    <span>{uploadError}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label">Select File *</label>
                  <input
                    className="vault-input"
                    type="file"
                    required
                    accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.txt,.png,.jpg,.jpeg"
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const f = e.target.files?.[0] || null
                      setUploadFile(f)
                      if (f && !uploadDisplayName) {
                        setUploadDisplayName(f.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '').replace(/_/g, ' '))
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label">Display Name</label>
                  <input
                    className="vault-input"
                    value={uploadDisplayName}
                    placeholder="e.g. Customized Cover Letter - SDE"
                    onChange={(e) => setUploadDisplayName(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label">Document Role *</label>
                  <select
                    className="vault-select-full"
                    value={uploadRole}
                    onChange={(e) => setUploadRole(e.target.value as DocumentRole)}
                  >
                    <option value="SUBMITTED_RESUME">Submitted Resume</option>
                    <option value="COVER_LETTER">Cover Letter</option>
                    <option value="JOB_DESCRIPTION">Job Description</option>
                    <option value="PORTFOLIO">Portfolio</option>
                    <option value="CERTIFICATE">Certificate</option>
                    <option value="SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT">Supporting Document</option>
                    <option value="OTHER">Other</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="vault-modal-footer">
                <button type="button" className="button button-secondary" onClick={() => setIsUploading(false)}>
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button type="submit" className="button button-primary" disabled={isSubmittingUpload || !uploadFile}>
                  {isSubmittingUpload ? 'Uploading…' : 'Upload & Attach'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Preview Modal */}
      {activePreviewFile && (
        <VaultFileDetailModal
          file={activePreviewFile}
          onClose={() => setActivePreviewFile(null)}
          onUpdate={(u: VaultFile) => setActivePreviewFile(u)}
          onDelete={() => {
            setActivePreviewFile(null)
            loadDocs()
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { Sparkles, CheckCircle2, ListTodo, Plus, Award } from 'lucide-react'
import { intelligenceApi } from '../lib/intelligenceApi'
import type { ResumeMatchScore, PreparationTaskSuggestion } from '../lib/intelligence/types'
import { useCareerData } from '../context/useCareerData'

interface ApplicationIntelligenceSectionProps {
  applicationId: string
  currentResumeVersionId?: string
  onSelectResumeVersion?: (versionId: string) => void
}

export function ApplicationIntelligenceSection({
  applicationId,
  currentResumeVersionId,
  onSelectResumeVersion,
}: ApplicationIntelligenceSectionProps) {
  const { addRecord } = useCareerData()
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'resume' | 'prep'>('resume')

  // Resume matches state
  const [matches, setMatches] = useState<ResumeMatchScore[]>([])
  const [loadingMatches, setLoadingMatches] = useState(false)
  const [matchError, setMatchError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Prep checklist state
  const [prepTasks, setPrepTasks] = useState<PreparationTaskSuggestion[]>([])
  const [loadingPrep, setLoadingPrep] = useState(false)
  const [prepError, setPrepError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [createdTasksCount, setCreatedTasksCount] = useState<number | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!applicationId) return
    loadResumeMatches()
  }, [applicationId])

  const loadResumeMatches = async () => {
    setLoadingMatches(true)
    setMatchError(null)
    try {
      const data = await intelligenceApi.getResumeMatches(applicationId)
      setMatches(data)
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMatchError(err.message || 'Failed to load resume match suggestions.')
    } finally {
      setLoadingMatches(false)
    }
  }

  const handleGeneratePrep = async () => {
    setLoadingPrep(true)
    setPrepError(null)
    setCreatedTasksCount(null)
    try {
      const tasks = await intelligenceApi.generatePreparationTasks(applicationId)
      setPrepTasks(tasks)
    } catch (err: any) {
      setPrepError(err.message || 'Failed to generate interview preparation tasks.')
    } finally {
      setLoadingPrep(false)
    }
  }

  const handleToggleTaskSelection = (taskId: string) => {
    setPrepTasks(
      prepTasks.map((t) => (t.id === taskId ? { ...t, selected: !t.selected } : t))
    )
  }

  const handleCreateSelectedTasks = async () => {
    const selected = prepTasks.filter((t) => t.selected !== false)
    if (selected.length === 0) return

    setLoadingPrep(true)
    try {
      // Create via intelligenceApi or local addRecord
      await intelligenceApi.createPreparationTasks(
        applicationId,
        selected.map((t) => ({
          title: t.title,
          description: t.description,
          priority: t.priority,
          category: t.category,
        }))
      )

      // Also sync to active careerData store for live UI updates
      for (const t of selected) {
        addRecord('task', {
          title: t.title,
          description: t.description,
          priority: t.priority,
          category: t.category,
          applicationId,
          done: 'false',
        })
      }

      setCreatedTasksCount(selected.length)
      setPrepTasks([])
    } catch (err: any) {
      setPrepError(err.message || 'Failed to create preparation tasks.')
    } finally {
      setLoadingPrep(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        border: '1px solid var(--line)',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        background: 'var(--surface)',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        marginTop: '16px',
      }}
    >
      {/* Sub Tabs */}
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          borderBottom: '1px solid var(--line)',
          background: 'var(--surface-muted)',
        }}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('resume')}
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            padding: '10px',
            fontSize: '12px',
            fontWeight: 500,
            border: 'none',
            background: activeTab === 'resume' ? 'var(--surface)' : 'transparent',
            color: activeTab === 'resume' ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            borderBottom: activeTab === 'resume' ? '2px solid var(--accent)' : 'none',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            gap: '6px',
          }}
        >
          <Award size={14} /> Resume Recommendations
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('prep')}
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            padding: '10px',
            fontSize: '12px',
            fontWeight: 500,
            border: 'none',
            background: activeTab === 'prep' ? 'var(--surface)' : 'transparent',
            color: activeTab === 'prep' ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            borderBottom: activeTab === 'prep' ? '2px solid var(--accent)' : 'none',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            gap: '6px',
          }}
        >
          <ListTodo size={14} /> Interview Preparation
        </button>
      </div>

      <div style={{ padding: '14px' }}>
        {/* Tab 1: Resume Recommendations */}
        {activeTab === 'resume' && (
          <div>
            {loadingMatches ? (
              <div style={{ padding: '20px', textAlign: 'center', fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                Calculating deterministic skill coverage and role alignment...
              </div>
            ) : matchError ? (
              <div style={{ padding: '10px', color: '#b91c1c', fontSize: '12px' }}>{matchError}</div>
            ) : matches.length === 0 ? (
              <div style={{ padding: '14px', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: '12px' }}>
                No active resumes found in Vault to evaluate against this role.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '10px' }}>
                {matches.map((m) => {
                  const isCurrent = currentResumeVersionId === m.resumeVersionId
                  const badgeColor =
                    m.relevanceTier === 'High' ? '#16a34a' : m.relevanceTier === 'Medium' ? '#d97706' : '#6b7280'

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={m.resumeVersionId}
                      style={{
                        padding: '12px',
                        border: isCurrent ? '1.5px solid var(--accent)' : '1px solid var(--line)',
                        borderRadius: '6px',
                        background: isCurrent ? 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.04)' : 'var(--surface)',
                        display: 'flex',
                        flexDirection: 'column',
                        gap: '8px',
                      }}
                    >
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                        <div>
                          <strong style={{ fontSize: '13px', color: 'var(--ink)' }}>{m.resumeLabel}</strong>
                          {m.targetRole && (
                            <span style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)', marginLeft: '8px' }}>
                              ({m.targetRole})
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                          <span
                            style={{
                              padding: '2px 8px',
                              borderRadius: '12px',
                              fontSize: '11px',
                              fontWeight: 600,
                              background: `${badgeColor}15`,
                              color: badgeColor,
                            }}
                          >
                            {m.score}% Match ({m.relevanceTier})
                          </span>

                          {onSelectResumeVersion && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              className={isCurrent ? 'button button-secondary' : 'button button-primary'}
                              style={{ fontSize: '11px', height: '26px', padding: '0 8px' }}
                              onClick={() => onSelectResumeVersion(m.resumeVersionId)}
                              disabled={isCurrent}
                            >
                              {isCurrent ? 'Attached' : 'Attach Version'}
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{m.explanation}</p>

                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '4px' }}>
                        {m.matchedSkills.map((s) => (
                          <span
                            key={s}
                            style={{
                              fontSize: '10px',
                              padding: '2px 6px',
                              borderRadius: '4px',
                              background: '#dcfce7',
                              color: '#15803d',
                              fontWeight: 500,
                            }}
                          >
                            ✓ {s}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                        {m.missingRequiredSkills.map((s) => (
                          <span
                            key={s}
                            style={{
                              fontSize: '10px',
                              padding: '2px 6px',
                              borderRadius: '4px',
                              background: '#fee2e2',
                              color: '#b91c1c',
                            }}
                          >
                            ✕ {s}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tab 2: Interview Preparation */}
        {activeTab === 'prep' && (
          <div>
            {createdTasksCount !== null && (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: '8px',
                  padding: '8px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  background: '#dcfce7',
                  color: '#15803d',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  marginBottom: '12px',
                }}
              >
                <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
                <span>Successfully added {createdTasksCount} interview preparation tasks to your Tasks workspace!</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {prepError && (
              <div style={{ padding: '8px', color: '#b91c1c', fontSize: '12px', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                {prepError}
              </div>
            )}

            {prepTasks.length === 0 ? (
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '16px' }}>
                <p style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--muted)', margin: '0 0 12px 0' }}>
                  Generate a deterministic preparation checklist customized to the skills and technical topics required for this job.
                </p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="button button-primary"
                  onClick={handleGeneratePrep}
                  disabled={loadingPrep}
                  style={{ fontSize: '12px' }}
                >
                  <Sparkles size={14} />
                  {loadingPrep ? 'Analyzing Requirements...' : 'Generate Preparation Checklist'}
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '10px' }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                    Select preparation topics to add to your workspace tasks:
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="button button-primary"
                    style={{ fontSize: '11px', height: '28px' }}
                    onClick={handleCreateSelectedTasks}
                    disabled={loadingPrep}
                  >
                    <Plus size={14} /> Add Selected Tasks
                  </button>
                </div>

                {prepTasks.map((task) => (
                  <div
                    key={task.id}
                    style={{
                      padding: '10px',
                      border: '1px solid var(--line)',
                      borderRadius: '6px',
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'flex-start',
                      gap: '10px',
                    }}
                  >
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={task.selected !== false}
                      onChange={() => handleToggleTaskSelection(task.id)}
                      style={{ marginTop: '3px' }}
                    />
                    <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--ink)' }}>{task.title}</strong>
                        <span
                          style={{
                            fontSize: '10px',
                            padding: '1px 6px',
                            borderRadius: '4px',
                            background: 'var(--surface-muted)',
                            color: 'var(--muted)',
                          }}
                        >
                          {task.category}
                        </span>
                        <span
                          style={{
                            fontSize: '10px',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            color: task.priority === 'High' ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)',
                          }}
                        >
                          {task.priority} Priority
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: '4px', whiteSpace: 'pre-line' }}>
                        {task.subtopics.map((st) => `• ${st}`).join('   ')}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { MemoryRouter, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom'
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { DemoCareerDataProvider } from '../context/CareerData'
import { CareerDataContext, type CareerDataContextValue } from '../context/careerDataContext'
import { AuthContext, type AuthContextValue } from '../context/auth-context'
import { ThemeProvider } from '../context/ThemeProvider'
import { demoData } from '../data/demo'
import { AppShell } from './AppShell'

afterEach(cleanup)

function renderShell(auth: AuthContextValue, dataError?: string) {
  const content = (
    <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/']}>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/auth/login" element={<p>Signed-out screen</p>} />
        <Route path="/profile" element={<p>Profile screen</p>} />
        <Route path="/" element={<AppShell />}>
          <Route index element={<p>Workspace contents</p>} />
        </Route>
      </Routes>
    </MemoryRouter>
  )
  const failedData: CareerDataContextValue = {
    data: demoData,
    dataLoading: false,
    dataError: dataError ?? '',
    dataRetryLabel: 'Try again',
    retryDataLoad: vi.fn(),
    addRecord: vi.fn(),
    updateRecord: vi.fn(),
    deleteRecord: vi.fn(),
    toggleTask: vi.fn(),
  }
  return render(
    <AuthContext.Provider value={auth}>
      <ThemeProvider>
        {dataError
          ? <CareerDataContext.Provider value={failedData}>{content}</CareerDataContext.Provider>
          : <DemoCareerDataProvider>{content}</DemoCareerDataProvider>}
      </ThemeProvider>
    </AuthContext.Provider>,
  )
}

function authValue(overrides: Partial<AuthContextValue> = {}): AuthContextValue {
  return {
    session: null,
    user: null,
    loading: false,
    provisioning: false,
    authError: '',
    provisioningError: '',
    dataMode: 'demo',
    signUp: vi.fn(),
    signIn: vi.fn(),
    requestPasswordReset: vi.fn(),
    updatePassword: vi.fn(),
    updateDisplayName: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    signOut: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    retryProvisioning: vi.fn(),
    ...overrides,
  }
}

describe('AppShell authentication menu', () => {
  it('offers sign-in and account creation when signed out in demo mode', () => {
    renderShell(authValue())
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open profile menu' }))
    expect(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Sign in' })).toBeTruthy()
    expect(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Create account' })).toBeTruthy()
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Browser-local demo').length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  })

  it('shows the signed-in user and signs out to the signed-out screen', async () => {
    const signOut = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    renderShell(authValue({
      session: { user: { id: 'auth-user-1' } } as NonNullable<AuthContextValue['session']>,
      user: { id: 'auth-user-1', name: 'Taylor Example', email: 'taylor@example.test' },
      signOut,
    }))

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open profile menu' }))
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Taylor Example').length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    expect(screen.getAllByText('taylor@example.test').length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Sign out' }))
    expect(await screen.findByText('Signed-out screen')).toBeTruthy()
    expect(signOut).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
  })

  it('replaces workspace content with a clear error instead of showing stale metrics', () => {
    renderShell(authValue(), 'The database schema needs an update.')
    expect(screen.getByRole('alert').textContent).toContain('The database schema needs an update.')
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Try again' })).toBeTruthy()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Workspace contents')).toBeNull()
  })

  it('toggles the profile menu, dismisses with Escape and keeps menus mutually exclusive', () => {
    renderShell(authValue())
    const profileTrigger = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open profile menu' })
    fireEvent.click(profileTrigger)
    expect(screen.getByRole('menu')).toBeTruthy()
    fireEvent.click(profileTrigger)
    expect(screen.queryByRole('menu')).toBeNull()

    fireEvent.click(profileTrigger)
    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'Escape' })
    expect(screen.queryByRole('menu')).toBeNull()

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add new' }))
    expect(screen.getByRole('menu')).toBeTruthy()
    fireEvent.click(profileTrigger)
    expect(screen.getAllByRole('menu')).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'View profile' })).toBeTruthy()
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'View profile' }))
    expect(screen.getByText('Profile screen')).toBeTruthy()
  })

  it('closes menus when clicking outside and retains a persisted sidebar toggle', () => {
    localStorage.clear()
    const firstRender = renderShell(authValue())
    const collapse = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Collapse sidebar' })
    fireEvent.click(collapse)
    expect(localStorage.getItem('careeros-sidebar-collapsed-v1')).toBe('true')
    firstRender.unmount()
    const restoredRender = renderShell(authValue())
    expect(restoredRender.container.querySelector('.app-shell')?.classList.contains('sidebar-collapsed')).toBe(true)

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Notifications' }))
    expect(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Notifications' })).toBeTruthy()
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Notifications' }))
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Notifications' })).toBeNull()
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Notifications' }))
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open sidebar profile menu' }))
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Notifications' })).toBeNull()
    expect(screen.getAllByRole('menu')).toHaveLength(1)
    fireEvent.pointerDown(document.body)
    expect(screen.queryByRole('menu')).toBeNull()
  })
})
