import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type MouseEvent } from 'react'
import { Link, NavLink, Outlet, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import {
  Bell, BriefcaseBusiness, Building2, CalendarDays, CheckSquare, ChevronDown, ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight, CircleHelp, FolderArchive, LayoutDashboard, LogOut, Moon, Plus, Search, Settings, Sun, Users, X,
  FileText, UploadCloud,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { getCompanyName } from '../data/demo'
import { useCareerData } from '../context/useCareerData'
import { useAuth } from '../context/auth-context'
import { useTheme } from '../context/useTheme'
import type { RecordType } from '../types'
import { RecordDialog } from './RecordDialog'
import { VaultUploadDialog } from './vault/VaultUploadDialog'

const navigation = [
  { label: 'Overview', to: '/', icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { label: 'Applications', to: '/applications', icon: BriefcaseBusiness },
  { label: 'Companies', to: '/companies', icon: Building2 },
  { label: 'Contacts', to: '/contacts', icon: Users },
  { label: 'Tasks', to: '/tasks', icon: CheckSquare },
  { label: 'Calendar', to: '/calendar', icon: CalendarDays },
  { label: 'Vault', to: '/vault', icon: FolderArchive },
]

const addOptions: { type: RecordType; label: string; icon: typeof BriefcaseBusiness }[] = [
  { type: 'application', label: 'Application', icon: BriefcaseBusiness },
  { type: 'company', label: 'Company', icon: Building2 },
  { type: 'contact', label: 'Contact', icon: Users },
  { type: 'task', label: 'Task', icon: CheckSquare },
  { type: 'event', label: 'Event', icon: CalendarDays },
]

const pathTitles: Record<string, string> = {
  '/': 'Overview',
  '/applications': 'Applications',
  '/companies': 'Companies',
  '/contacts': 'Contacts',
  '/tasks': 'Tasks & follow-ups',
  '/calendar': 'Calendar',
  '/settings': 'Settings',
  '/profile': 'My profile',
  '/vault': 'Career Vault',
  '/vault/resumes': 'Resume Vault',
  '/vault/jobs': 'Job Descriptions',
  '/vault/all': 'All Documents',
  '/vault/trash': 'Vault Trash',
}

type Dropdown = 'profile-top' | 'profile-sidebar' | 'notifications' | 'quick-add' | null
const sidebarStorageKey = 'careeros-sidebar-collapsed-v1'

function readSidebarPreference() {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(sidebarStorageKey) === 'true'
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('CareerOS could not read the saved sidebar preference.', error)
    return false
  }
}

function profileName(auth: ReturnType<typeof useAuth>) {
  const metadataName = auth.session?.user.user_metadata?.full_name
  if (typeof metadataName === 'string' && metadataName.trim()) return metadataName.trim()
  if (auth.user?.name.trim()) return auth.user.name.trim()
  const emailName = auth.user?.email.split('@')[0] ?? auth.session?.user.email?.split('@')[0]
  return emailName || 'CareerOS member'
}

function initialsFor(name: string) {
  return name.split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? '').join('')
}

export function AppShell() {
  const { data, dataLoading, dataError, dataRetryLabel, retryDataLoad } = useCareerData()
  const auth = useAuth()
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme()
  const location = useLocation()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  const [addType, setAddType] = useState<RecordType | null>(null)
  const [isQuickUploadOpen, setIsQuickUploadOpen] = useState(false)
  const [dropdown, setDropdown] = useState<Dropdown>(null)
  const [sidebarOpen, setSidebarOpen] = useState(false)
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(readSidebarPreference)
  const [signOutError, setSignOutError] = useState('')
  const [addInitialDate, setAddInitialDate] = useState<Date | undefined>()
  const profileHasUnsavedChanges = useRef(false)
  const setProfileUnsavedChanges = useCallback((hasChanges: boolean) => {
    profileHasUnsavedChanges.current = hasChanges
  }, [])
  const searchInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const menuName = profileName(auth)
  const email = auth.user?.email ?? auth.session?.user.email ?? 'Browser-local demo'
  const initials = initialsFor(menuName)
  const title = pathTitles[location.pathname] ?? 'CareerOS'
  const query = search.trim().toLowerCase()

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(sidebarStorageKey, String(sidebarCollapsed))
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('CareerOS could not save the sidebar preference.', error)
    }
  }, [sidebarCollapsed])

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setDropdown(null)
        setSidebarOpen(false)
      }
      if ((event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        event.preventDefault()
        searchInputRef.current?.focus()
      }
    }
    const handlePointerDown = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      if (event.target instanceof Element && !event.target.closest('[data-app-menu]')) setDropdown(null)
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', handlePointerDown)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', handlePointerDown)
    }
  }, [])

  const results = useMemo(() => {
    if (query.length < 2) return []
    const matches = [
      ...data.companies.filter((item) => item.name.toLowerCase().includes(query)).map((item) => ({ label: item.name, detail: 'Company', path: '/companies' })),
      ...data.contacts.filter((item) => item.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || getCompanyName(data, item.companyId).toLowerCase().includes(query)).map((item) => ({ label: item.name, detail: `Contact · ${getCompanyName(data, item.companyId)}`, path: '/contacts' })),
      ...data.applications.filter((item) => item.jobTitle.toLowerCase().includes(query) || getCompanyName(data, item.companyId).toLowerCase().includes(query)).map((item) => ({ label: item.jobTitle, detail: `Application · ${getCompanyName(data, item.companyId)}`, path: '/applications' })),
    ]
    return matches.slice(0, 6)
  }, [data, query])

  const toggleDropdown = (next: Exclude<Dropdown, null>) => {
    setDropdown((current) => current === next ? null : next)
  }
  const mayLeaveProfile = () => !profileHasUnsavedChanges.current
    || window.confirm('You have unsaved profile changes. Leave this page and discard them?')
  const navigateSafely = (path: string) => {
    if (!mayLeaveProfile()) return false
    navigate(path)
    return true
  }
  const handleNavigationClick = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
    if (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return
    if (!mayLeaveProfile()) event.preventDefault()
    else closeNavigation()
  }
  const goToSearch = (path: string) => {
    if (!navigateSafely(`${path}?q=${encodeURIComponent(search.trim())}`)) return
    setSearch('')
  }
  const openAdd = (type: RecordType, initialDate?: Date) => {
    setAddInitialDate(initialDate)
    setAddType(type)
    setDropdown(null)
  }
  const signOut = async () => {
    if (!mayLeaveProfile()) return
    setSignOutError('')
    try {
      await auth.signOut()
      setDropdown(null)
      navigate('/auth/login', { replace: true })
    } catch (error) {
      setSignOutError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not sign out. Please try again.')
    }
  }
  const closeNavigation = () => setSidebarOpen(false)

  return (
    <div className={`app-shell ${sidebarCollapsed ? 'sidebar-collapsed' : ''}`}>
      {sidebarOpen && <button className="mobile-scrim" aria-label="Close navigation" onClick={closeNavigation} />}
      <aside className={`sidebar ${sidebarOpen ? 'sidebar-open' : ''}`}>
        <div className="brand-row">
          <Link className="brand-home" to="/" aria-label="CareerOS overview" onClick={closeNavigation}>
            <span className="brand-mark">c</span><span className="brand-name">CareerOS</span>
          </Link>
          <button className="sidebar-collapse icon-button" aria-label={sidebarCollapsed ? 'Expand sidebar' : 'Collapse sidebar'} title={sidebarCollapsed ? 'Expand sidebar' : 'Collapse sidebar'} onClick={() => setSidebarCollapsed((collapsed) => !collapsed)}>
            {sidebarCollapsed ? <ChevronRight size={16} /> : <ChevronLeft size={16} />}
          </button>
          <button className="mobile-close icon-button" aria-label="Close navigation" onClick={closeNavigation}><X size={17} /></button>
        </div>
        <div className="workspace-switcher">
          <span className="workspace-avatar">{auth.dataMode === 'demo' ? 'D' : initials.slice(0, 1)}</span>
          <span className="workspace-copy"><strong>{auth.dataMode === 'demo' ? 'Demo workspace' : 'Personal workspace'}</strong><small>{auth.dataMode === 'demo' ? 'Saved in this browser' : 'Private workspace'}</small></span>
        </div>
        <div className="sidebar-navigation">
          <div className="sidebar-section-label">Workspace</div>
          <nav className="primary-nav" aria-label="Main navigation">
            {navigation.map(({ label, to, icon: Icon }) => (
              <NavLink key={to} to={to} end={to === '/'} title={label} aria-label={label} onClick={handleNavigationClick} className={({ isActive }) => `nav-link ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}`}>
                <Icon size={18} strokeWidth={1.8} /><span>{label}</span>
                {label === 'Tasks' && data.tasks.filter((task) => !task.done).length > 0 && <span className="nav-count">{data.tasks.filter((task) => !task.done).length}</span>}
              </NavLink>
            ))}
          </nav>
        </div>
        <div className="sidebar-bottom">
          <div className="sidebar-user-row">
            <div className="sidebar-profile-wrap" data-app-menu>
              <button className="user-card" aria-label="Open sidebar profile menu" aria-expanded={dropdown === 'profile-sidebar'} aria-haspopup="menu" onClick={() => toggleDropdown('profile-sidebar')}>
                <span className="user-avatar">{initials}</span>
                <span className="user-copy"><strong>{menuName}</strong><small>{email}</small></span>
                <ChevronDown size={15} />
              </button>
              {dropdown === 'profile-sidebar' && <ProfileMenu
                name={menuName}
                email={email}
                loading={auth.loading}
                hasSession={Boolean(auth.session)}
                signOutError={signOutError}
                onNavigate={(path) => { if (navigateSafely(path)) { setDropdown(null); closeNavigation() } }}
                onSignOut={() => { void signOut() }}
              />}
            </div>
            <Link className="sidebar-settings icon-button" to="/settings" aria-label="Settings" title="Settings" onClick={handleNavigationClick}><Settings size={17} /></Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>

      <main className="main-panel">
        <header className="topbar">
          <div className="topbar-left">
            <button className="mobile-menu icon-button" aria-label="Open navigation" aria-expanded={sidebarOpen} onClick={() => setSidebarOpen(true)}><span className="mobile-menu-lines" /></button>
            <span className="breadcrumb-muted">Workspace</span><span className="breadcrumb-slash">/</span><span className="breadcrumb-current">{title}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="topbar-actions">
            <div className="global-search">
              <Search size={16} />
              <input ref={searchInputRef} value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter' && search.trim()) goToSearch(results[0]?.path ?? '/applications') }} placeholder="Search anything..." aria-label="Search companies, contacts, applications" />
              <kbd>⌘ K</kbd>
              {query.length >= 2 && <div className="search-results">
                {results.length ? results.map((result) => <button key={`${result.detail}-${result.label}`} onClick={() => goToSearch(result.path)}><Search size={14} /><span><strong>{result.label}</strong><small>{result.detail}</small></span></button>) : <p>No matches found</p>}
              </div>}
            </div>
            <div className="quick-add-wrap" data-app-menu>
              <button className="button button-primary quick-add-button" aria-expanded={dropdown === 'quick-add'} aria-haspopup="menu" onClick={() => toggleDropdown('quick-add')}><Plus size={16} /> <span>Add new</span></button>
              {dropdown === 'quick-add' && (
                <div className="quick-add-menu" role="menu">
                  {addOptions.map(({ type, label, icon: Icon }) => (
                    <button role="menuitem" key={type} onClick={() => openAdd(type)}>
                      <Icon size={16} /> <span>{label}</span><Plus size={13} className="quick-add-item-plus" />
                    </button>
                  ))}
                  <div style={{ height: '1px', background: 'var(--line)', margin: '4px 0' }} />
                  <button
                    role="menuitem"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setDropdown(null)
                      navigate('/vault/jobs')
                    }}
                  >
                    <FileText size={16} /> <span>Save Job Description</span><Plus size={13} className="quick-add-item-plus" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    role="menuitem"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setDropdown(null)
                      setIsQuickUploadOpen(true)
                    }}
                  >
                    <UploadCloud size={16} /> <span>Upload Document</span><Plus size={13} className="quick-add-item-plus" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <button className="icon-button theme-toggle" aria-label={`Switch to ${theme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light'} mode`} title={`${theme === 'light' ? 'Dark' : 'Light'} mode`} onClick={toggleTheme}>{theme === 'light' ? <Moon size={17} /> : <Sun size={17} />}</button>
            <div className="notice-wrap" data-app-menu>
              <button className={`icon-button notification-button ${dropdown === 'notifications' ? 'notice-active' : ''}`} aria-label="Notifications" aria-expanded={dropdown === 'notifications'} aria-haspopup="dialog" onClick={() => toggleDropdown('notifications')}><Bell size={17} /></button>
              {dropdown === 'notifications' && <div className="notification-popover" role="dialog" aria-label="Notifications"><strong>You’re all caught up</strong><p>Updates about upcoming interviews and follow-ups will appear here.</p><button onClick={() => { if (navigateSafely('/calendar')) setDropdown(null) }}>View calendar <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button></div>}
            </div>
            <div className="top-profile-wrap" data-app-menu>
              <button className="top-avatar" aria-label="Open profile menu" aria-expanded={dropdown === 'profile-top'} aria-haspopup="menu" onClick={() => toggleDropdown('profile-top')}>{initials}</button>
              {dropdown === 'profile-top' && <ProfileMenu
                name={menuName}
                email={email}
                loading={auth.loading}
                hasSession={Boolean(auth.session)}
                signOutError={signOutError}
                onNavigate={(path) => { if (navigateSafely(path)) setDropdown(null) }}
                onSignOut={() => { void signOut() }}
              />}
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>
        <div className="page-content">
          {dataError
            ? <section className="data-error" role="alert">
              <h2>Workspace data unavailable</h2>
              <p>{dataError}</p>
              <button className="button button-secondary" onClick={retryDataLoad}>{dataRetryLabel}</button>
            </section>
            : dataLoading
              ? <div className="workspace-loading" role="status"><span className="loading-spinner" /> Loading your workspace…</div>
              : <Outlet context={{ openAdd, setProfileUnsavedChanges }} />}
        </div>
        <footer className="app-footer"><span>CareerOS <span className="footer-dot">·</span> Your next move, organized.</span><a href="mailto:hello@careeros.example"><CircleHelp size={14} /> Help</a></footer>
      </main>
      {addType && <RecordDialog type={addType} initialDate={addInitialDate} onClose={() => { setAddType(null); setAddInitialDate(undefined) }} />}
      {isQuickUploadOpen && <VaultUploadDialog onClose={() => setIsQuickUploadOpen(false)} onSuccess={() => setIsQuickUploadOpen(false)} />}
    </div>
  )
}

function ProfileMenu({
  name, email, loading, hasSession, signOutError, onNavigate, onSignOut,
}: {
  name: string
  email: string
  loading: boolean
  hasSession: boolean
  signOutError: string
  onNavigate: (path: string) => void
  onSignOut: () => void
}) {
  return <div className="profile-menu" role="menu">
    <div className="profile-menu-identity"><span className="user-avatar">{initialsFor(name)}</span><span><strong>{name}</strong><small>{email}</small></span></div>
    <button role="menuitem" onClick={() => onNavigate('/profile')}><Users size={15} /> View profile</button>
    <button role="menuitem" onClick={() => onNavigate('/settings')}><Settings size={15} /> Settings</button>
    {loading
      ? <p className="auth-message" role="status">Restoring your session…</p>
      : hasSession
        ? <button role="menuitem" onClick={onSignOut}><LogOut size={15} /> Sign out</button>
        : <div className="profile-auth-links"><Link role="menuitem" to="/auth/login">Sign in</Link><Link role="menuitem" to="/auth/signup">Create account</Link></div>}
    {signOutError && <p className="form-error" role="alert">{signOutError}</p>}
  </div>
}

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Select or create company...'));

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Create "New Company"/i }));

    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Company Name/i);
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: 'acme corp' } });

    expect(screen.getByText(/Existing match:/i)).toBeTruthy();
  });

import { useState, useMemo, useRef, useEffect, useContext } from 'react'
import { Building2, Plus, Check, Search, AlertCircle, X } from 'lucide-react'
import type { Company } from '../types'
import { CareerDataContext } from '../context/careerDataContext'

interface CompanySelectWithCreateProps {
  value: string
  onChange: (companyId: string) => void
  label?: string
  placeholder?: string
  required?: boolean
  allowClear?: boolean
  companies?: Company[]
  onCompanyCreated?: (company: Company) => void
  onCreateCompany?: (name: string, website?: string) => Promise<Company> | Company
}

export function normalizeCompanyName(name: string): string {
  return name.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
}

export function extractDomain(url?: string | null): string {
  if (!url) return ''
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(url.startsWith('http') ? url : `https://${url}`)
    return parsed.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '')
  } catch {
    return ''
  }
}

export function CompanySelectWithCreate({
  value,
  onChange,
  label = 'Company',
  placeholder = 'Select or create company...',
  required = false,
  allowClear = true,
  companies: propsCompanies,
  onCompanyCreated,
  onCreateCompany,
}: CompanySelectWithCreateProps) {
  const careerCtx = useContext(CareerDataContext)
  const availableCompanies = propsCompanies || careerCtx?.data?.companies || []
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('')
  const [isCreatingInline, setIsCreatingInline] = useState(false)

  // Inline creation fields
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('')
  const [newWebsite, setNewWebsite] = useState('')
  const [newCareersUrl, setNewCareersUrl] = useState('')
  const [duplicateWarning, setDuplicateWarning] = useState<Company | null>(null)
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  const selectedCompany = useMemo(() => {
    return availableCompanies.find((c) => c.id === value) || null
  }, [availableCompanies, value])

  const filteredCompanies = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) return availableCompanies
    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase()
    return availableCompanies.filter((c) =>
      c.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) || (c.website && c.website.toLowerCase().includes(term))
    )
  }, [availableCompanies, searchTerm])

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false)
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside)
  }, [])

  // Duplicate check when typing new company
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!newName.trim()) {
      setDuplicateWarning(null)
      return
    }
    const norm = normalizeCompanyName(newName)
    const newDom = extractDomain(newWebsite)
    const match = availableCompanies.find((c) => {
      const matchName = normalizeCompanyName(c.name) === norm
      const matchDomain = newDom && c.website && extractDomain(c.website) === newDom
      return matchName || matchDomain
    })
    setDuplicateWarning(match || null)
  }, [newName, newWebsite, availableCompanies])

  const handleStartInlineCreate = () => {
    setIsCreatingInline(true)
    setNewName(searchTerm.trim())
    setNewWebsite('')
    setNewCareersUrl('')
  }

  const handleConfirmCreate = async () => {
    if (!newName.trim()) return

    try {
      let createdCompany: Company
      if (onCreateCompany) {
        createdCompany = await onCreateCompany(newName.trim(), newWebsite.trim() || undefined)
      } else {
        const id = `company-${Date.now()}`
        const newRecord: Company = {
          id,
          name: newName.trim(),
          website: newWebsite.trim(),
          careersUrl: newCareersUrl.trim(),
          industry: '',
          location: '',
          size: '',
          tags: [],
          linkedinUrl: '',
          notes: '',
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        }
        if (careerCtx?.addRecord) {
          careerCtx.addRecord('company', {
            name: newName.trim(),
            website: newWebsite.trim(),
            careersUrl: newCareersUrl.trim(),
            industry: '',
            location: '',
            size: '',
            tags: '',
            linkedinUrl: '',
            notes: '',
          })
        }
        createdCompany = newRecord
      }

      onCompanyCreated?.(createdCompany)
      onChange(createdCompany.id)
      setIsCreatingInline(false)
      setIsOpen(false)
      setSearchTerm('')
      setNewName('')
      setNewWebsite('')
      setNewCareersUrl('')
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to create company inline:', err)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="company-select-with-create" ref={containerRef} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
      {label && (
        <label className="vault-field-label">
          {label} {required && <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>*</span>}
        </label>
      )}

      {/* Main Selector Button */}
      <div
        className="vault-input"
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          cursor: 'pointer',
          padding: '8px 12px',
          background: 'var(--surface)',
        }}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
          <Building2 size={15} style={{ color: selectedCompany ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--muted)' }} />
          <span style={{ color: selectedCompany ? 'var(--ink)' : 'var(--muted)', fontSize: '13px' }}>
            {selectedCompany ? selectedCompany.name : placeholder}
          </span>
        </div>

        {selectedCompany && allowClear && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action-button"
            style={{ padding: '2px', border: 'none', background: 'transparent' }}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation()
              onChange('')
            }}
          >
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Dropdown Menu */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div
          className="company-select-dropdown"
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '100%',
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            zIndex: 100,
            marginTop: '4px',
            background: 'var(--surface)',
            border: '1px solid var(--line)',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)',
            overflow: 'hidden',
          }}
        >
          {!isCreatingInline ? (
            <div style={{ padding: '8px' }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: '6px',
                  padding: '6px 10px',
                  border: '1px solid var(--line)',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  background: 'var(--surface-muted)',
                  marginBottom: '8px',
                }}
              >
                <Search size={14} style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }} />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search existing companies..."
                  value={searchTerm}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  style={{
                    border: 'none',
                    background: 'transparent',
                    outline: 'none',
                    width: '100%',
                    fontSize: '12px',
                    color: 'var(--ink)',
                  }}
                  autoFocus
                />
              </div>

              <div style={{ maxHeight: '180px', overflowY: 'auto' }}>
                {allowClear && (
                  <div
                    style={{
                      padding: '7px 10px',
                      borderRadius: '4px',
                      fontSize: '12px',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      color: 'var(--muted)',
                    }}
                    onClick={() => {
                      onChange('')
                      setIsOpen(false)
                    }}
                  >
                    <em>No Company (Independent)</em>
                  </div>
                )}

                {filteredCompanies.map((c) => (
                  <div
                    key={c.id}
                    style={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'space-between',
                      padding: '7px 10px',
                      borderRadius: '4px',
                      fontSize: '12px',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      background: value === c.id ? 'var(--surface-muted)' : 'transparent',
                    }}
                    onClick={() => {
                      onChange(c.id)
                      setIsOpen(false)
                    }}
                  >
                    <div>
                      <strong style={{ color: 'var(--ink)' }}>{c.name}</strong>
                      {c.website && <span style={{ marginLeft: '6px', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: '11px' }}>({extractDomain(c.website)})</span>}
                    </div>
                    {value === c.id && <Check size={14} style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }} />}
                  </div>
                ))}

                {filteredCompanies.length === 0 && (
                  <div style={{ padding: '12px', textAlign: 'center', fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                    No matching company found.
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--line)', paddingTop: '8px', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="button button-secondary"
                  style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: '12px', height: '32px' }}
                  onClick={handleStartInlineCreate}
                >
                  <Plus size={14} /> Create "{searchTerm.trim() || 'New Company'}"
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* Inline Company Creation Form */
            <div style={{ padding: '12px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '10px' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <strong style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--ink)' }}>Quick Create Company</strong>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="row-action-button"
                  style={{ border: 'none', background: 'transparent' }}
                  onClick={() => setIsCreatingInline(false)}
                >
                  <X size={14} />
                </button>
              </div>

              {duplicateWarning && (
                <div
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    padding: '8px 10px',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    background: '#fef3c7',
                    border: '1px solid #fde68a',
                    fontSize: '11px',
                    color: '#92400e',
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                    <AlertCircle size={14} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
                    <span>Existing match: <strong>{duplicateWarning.name}</strong></span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="button button-secondary"
                    style={{ fontSize: '10px', padding: '2px 8px', height: '22px' }}
                    onClick={() => {
                      onChange(duplicateWarning.id)
                      setIsCreatingInline(false)
                      setIsOpen(false)
                    }}
                  >
                    Reuse
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              <div>
                <label className="vault-field-label" style={{ fontSize: '11px' }}>Company Name *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  aria-label="Company Name"
                  className="vault-input"
                  style={{ fontSize: '12px', padding: '6px 8px' }}
                  placeholder="e.g. Microsoft"
                  value={newName}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                  autoFocus
                />

              <div>
                <label className="vault-field-label" style={{ fontSize: '11px' }}>Website (Optional)</label>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  aria-label="Website"
                  className="vault-input"
                  style={{ fontSize: '12px', padding: '6px 8px' }}
                  placeholder="https://microsoft.com"
                  value={newWebsite}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewWebsite(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="vault-field-label" style={{ fontSize: '11px' }}>Careers Page (Optional)</label>

                  style={{ fontSize: '12px', padding: '6px 8px' }}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { Sparkles, Clock, ArrowRight, AlertTriangle, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react'
import { intelligenceApi } from '../lib/intelligenceApi'
import type { SmartInsightsSummary } from '../lib/intelligence/types'
import { useAuth } from '../context/auth-context'

export function DashboardInsightsSection() {
  const auth = useAuth()
  const [insights, setInsights] = useState<SmartInsightsSummary | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    intelligenceApi
      .getSmartInsights(auth.session?.access_token)
      .then(setInsights)
      .catch((err) => console.error('Failed to load dashboard insights:', err))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false))
  }, [auth.session?.access_token])

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div
        className="dashboard-card"
        style={{
          padding: '16px',
          borderRadius: '8px',
          border: '1px solid var(--line)',
          background: 'var(--surface)',
          marginBottom: '20px',
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Loading CareerOS Smart Insights...</span>
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (!insights || insights.suggestedActions.length === 0) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="dashboard-smart-insights"
      style={{
        padding: '16px',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        border: '1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25)',
        background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.04) 0%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.02) 100%)',
        marginBottom: '24px',
      }}
    >
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
          <Sparkles size={16} style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }} />
          <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--ink)' }}>
            Smart Career Insights & Suggested Actions
          </h3>
        </div>
        <span style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
          {insights.stats.upcomingInterviewsCount} interviews • {insights.stats.overdueTasksCount} overdue tasks
        </span>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr))', gap: '10px' }}>
        {insights.suggestedActions.slice(0, 3).map((item) => {
          const isUrgent = item.severity === 'urgent'
          const isWarning = item.severity === 'warning'
          const iconColor = isUrgent ? '#ef4444' : isWarning ? '#f59e0b' : 'var(--accent)'

          return (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              style={{
                padding: '12px',
                borderRadius: '6px',
                background: 'var(--surface)',
                border: '1px solid var(--line)',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                gap: '8px',
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: '8px' }}>
                {isUrgent ? (
                  <AlertCircle size={16} style={{ color: iconColor, flexShrink: 0, marginTop: '2px' }} />
                ) : isWarning ? (
                  <AlertTriangle size={16} style={{ color: iconColor, flexShrink: 0, marginTop: '2px' }} />
                ) : (
                  <Clock size={16} style={{ color: iconColor, flexShrink: 0, marginTop: '2px' }} />
                )}
                <div>
                  <strong style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--ink)', display: 'block' }}>{item.title}</strong>
                  <p style={{ margin: '2px 0 0 0', fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)', lineHeight: '1.4' }}>
                    {item.description}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                <Link
                  to={item.actionUrl}
                  style={{
                    display: 'inline-flex',

                >
                  {item.actionLabel} <ArrowRight size={12} />

              </div>

import { Component, type ErrorInfo, type ReactNode } from 'react'

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode
  fallback?: ReactNode
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean
  error: Error | null
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  public state: State = {
    hasError: false,
    error: null,
  }

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, error }
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    console.error('CareerOS ErrorBoundary caught an error:', error, errorInfo)
  }

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback
      }
      return (
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '32px',
            maxWidth: '640px',
            margin: '80px auto',
            background: 'var(--surface, #1e293b)',
            borderRadius: '12px',
            border: '1px solid var(--line, #334155)',
            color: 'var(--foreground, #f8fafc)',
            fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif',
          }}
        >
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: '8px', color: '#ef4444' }}>
            Something went wrong
          </h2>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary, #94a3b8)', fontSize: '0.875rem', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
            CareerOS encountered an unexpected error while rendering this view.
          </p>
          {this.state.error?.message && (
            <pre
              style={{
                padding: '12px',
                background: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
                borderRadius: '6px',
                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                overflowX: 'auto',
                marginBottom: '16px',
                color: '#fca5a5',
              }}
            >
              {this.state.error.message}
            </pre>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
            style={{
              padding: '8px 16px',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              background: '#2563eb',
              color: '#fff',
              border: 'none',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              fontWeight: 500,
            }}
          >
            Reload Workspace
          </button>
        </div>
      )
    }

    return this.props.children
  }
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { addMonths, format, isSameDay, isSameMonth, isToday, parseISO, startOfMonth, subMonths } from 'date-fns'
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, CalendarPlus, CheckSquare, Clock3, MapPin, Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { getCalendarDays, getItemsForDate, getScheduledItems } from '../lib/calendar'
import type { CareerData, RecordType } from '../types'

interface MonthlyCalendarProps {
  data: CareerData
  compact?: boolean
  onAdd: (type: Extract<RecordType, 'task' | 'event'>, date: Date) => void
  onOpen: (type: Extract<RecordType, 'task' | 'event'>, id: string) => void
  onDeleteEvent?: (id: string) => void
}

const weekdays = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun']

export function MonthlyCalendar({ data, compact = false, onAdd, onOpen, onDeleteEvent }: MonthlyCalendarProps) {
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(() => new Date())
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(() => startOfMonth(new Date()))
  const days = useMemo(() => getCalendarDays(month), [month])
  const items = useMemo(() => getScheduledItems(data), [data])
  const selectedItems = getItemsForDate(items, selectedDate)

  const goToMonth = (nextMonth: Date) => {
    setMonth(startOfMonth(nextMonth))
    setSelectedDate((selected) => isSameMonth(selected, nextMonth) ? selected : startOfMonth(nextMonth))
  }

  const selectToday = () => {
    const today = new Date()
    setMonth(startOfMonth(today))
    setSelectedDate(today)
  }

  return <section className={`monthly-calendar ${compact ? 'monthly-calendar-compact' : ''}`} aria-label="Monthly calendar">
    <div className="calendar-heading">
      <div><h2>{format(month, 'MMMM yyyy')}</h2><p>{selectedItems.length ? `${selectedItems.length} scheduled item${selectedItems.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected` : 'Select a date to see what’s planned'}</p></div>
      <div className="calendar-controls">
        <button className="calendar-today" onClick={selectToday}>Today</button>
        <button className="calendar-nav-button" aria-label="Previous month" onClick={() => goToMonth(subMonths(month, 1))}><ArrowLeft size={15} /></button>
        <button className="calendar-nav-button" aria-label="Next month" onClick={() => goToMonth(addMonths(month, 1))}><ArrowRight size={15} /></button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div className="calendar-grid" role="grid" aria-label={format(month, 'MMMM yyyy')}>
      {weekdays.map((weekday) => <div className="calendar-weekday" role="columnheader" key={weekday}>{weekday}</div>)}
      {days.map((day) => {
        const dayItems = getItemsForDate(items, day)
        const hasEvent = dayItems.some((item) => item.type === 'event')
        const hasTask = dayItems.some((item) => item.type === 'task')
        const selected = isSameDay(day, selectedDate)
        return <button
          className={`calendar-day ${!isSameMonth(day, month) ? 'calendar-day-outside' : ''} ${isToday(day) ? 'calendar-day-today' : ''} ${selected ? 'calendar-day-selected' : ''}`}
          role="gridcell"
          aria-label={`${format(day, 'EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy')}${dayItems.length ? `, ${dayItems.length} scheduled item${dayItems.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : ''}`}
          aria-pressed={selected}
          key={format(day, 'yyyy-MM-dd')}
          onClick={() => setSelectedDate(day)}
        >
          <span className="calendar-day-number">{format(day, 'd')}</span>
          <span className="calendar-indicators" aria-hidden="true">
            {hasEvent && <i className="calendar-event-indicator" />}
            {hasTask && <i className="calendar-task-indicator" />}
          </span>
        </button>
      })}
    </div>
    <div className="calendar-selected">
      <div className="calendar-selected-heading">
        <h3>{isToday(selectedDate) ? 'Today' : format(selectedDate, 'EEEE, MMM d')}</h3>
        <div className="calendar-add-actions">
          <button className="calendar-add-link" onClick={() => onAdd('event', selectedDate)}><CalendarPlus size={13} /> Event</button>
          <button className="calendar-add-link" onClick={() => onAdd('task', selectedDate)}><Plus size={13} /> Task</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      {selectedItems.length ? <div className="calendar-selected-list">
        {selectedItems.map((item) => <article className={`calendar-selected-item calendar-selected-${item.type}`} key={`${item.type}-${item.id}`}>
          <span className="calendar-item-symbol" aria-hidden="true">{item.type === 'event' ? <Clock3 size={13} /> : <CheckSquare size={13} />}</span>
          <button className="calendar-item-open" onClick={() => onOpen(item.type, item.id)}>
            <strong>{item.title}</strong>
            <span>{item.type === 'event' ? `${item.category}${item.time ? ` · ${format(parseISO(item.time), 'h:mm a')}` : ''}` : `${item.category}${item.company ? ` · ${item.company}` : ''}`}</span>
            {item.type === 'event' && (item.location || item.company) && <small><MapPin size={11} /> {item.location || item.company}</small>}
          </button>
          {item.type === 'event' && onDeleteEvent && <button className="calendar-item-delete" aria-label={`Delete ${item.title}`} onClick={() => onDeleteEvent(item.id)}><Trash2 size={13} /></button>}
        </article>)}
      </div> : <div className="calendar-empty">Nothing scheduled. Add an event or task for this date.</div>}
      <p className="calendar-legend"><span><i className="calendar-event-indicator" /> Events</span><span><i className="calendar-task-indicator" /> Tasks</span></p>
    </div>
  </section>
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

const labels: Record<RecordType, string> = {
  company: 'company',
  application: 'application',
  contact: 'contact',

  event: 'event',
}

function getCurrentRecord(type: RecordType, id: string | undefined, data: ReturnType<typeof useCareerData>['data']): EditableRecord | undefined {
  if (!id) return undefined
  if (type === 'company') return data.companies.find((item) => item.id === id)
  if (type === 'application') return data.applications.find((item) => item.id === id)
  if (type === 'contact') return data.contacts.find((item) => item.id === id)
  if (type === 'task') return data.tasks.find((item) => item.id === id)
  return data.events.find((item) => item.id === id)
}

function getRecordField(record: EditableRecord | undefined, field: string): unknown {
  if (!record || !(field in record)) return undefined
  return record[field as keyof EditableRecord]
}

function inputValue(value: unknown, type: Field['type']) {
  if (Array.isArray(value) && value.every((item) => typeof item === 'string')) return value.join(', ')
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return ''
  if (type === 'date' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return value
  if (type === 'date' || type === 'datetime-local') {
    const date = new Date(value)
    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return ''
    const localDate = new Date(date.getTime() - date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000).toISOString()
    return type === 'date' ? localDate.slice(0, 10) : localDate.slice(0, 16)
  }
  return value
}

export function RecordDialog({ type, recordId, initialDate, onClose }: RecordDialogProps) {
  const { data, addRecord, updateRecord } = useCareerData()
  const auth = useAuth()
  const token = auth.session?.access_token

  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})
  const [activeCompanyTab, setActiveCompanyTab] = useState<'details' | 'resources'>('details')
  const [activeAppTab, setActiveAppTab] = useState<'details' | 'documents' | 'intelligence'>('details')

  // Selected company state for inline create support
  const record = getCurrentRecord(type, recordId, data)
  const [selectedCompanyId, setSelectedCompanyId] = useState<string>(String(getRecordField(record, 'companyId') ?? ''))

  // Resume groups for version selection in applications
  const [resumeGroups, setResumeGroups] = useState<ResumeGroup[]>([])
  const [jobDescriptions, setJobDescriptions] = useState<JobDescription[]>([])
  const [selectedResumeVersion, setSelectedResumeVersion] = useState<string>(String(getRecordField(record, 'resumeReference') ?? ''))

  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null)
  const closeRef = useRef(onClose)
  const fields = fieldsByType[type]

  useEffect(() => {
    closeRef.current = onClose
  }, [onClose])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (type === 'application') {
      vaultApi.getResumeGroups(false, token).then(setResumeGroups).catch(() => {})
      vaultApi.getJobDescriptions(token).then(setJobDescriptions).catch(() => {})
    }
  }, [type, token])

  useEffect(() => {
    const previouslyFocused = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null
    const dialog = dialogRef.current
    const focusable = () => [...(dialog?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])') ?? [])]
    const firstField = dialog?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled])')
    ;(firstField ?? focusable()[0])?.focus()

    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        event.preventDefault()
        closeRef.current()
        return
      }
      if (event.key !== 'Tab') return
      const items = focusable()
      const first = items[0]
      const last = items.at(-1)
      if (!first || !last) {
        event.preventDefault()
      } else if (event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === first || !dialog?.contains(document.activeElement))) {
        event.preventDefault()
        last.focus()
      } else if (!event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === last || !dialog?.contains(document.activeElement))) {
        event.preventDefault()
        first.focus()
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
      if (previouslyFocused?.isConnected) previouslyFocused.focus()
    }
  }, [])

  const save = (formData: FormData) => {
    const values = Object.fromEntries(fields.map((field) => [field.name, String(formData.get(field.name) ?? '')]))
    if (fieldErrors.companyId) {
      delete fieldErrors.companyId
    }

    // Bind custom selected company if relevant
    if (fields.some((f) => f.name === 'companyId')) {
      values.companyId = selectedCompanyId
    }
    if (fields.some((f) => f.name === 'resumeReference')) {
      values.resumeReference = selectedResumeVersion || values.resumeReference
    }

    const result = createRecordSchema(type, data).safeParse(values)
    if (!result.success) {
      const nextErrors: Record<string, string> = {}
      for (const issue of result.error.issues) {
        const fieldName = issue.path[0]
        if (typeof fieldName === 'string') nextErrors[fieldName] ??= issue.message
      }
      setFieldErrors(nextErrors)
      return
    }
    setFieldErrors({})
    if (recordId) updateRecord(type, recordId, result.data)
    else addRecord(type, result.data)
    onClose()
  }

  // Completeness indicator for applications
  const completeness = type === 'application' && record
    ? computeApplicationCompleteness(record as Application)
    : null

  return (
    <div className="dialog-backdrop" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget) onClose() }}>
      <section ref={dialogRef} className="dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dialog-title" style={{ maxWidth: '640px' }}>
        <div className="dialog-heading">
          <div>
            <p className="eyebrow">{recordId ? 'Edit record' : 'New record'}</p>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '12px' }}>
              <h2 id="dialog-title">{recordId ? 'Update' : 'Add'} {labels[type]}</h2>
              {completeness && (
                <div
                  style={{
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: '4px',
                    fontSize: '11px',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    padding: '2px 8px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    background: completeness.status === 'complete' ? '#ecfdf5' : '#fef3c7',
                    color: completeness.status === 'complete' ? '#065f46' : '#92400e',
                    border: `1px solid ${completeness.status === 'complete' ? '#a7f3d0' : '#fde68a'}`,
                  }}
                  title={completeness.missingFields.map((m) => `• Missing: ${m.label}`).join('\n')}
                >
                  <span>{completeness.score}% complete</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          <button className="icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Close dialog" onClick={onClose}>×</button>
        </div>

        {/* Company Detail Tabs */}
        {type === 'company' && recordId && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--line)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`vault-tab-button ${activeCompanyTab === 'details' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              style={{ fontSize: '13px', padding: '8px 12px' }}
              onClick={() => setActiveCompanyTab('details')}
            >
              Company Details
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`vault-tab-button ${activeCompanyTab === 'resources' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              style={{ fontSize: '13px', padding: '8px 12px' }}
              onClick={() => setActiveCompanyTab('resources')}
            >
              Vault Resources & Documents
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Application Detail Tabs */}
        {type === 'application' && recordId && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--line)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`vault-tab-button ${activeAppTab === 'details' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              style={{ fontSize: '13px', padding: '8px 12px' }}
              onClick={() => setActiveAppTab('details')}
            >
              Application Details
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`vault-tab-button ${activeAppTab === 'documents' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              style={{ fontSize: '13px', padding: '8px 12px' }}
              onClick={() => setActiveAppTab('documents')}
            >
              Application Documents
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`vault-tab-button ${activeAppTab === 'intelligence' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              style={{ fontSize: '13px', padding: '8px 12px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '5px' }}
              onClick={() => setActiveAppTab('intelligence')}
            >
              <Sparkles size={14} style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }} /> Smart Prep & Matching
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Sub-tab view: Company Resources */}
        {type === 'company' && recordId && activeCompanyTab === 'resources' ? (
          <div style={{ padding: '0 4px 16px' }}>
            <CompanyResourcesTab
              companyId={recordId}
              companyName={(record as Company)?.name || 'Company'}
            />
          </div>
        ) : type === 'application' && recordId && activeAppTab === 'documents' ? (
          /* Sub-tab view: Application Documents */
          <div style={{ padding: '0 4px 16px' }}>
            <ApplicationDocumentsTab
              applicationId={recordId}
              jobTitle={(record as Application)?.jobTitle || 'Application'}
              resumeReference={(record as Application)?.resumeReference}
            />
          </div>
        ) : type === 'application' && recordId && activeAppTab === 'intelligence' ? (
          /* Sub-tab view: Smart Prep & Matching */
          <div style={{ padding: '0 4px 16px' }}>
            <ApplicationIntelligenceSection
              applicationId={recordId}
              currentResumeVersionId={selectedResumeVersion}
              onSelectResumeVersion={(vId) => {
                setSelectedResumeVersion(vId)
                if (recordId) {
                  updateRecord('application', recordId, { resumeReference: vId })
                }
              }}
            />
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Form for Main Record */
          <form onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); save(new FormData(event.currentTarget)) }}>
            <div className="form-grid">
              {fields.map((field) => {
                if (field.company) {
                  return (
                    <div key={field.name} className="form-field">
                      <CompanySelectWithCreate
                        label={field.label}
                        required={field.required}
                        value={selectedCompanyId}
                        onChange={(cid) => {
                          setSelectedCompanyId(cid)
                          if (fieldErrors.companyId) {
                            setFieldErrors((prev) => {
                              const n = { ...prev }
                              delete n.companyId
                              return n
                            })
                          }
                        }}
                      />
                      {fieldErrors.companyId && <span className="form-error" role="alert">{fieldErrors.companyId}</span>}
                    </div>
                  )
                }

                if (type === 'application' && field.name === 'resumeReference') {
                  return (
                    <div key={field.name} className="form-field">
                      <label>
                        <span>{field.label}</span>
                        <select
                          value={selectedResumeVersion}
                          onChange={(e) => setSelectedResumeVersion(e.target.value)}
                        >
                          <option value="">-- Choose submitted resume version --</option>
                          {resumeGroups.map((group) =>
                            group.versions.map((v) => (
                              <option key={v.id} value={`${group.name} (${v.versionLabel})`}>
                                {group.name} — {v.versionLabel} {v.isCurrent ? '(Current)' : ''}
                              </option>
                            ))
                          )}
                          {/* Fallback option if custom text already stored */}
                          {selectedResumeVersion && !resumeGroups.some((g) => g.versions.some((v) => `${g.name} (${v.versionLabel})` === selectedResumeVersion)) && (
                            <option value={selectedResumeVersion}>{selectedResumeVersion} (Legacy/Custom)</option>
                          )}
                        </select>
                      </label>
                    </div>
                  )
                }

                if (type === 'application' && field.name === 'jobDescription') {
                  return (
                    <div key={field.name} className="form-field full-width">
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: 500 }}>{field.label}</span>
                        {jobDescriptions.length > 0 && (
                          <select
                            style={{ fontSize: '11px', padding: '3px 6px', maxWidth: '240px' }}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const found = jobDescriptions.find((j) => j.id === e.target.value)
                              if (found) {
                                const descArea = document.querySelector('textarea[name="jobDescription"]') as HTMLTextAreaElement
                                if (descArea) descArea.value = found.descriptionText || found.responsibilities || ''
                              }
                            }}
                          >
                            <option value="">-- Copy from saved Vault JD --</option>
                            {jobDescriptions.map((j) => (
                              <option key={j.id} value={j.id}>
                                {j.title} {j.company?.name ? `(${j.company.name})` : ''}
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <textarea
                        name={field.name}
                        aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors[field.name])}
                        aria-describedby={fieldErrors[field.name] ? `error-${type}-${field.name}` : undefined}
                        defaultValue={inputValue(getRecordField(record, field.name), field.type)}
                      />
                    </div>
                  )
                }

                return (
                  <label className={field.type === 'textarea' ? 'form-field full-width' : 'form-field'} key={field.name}>
                    <span>{field.label}{field.required ? ' *' : ''}</span>
                    {field.relation === 'contact' ? (
                      <select name={field.name} aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors[field.name])} aria-describedby={fieldErrors[field.name] ? `error-${type}-${field.name}` : undefined} defaultValue={String(getRecordField(record, field.name) ?? '')}>
                        <option value="">No contact</option>
                        {data.contacts.map((contact) => <option key={contact.id} value={contact.id}>{contact.name}</option>)}
                      </select>
                    ) : field.relation === 'application' ? (
                      <select name={field.name} aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors[field.name])} aria-describedby={fieldErrors[field.name] ? `error-${type}-${field.name}` : undefined} defaultValue={String(getRecordField(record, field.name) ?? '')}>
                        <option value="">No application</option>
                        {data.applications.map((application) => <option key={application.id} value={application.id}>{application.jobTitle}</option>)}
                      </select>
                    ) : field.type === 'select' ? (
                      <select name={field.name} aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors[field.name])} aria-describedby={fieldErrors[field.name] ? `error-${type}-${field.name}` : undefined} defaultValue={String(getRecordField(record, field.name) ?? field.options?.[0] ?? '')}>
                        {field.options?.map((option) => <option key={option}>{option}</option>)}
                      </select>
                    ) : field.type === 'textarea' ? (
                      <textarea name={field.name} aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors[field.name])} aria-describedby={fieldErrors[field.name] ? `error-${type}-${field.name}` : undefined} defaultValue={inputValue(getRecordField(record, field.name), field.type)} />
                    ) : (
                      <input
                        name={field.name}
                        type={field.type ?? 'text'}
                        required={field.required}
                        aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors[field.name])}
                        aria-describedby={fieldErrors[field.name] ? `error-${type}-${field.name}` : undefined}
                        defaultValue={inputValue(getRecordField(record, field.name), field.type) || (!record && initialDate && field.name === 'dueAt' ? format(initialDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') : !record && initialDate && field.name === 'startsAt' ? format(initialDate, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm") : '')}
                        placeholder={field.placeholder}
                      />
                    )}
                    {fieldErrors[field.name] && <span id={`error-${type}-${field.name}`} className="form-error" role="alert">{fieldErrors[field.name]}</span>}
                  </label>
                )
              })}
            </div>
            <div className="dialog-actions">
              <button className="button button-secondary" type="button" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
              <button className="button button-primary" type="submit">{recordId ? 'Save changes' : `Add ${labels[type]}`}</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}

import { Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useAuth } from '../context/auth-context'
import { isSupabaseConfigured } from '../lib/supabase'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'

export function RequireAuth({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const auth = useAuth()
  const location = useLocation()

  if (auth.dataMode === 'demo') return children
  if (!isSupabaseConfigured) {
    return <section className="auth-gate"><h1>Authentication setup required</h1><p>Configure the public Supabase URL and publishable key before using API mode.</p><a className="button button-primary" href="/auth/login">Open sign in</a></section>
  }
  if (auth.loading) return <div className="route-loading" role="status">Restoring your secure session…</div>
  if (!auth.session) return <Navigate to="/auth/login" replace state={{ from: location.pathname }} />
  if (auth.provisioning) return <div className="route-loading" role="status">Preparing your workspace…</div>
  if (auth.provisioningError) {
    return <section className="auth-gate" role="alert">
      <h1>We could not verify your CareerOS account</h1>
      <p>{auth.provisioningError}</p>
      <div className="auth-gate-actions">
        <button className="button button-primary" onClick={auth.retryProvisioning}>Try again</button>
        <button className="button button-secondary" onClick={() => { void auth.signOut() }}>Sign out</button>
      </div>
    </section>
  }
  if (!auth.user) return <div className="route-loading" role="status">Verifying your account…</div>
  return children
}

          }}

            setActiveFile(null)
            setFiles((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== id))
            setTotalFiles((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1))
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
