import { useState, useEffect, useRef, type DragEvent } from 'react'
import {
  FileText,
  Plus,
  UploadCloud,
  CheckCircle2,
  Download,
  Eye,
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  Calendar,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  Sparkles,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { vaultApi } from '../../lib/vaultApi'
import { useAuth } from '../../context/auth-context'
import type { ResumeGroup, VaultFile } from '../../types'
import { VaultFileDetailModal } from './VaultFileDetailModal'

export function ResumeVaultPage() {
  const auth = useAuth()
  const token = auth.session?.access_token

  const [groups, setGroups] = useState<ResumeGroup[]>([])
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true)
  const [isCreatingGroup, setIsCreatingGroup] = useState(false)
  const [activeUploadGroupId, setActiveUploadGroupId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [activePreviewFile, setActivePreviewFile] = useState<VaultFile | null>(null)

  // New Group Form State
  const [groupName, setGroupName] = useState('')
  const [targetRole, setTargetRole] = useState('')
  const [groupDescription, setGroupDescription] = useState('')
  const [groupSkills, setGroupSkills] = useState('')
  const [isSubmittingGroup, setIsSubmittingGroup] = useState(false)

  // Upload Version Form State
  const [versionFile, setVersionFile] = useState<File | null>(null)
  const [versionLabel, setVersionLabel] = useState('')
  const [versionDescription, setVersionDescription] = useState('')
  const [versionSkills, setVersionSkills] = useState('')
  const [isVersionCurrent, setIsVersionCurrent] = useState(true)
  const [isSubmittingVersion, setIsSubmittingVersion] = useState(false)
  const [versionError, setVersionError] = useState('')
  const [isDraggingVersion, setIsDraggingVersion] = useState(false)
  const versionFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  const loadResumeGroups = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      const data = await vaultApi.getResumeGroups(false, token)
      setGroups(data)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load resume groups', err)
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadResumeGroups()
  }, [token])

  const handleCreateGroup = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!groupName.trim()) return
    setIsSubmittingGroup(true)
    try {
      const skills = groupSkills.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      const created = await vaultApi.createResumeGroup(
        {
          name: groupName.trim(),
          targetRole: targetRole.trim() || undefined,
          description: groupDescription.trim() || undefined,
          skills,
        },
        token,
      )
      setGroups((prev) => [created, ...prev])
      setIsCreatingGroup(false)
      setGroupName('')
      setTargetRole('')
      setGroupDescription('')
      setGroupSkills('')
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to create resume group')
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingGroup(false)
    }
  }

  const handleUploadVersion = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!activeUploadGroupId || !versionFile) {
      setVersionError('Please select a resume file (PDF preferred).')
      return
    }

    setIsSubmittingVersion(true)
    setVersionError('')

    try {
      const skills = versionSkills.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      await vaultApi.uploadResumeVersion(
        activeUploadGroupId,
        versionFile,
        {
          versionLabel: versionLabel.trim() || undefined,
          description: versionDescription.trim() || undefined,
          skills,
          isCurrent: isVersionCurrent,
        },
        token,
      )

      await loadResumeGroups()
      setActiveUploadGroupId(null)
      setVersionFile(null)
      setVersionLabel('')
      setVersionDescription('')
      setVersionSkills('')
    } catch (err: any) {
      setVersionError(err.message || 'Failed to upload version')
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingVersion(false)
    }
  }

  const handleSetCurrent = async (groupId: string, versionId: string) => {
    try {
      await vaultApi.setCurrentResumeVersion(groupId, versionId, token)
      setGroups((prev) =>
        prev.map((g) => {
          if (g.id !== groupId) return g
          return {
            ...g,
            versions: g.versions.map((v) => ({
              ...v,
              isCurrent: v.id === versionId,
            })),
          }
        }),
      )
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to set current version')
    }
  }

  const formatBytes = (bytes?: number) => {
    if (!bytes) return '0 B'
    const mb = bytes / (1024 * 1024)
    if (mb < 1) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`
    return `${mb.toFixed(1)} MB`
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '20px' }}>
      {/* Top Banner */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '12px' }}>
        <div>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: '18px', fontWeight: 700, margin: 0, color: 'var(--ink)' }}>Resume Profiles & Versions</h2>
          <p style={{ margin: '2px 0 0', fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
            Each resume group contains immutable version snapshots. Applications remain pinned to their exact submitted version.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button className="button button-primary" onClick={() => setIsCreatingGroup(true)}>
          <Plus size={15} /> Create Resume Group
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Group List */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="directory-empty" style={{ padding: '48px 24px' }}>Loading resume profiles…</div>
      ) : groups.length > 0 ? (
        groups.map((group) => {
          const currentVer = group.versions.find((v) => v.isCurrent) || group.versions[0]
          return (
            <div key={group.id} className="resume-group-card">
              <div className="resume-group-header">
                <div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px' }}>
                    <h3 style={{ fontSize: '16px', fontWeight: 700, margin: 0, color: 'var(--ink)' }}>{group.name}</h3>
                    {currentVer && (
                      <span className="vault-badge current">Current: {currentVer.versionLabel}</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {group.targetRole && (
                    <p style={{ margin: '3px 0 0', fontSize: '13px', color: 'var(--accent)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                      Target: {group.targetRole}
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {group.description && (
                    <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{group.description}</p>
                  )}

                  {group.skills.length > 0 && (
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '6px', marginTop: '10px' }}>
                      {group.skills.map((s) => (
                        <span key={s} className="skill-chip">{s}</span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <button
                  className="button button-secondary"
                  style={{ height: '32px', fontSize: '12px' }}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setActiveUploadGroupId(group.id)
                    setVersionLabel(`v${((group.versions.length + 1) / 1.0).toFixed(1)}`)
                  }}
                >
                  <UploadCloud size={14} /> Upload New Version
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Version History List */}
              <div className="resume-versions-timeline">
                {group.versions.map((ver) => (
                  <div key={ver.id} className="resume-version-row">
                    <div className="version-left">
                      <span className="vault-ext-badge">PDF</span>
                      <div className="version-info">
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                          <strong style={{ fontSize: '13px', color: 'var(--ink)' }}>{ver.versionLabel}</strong>
                          {ver.isCurrent && (
                            <span className="vault-badge current" style={{ fontSize: '10px', padding: '1px 6px' }}>
                              Active
                            </span>
                          )}
                          <span style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--subtle)' }}>
                            • {formatBytes(ver.vaultFile?.fileSizeBytes)}
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        {ver.description && (
                          <p style={{ margin: '2px 0 0', fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                            {ver.description}
                          </p>
                        )}

                        <div className="version-meta">
                          <span>
                            <Calendar size={12} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: '4px' }} />
                            Uploaded: {new Date(ver.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                          </span>

                          {ver.applicationDocuments && ver.applicationDocuments.length > 0 && (
                            <span>
                              <BriefcaseBusiness size={12} style={{ display: 'inline', marginRight: '4px' }} />
                              Used in {ver.applicationDocuments.length} application{ver.applicationDocuments.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                      {!ver.isCurrent && (
                        <button
                          className="button button-secondary"
                          style={{ height: '30px', fontSize: '11px', padding: '0 10px' }}
                          onClick={() => handleSetCurrent(group.id, ver.id)}
                        >
                          <CheckCircle2 size={12} /> Make Current
                        </button>
                      )}

                      {ver.vaultFile && (
                        <>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="row-action-button"
                            title="Preview version"
                            onClick={() => setActivePreviewFile(ver.vaultFile!)}
                          >
                            <Eye size={14} />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="row-action-button"
                            title="Download version"
                            onClick={() =>
                              vaultApi.downloadFile(
                                ver.vaultFile!.id,
                                ver.vaultFile!.originalFilename || ver.vaultFile!.displayName,
                                token,
                              )
                            }
                          >
                            <Download size={14} />
                          </button>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        })
      ) : (
        <div className="directory-empty" style={{ padding: '48px 24px' }}>
          <FileText size={36} style={{ color: 'var(--subtle)', margin: '0 auto 10px' }} />
          <h3>No Resume Groups Yet</h3>
          <p>Create tailored resume groups like "Frontend Developer" or "Full Stack Engineer" to maintain immutable version histories.</p>
          <button className="button button-primary" onClick={() => setIsCreatingGroup(true)}>
            <Plus size={14} /> Create First Group
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Create Group Modal */}
      {isCreatingGroup && (
        <div className="vault-modal-scrim" onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && setIsCreatingGroup(false)}>
          <div className="vault-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="create-group-title">
            <div className="vault-modal-header">
              <div>
                <h2 id="create-group-title">Create Resume Group</h2>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                  Group resume versions tailored for specific roles or seniority levels.
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="row-action-button"
                aria-label="Close"
                onClick={() => setIsCreatingGroup(false)}
              >
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateGroup} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <div className="vault-modal-body">
                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="group-name-input">
                    Resume Group Name <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="group-name-input"
                    className="vault-input"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. Senior Frontend Engineer"
                    value={groupName}
                    onChange={(e) => setGroupName(e.target.value)}
                  />
                  <span className="vault-field-hint">A clear identifier for this resume variant.</span>
                </div>

                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="group-target-input">
                    Target Role / Title
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="group-target-input"
                    className="vault-input"
                    placeholder="e.g. Staff Software Engineer, Tech Lead"
                    value={targetRole}
                    onChange={(e) => setTargetRole(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="group-desc-input">
                    Description & Strategy
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="group-desc-input"
                    className="vault-textarea"
                    rows={3}
                    placeholder="Describe how this resume variant is tailored (e.g. highlights systems architecture and scale)..."
                    value={groupDescription}
                    onChange={(e) => setGroupDescription(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="group-skills-input">
                    Key Skills (comma-separated)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="group-skills-input"
                    className="vault-input"
                    placeholder="React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL"
                    value={groupSkills}
                    onChange={(e) => setGroupSkills(e.target.value)}
                  />
                  <span className="vault-field-hint">These skills are automatically indexed as search tags.</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="vault-modal-footer">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="button button-secondary"
                  onClick={() => setIsCreatingGroup(false)}
                  disabled={isSubmittingGroup}
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="button button-primary"
                  disabled={isSubmittingGroup || !groupName.trim()}
                >
                  {isSubmittingGroup ? 'Creating…' : 'Create Group'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Upload Version Modal */}
      {activeUploadGroupId && (
        <div
          className="vault-modal-scrim"
          onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && !isSubmittingVersion && setActiveUploadGroupId(null)}
        >
          <div className="vault-modal" style={{ maxWidth: '640px' }} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="upload-version-title">
            <div className="vault-modal-header">
              <div>
                <h2 id="upload-version-title">Upload Resume Version</h2>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                  Each upload creates an immutable snapshot without overwriting previous versions.
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="row-action-button"
                aria-label="Close"
                onClick={() => !isSubmittingVersion && setActiveUploadGroupId(null)}
                disabled={isSubmittingVersion}
              >
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleUploadVersion} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <div className="vault-modal-body">
                {versionError && (
                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: '8px',
                      padding: '10px 14px',
                      borderRadius: '8px',
                      background: '#fef2f2',
                      color: '#b91c1c',
                      fontSize: '12px',
                      border: '1px solid #fecaca',
                    }}
                  >
                    <AlertCircle size={15} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
                    <span>{versionError}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Drag & Drop File Selector */}
                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label">
                    Resume Document <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>*</span>
                  </label>
                  <div
                    className={`vault-dropzone ${isDraggingVersion ? 'dragging' : ''}`}
                    onClick={() => versionFileInputRef.current?.click()}
                    onDragOver={(e: DragEvent) => {
                      e.preventDefault()
                      setIsDraggingVersion(true)
                    }}
                    onDragLeave={() => setIsDraggingVersion(false)}
                    onDrop={(e: DragEvent) => {
                      e.preventDefault()
                      setIsDraggingVersion(false)
                      if (e.dataTransfer.files?.[0]) {
                        setVersionFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0])
                        setVersionError('')
                      }
                    }}
                    style={{ padding: '24px 16px' }}
                  >
                    <div className="vault-dropzone-icon" style={{ width: '40px', height: '40px' }}>
                      <UploadCloud size={20} />
                    </div>
                    {versionFile ? (
                      <div>
                        <strong style={{ color: 'var(--ink)', fontSize: '13px' }}>{versionFile.name}</strong>
                        <p style={{ margin: '3px 0 0', fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                          {(versionFile.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB — Click or drop to replace
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div>
                        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--ink)', fontSize: '13px' }}>
                          Drag and drop your resume file, or <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>browse</span>
                        </p>
                        <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                          Supports PDF, DOCX, DOC (Up to 20 MB)
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <input
                      ref={versionFileInputRef}
                      type="file"
                      style={{ display: 'none' }}
                      accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx"
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        if (e.target.files?.[0]) {
                          setVersionFile(e.target.files[0])
                          setVersionError('')
                        }
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Two Column Section on Wider Screens */}
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))', gap: '14px' }}>
                  <div className="vault-form-field">
                    <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="version-label-input">
                      Version Label
                    </label>
                    <input
                      id="version-label-input"
                      className="vault-input"
                      value={versionLabel}
                      placeholder="e.g. v2.0 or 2026-Q1"
                      onChange={(e) => setVersionLabel(e.target.value)}
                    />
                    <span className="vault-field-hint">Defaults automatically if left blank.</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="vault-form-field">
                    <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="version-skills-input">
                      Skills Highlighted
                    </label>
                    <input
                      id="version-skills-input"
                      className="vault-input"
                      value={versionSkills}
                      placeholder="React, TypeScript, GraphQL"
                      onChange={(e) => setVersionSkills(e.target.value)}
                    />
                    <span className="vault-field-hint">Comma-separated tags for this version.</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="vault-form-field">
                  <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="version-desc-input">
                    Version Changes / Summary
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="version-desc-input"
                    className="vault-textarea"
                    rows={2}
                    value={versionDescription}
                    placeholder="e.g. Added Q3 leadership accomplishments, updated metrics, and refined architecture section..."
                    onChange={(e) => setVersionDescription(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div
                  style={{
                    padding: '12px',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    background: 'var(--surface-muted)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--line)',
                  }}
                >
                  <label
                    style={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: '10px',
                      fontSize: '13px',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      fontWeight: 550,
                      color: 'var(--ink)',
                    }}
                  >
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={isVersionCurrent}
                      onChange={(e) => setIsVersionCurrent(e.target.checked)}
                      style={{ width: '16px', height: '16px', accentColor: 'var(--accent)' }}
                    />
                    <span>Set as the active / current version for this group</span>
                  </label>
                  <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 26px', fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                    Active versions are automatically recommended when attaching resumes to applications.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="vault-modal-footer">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="button button-secondary"
                  onClick={() => !isSubmittingVersion && setActiveUploadGroupId(null)}
                  disabled={isSubmittingVersion}
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="button button-primary"
                  disabled={isSubmittingVersion || !versionFile}
                  style={{ minWidth: '130px' }}
                >
                  <Sparkles size={14} />
                  <span>{isSubmittingVersion ? 'Uploading Version…' : 'Save Version'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Preview Modal */}
      {activePreviewFile && (
        <VaultFileDetailModal
          file={activePreviewFile}
          onClose={() => setActivePreviewFile(null)}
          onUpdate={(updated) => setActivePreviewFile(updated)}
          onDelete={() => {
            setActivePreviewFile(null)
            loadResumeGroups()
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react'
import {
  Download,
  Trash2,
  X,
  FileText,
  HardDrive,
  Calendar,
  Building2,
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  Check,
  Tag,
  Clock,
  FileType,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { vaultApi } from '../../lib/vaultApi'
import { useAuth } from '../../context/auth-context'
import { useCareerData } from '../../context/useCareerData'
import type { VaultFile, VaultFileCategory } from '../../types'

interface VaultFileDetailModalProps {
  file: VaultFile
  onClose: () => void
  onUpdate: (updated: VaultFile) => void
  onDelete: (deletedId: string) => void
}

export function VaultFileDetailModal({
  file,
  onClose,
  onUpdate,
  onDelete,
}: VaultFileDetailModalProps) {
  const auth = useAuth()
  const token = auth.session?.access_token
  const { data } = useCareerData()

  const companies = data?.companies || []
  const applications = data?.applications || []

  const initialCompanyId = file.companyDocuments?.[0]?.companyId || ''
  const initialAppId = file.applicationDocuments?.[0]?.applicationId || ''

  const [category, setCategory] = useState<VaultFileCategory>(file.category)
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState(file.displayName)
  const [description, setDescription] = useState(file.description || '')
  const [tags, setTags] = useState(file.tags?.join(', ') || '')
  const [companyId, setCompanyId] = useState(initialCompanyId)
  const [applicationId, setApplicationId] = useState(initialAppId)

  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false)
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false)
  const [isDownloading, setIsDownloading] = useState(false)
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState('')

  const isPdf = file.extension === '.pdf'
  const isImage = ['.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.webp'].includes(file.extension)
  const isText = file.extension === '.txt'
  const canPreview = isPdf || isImage || isText

  const fileUrl = `/api/vault/files/${file.id}/content${token ? `?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}` : ''}`

  const formatBytes = (bytes: number) => {
    if (!bytes || bytes === 0) return '0 B'
    const mb = bytes / (1024 * 1024)
    if (mb < 1) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB (${bytes.toLocaleString()} bytes)`
    return `${mb.toFixed(2)} MB (${bytes.toLocaleString()} bytes)`
  }

  const handleDownload = async () => {
    setIsDownloading(true)
    try {
      await vaultApi.downloadFile(file.id, file.originalFilename || file.displayName, token)
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to download file.')
    } finally {
      setIsDownloading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Move "${file.displayName}" to trash?`)) return
    setIsDeleting(true)
    try {
      await vaultApi.deleteFile(file.id, false, false, token)
      onDelete(file.id)
      onClose()
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to delete file.')
      setIsDeleting(false)
    }
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setIsSaving(true)
    setErrorMessage('')

    try {
      const tagList = tags.split(',').map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      const updated = await vaultApi.updateFile(
        file.id,
        {
          displayName: displayName.trim() || file.originalFilename,
          description: description.trim() || null,
          category,
          tags: tagList,
          companyId: companyId ? companyId : null,
          applicationId: applicationId ? applicationId : null,
        },
        token,
      )

      onUpdate(updated)
      onClose()
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Failed to update file.')
      setIsSaving(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="vault-modal-scrim" onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
      <div className="vault-modal large" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="file-detail-title">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="vault-modal-header">
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '12px', minWidth: 0 }}>
            <span className="vault-ext-badge" style={{ fontSize: '12px', padding: '6px 8px' }}>
              {file.extension.replace('.', '')}
            </span>
            <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
              <h2
                id="file-detail-title"
                style={{
                  fontSize: '16px',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  color: 'var(--ink)',
                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                  maxWidth: '480px',
                }}
              >
                {file.displayName}
              </h2>
              <div style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: '11px', marginTop: '1px' }}>
                {file.originalFilename}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="button button-secondary"
              style={{ height: '32px', fontSize: '12px', gap: '6px' }}
              onClick={handleDownload}
              disabled={isDownloading}
              title="Download file"
            >
              <Download size={13} />
              <span>{isDownloading ? 'Downloading…' : 'Download'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="button button-secondary"
              style={{ height: '32px', padding: '0 10px', color: '#e11d48' }}
              onClick={handleDelete}
              disabled={isDeleting}
              title="Move file to trash"
            >
              <Trash2 size={14} />
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="row-action-button"
              aria-label="Close dialog"
              onClick={onClose}
              style={{ width: '32px', height: '32px' }}
            >
              <X size={17} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Form Wrap */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}>
          {/* Main Content: Left Preview & Right Details */}
          <div className="vault-detail-modal-layout">

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import {
  UploadCloud,
  FileText,
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  HardDrive,
  RefreshCw,
  Eye,
  Download,
  Plus,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { vaultApi } from '../../lib/vaultApi'
import { useAuth } from '../../context/auth-context'
import type { ResumeGroup, StorageSummary, VaultFile, JobDescription } from '../../types'
import { VaultFileDetailModal } from './VaultFileDetailModal'

interface VaultOverviewProps {
  onNavigateTab: (tab: 'resumes' | 'jobs' | 'all' | 'trash') => void
  onOpenUpload: () => void
  onOpenNewResumeGroup: () => void
  onOpenNewJobDescription?: () => void
}

export function VaultOverview({
  onNavigateTab,
  onOpenUpload,
  onOpenNewResumeGroup,
}: VaultOverviewProps) {
  const auth = useAuth()
  const token = auth.session?.access_token

  const [storage, setStorage] = useState<StorageSummary | null>(null)
  const [recentFiles, setRecentFiles] = useState<VaultFile[]>([])
  const [resumeGroups, setResumeGroups] = useState<ResumeGroup[]>([])
  const [jobDescriptions, setJobDescriptions] = useState<JobDescription[]>([])
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true)
  const [isReconciling, setIsReconciling] = useState(false)
  const [activeFile, setActiveFile] = useState<VaultFile | null>(null)

  const loadData = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      const [storageRes, filesRes, resumesRes, jdsRes] = await Promise.all([
        vaultApi.getStorageSummary(token),
        vaultApi.getFiles({ limit: 6, sortBy: 'recently_uploaded', token }),
        vaultApi.getResumeGroups(false, token),
        vaultApi.getJobDescriptions(token),
      ])
      setStorage(storageRes)
      setRecentFiles(filesRes.files)
      setResumeGroups(resumesRes)
      setJobDescriptions(jdsRes.slice(0, 4))
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load Vault overview data', err)
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData()
  }, [token])

  const handleReconcile = async () => {
    setIsReconciling(true)
    try {
      const result = await vaultApi.reconcileStorage(token)
      setStorage(result.summary)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Reconciliation failed', err)
    } finally {
      setIsReconciling(false)
    }
  }

  const formatBytes = (bytes: number) => {
    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B'
    const mb = bytes / (1024 * 1024)
    if (mb < 1) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`
    return `${mb.toFixed(1)} MB`
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '24px' }}>
      {/* Storage Summary Banner */}
      <div className="vault-storage-banner">
        <div className="vault-storage-info">
          <div className="vault-storage-title">
            <HardDrive size={18} style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }} />
            <span>Vault Storage Allowance</span>
          </div>

          <div className="vault-progress-track">
            <div
              className={`vault-progress-bar ${(storage?.usagePercentage || 0) > 85 ? 'danger' : (storage?.usagePercentage || 0) > 70 ? 'warning' : ''}`}
              style={{ width: `${storage?.usagePercentage || 0}%` }}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="vault-storage-stats">
            <span>
              <strong>{formatBytes(storage?.usedBytes || 0)}</strong> of {formatBytes(storage?.totalQuotaBytes || 0)} used ({storage?.usagePercentage || 0}%)
            </span>
            <span>•</span>
            <span><strong>{storage?.fileCount || 0}</strong> active career files</span>
            <span>•</span>
            <span>Max single upload: {formatBytes(storage?.maxFileSizeBytes || 20971520)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="vault-storage-actions">
          <button
            className="button button-secondary"
            style={{ fontSize: '12px', height: '34px' }}
            onClick={handleReconcile}
            disabled={isReconciling}
            title="Recalculate storage usage"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={13} className={isReconciling ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
            <span>Reconcile</span>
          </button>
          <button className="button button-primary" style={{ fontSize: '12px', height: '34px' }} onClick={onOpenUpload}>
            <UploadCloud size={14} /> Upload File
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Quick Action Tiles */}
      <div className="vault-quick-grid">
        <div className="vault-action-card" onClick={onOpenUpload} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
          <div className="vault-action-icon">
            <UploadCloud size={20} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3>Upload Documents</h3>
            <p>Add PDFs, DOCX, certifications, cover letters, or portfolio artifacts.</p>
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--accent)' }}>Upload new file →</span>
        </div>

        <div className="vault-action-card" onClick={() => onNavigateTab('resumes')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
          <div className="vault-action-icon" style={{ background: '#ecfdf5', color: '#059669' }}>
            <FileText size={20} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3>Resume Vault ({resumeGroups.length})</h3>
            <p>Maintain immutable version history tailored for specific job profiles.</p>
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#059669' }}>Manage versions →</span>
        </div>

        <div className="vault-action-card" onClick={() => onNavigateTab('jobs')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
          <div className="vault-action-icon" style={{ background: '#fffbeb', color: '#d97706' }}>

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { Search, FileText, Building2, Briefcase } from 'lucide-react'
import { intelligenceApi } from '../../lib/intelligenceApi'
import { vaultApi } from '../../lib/vaultApi'
import type { DocumentSearchResultItem } from '../../lib/intelligence/types'
import type { VaultFile } from '../../types'
import { VaultFileDetailModal } from './VaultFileDetailModal'

export function VaultSearchSection() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('ALL')
  const [results, setResults] = useState<DocumentSearchResultItem[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<VaultFile | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      handleSearch()
    }, 250)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [query, category])

  const handleSearch = async () => {
    if (!query.trim() && category === 'ALL') {
      setResults([])
      return
    }

    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const response = await intelligenceApi.searchDocuments({
        query: query.trim(),
        category: category !== 'ALL' ? category : undefined,
      })
      setResults(response.items || [])
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Search error:', err)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleOpenFile = async (fileId: string) => {
    try {
      const file = await vaultApi.getFile(fileId)
      setSelectedFile(file)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load file details:', err)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
      {/* Search Bar & Category Filter */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <div
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '8px',
            padding: '8px 12px',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            background: 'var(--surface)',
            border: '1px solid var(--line)',
          }}
        >
          <Search size={15} style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }} />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search documents by filename, tags, or content inside files (e.g. 'React', 'Spring Boot', 'Kafka')..."
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            style={{
              border: 'none',
              background: 'transparent',
              outline: 'none',
              width: '100%',
              fontSize: '13px',
              color: 'var(--ink)',
            }}
          />
        </div>

        <select
          value={category}
          onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
          className="vault-input"
          style={{ width: '160px', height: '36px', fontSize: '12px' }}
        >
          <option value="ALL">All Categories</option>
          <option value="RESUME">Resumes</option>
          <option value="JOB_DESCRIPTION">Job Descriptions</option>
          <option value="COVER_LETTER">Cover Letters</option>
          <option value="PORTFOLIO">Portfolio</option>
          <option value="CERTIFICATE">Certificates</option>
          <option value="SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT">Supporting Docs</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* Results Dropdown / Container */}
      {(results.length > 0 || loading || (query.trim() && !loading)) && (
        <div

              No documents matched "{query}".

              <div
                style={{
                  padding: '8px 12px',
                  fontSize: '11px',
                  color: 'var(--muted)',
                  borderBottom: '1px solid var(--line)',
                  background: 'var(--surface-muted)',
                }}
              >
                Found {results.length} matching document{results.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
              </div>

              {results.map((item) => (
                <div
                  key={item.id}
                  onClick={() => handleOpenFile(item.id)}
                  style={{
                    padding: '10px 14px',
                    borderBottom: '1px solid var(--line)',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    gap: '4px',
                    transition: 'background 0.15s ease',
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'var(--surface-muted)')}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'transparent')}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                      <FileText size={15} style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }} />
                      <strong style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--ink)' }}>{item.displayName}</strong>
                      <span
                        style={{
                          fontSize: '10px',
                          padding: '1px 6px',
                          borderRadius: '4px',
                          background: 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1)',
                          color: 'var(--accent)',
                        }}
                      >
                        {item.category}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                      {item.matchHighlights.map((hl) => (
                        <span
                          key={hl}
                          style={{
                            fontSize: '10px',
                            padding: '1px 6px',
                            borderRadius: '4px',
                            background: hl === 'Document Content' ? '#fef3c7' : 'var(--surface-muted)',
                            color: hl === 'Document Content' ? '#92400e' : 'var(--muted)',
                            fontWeight: hl === 'Document Content' ? 600 : 400,
                          }}
                        >
                          {hl}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {item.snippet && (
                    <div
                      style={{
                        fontSize: '11px',
                        color: 'var(--muted)',
                        background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.02)',
                        padding: '4px 8px',
                        borderRadius: '4px',
                        fontStyle: 'italic',
                      }}
                    >
                      "{item.snippet}"
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '12px', fontSize: '10px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                    {item.companyName && (
                      <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '4px' }}>
                        <Building2 size={11} /> {item.companyName}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {item.jobTitle && (
                      <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '4px' }}>
                        <Briefcase size={11} /> {item.jobTitle}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span>{(item.fileSizeBytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {selectedFile && (
        <VaultFileDetailModal
          file={selectedFile}
          onClose={() => setSelectedFile(null)}
          onUpdate={(u) => setSelectedFile(u)}
          onDelete={() => {
            setSelectedFile(null)
            handleSearch()
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { Trash2, RotateCcw, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react'
import { vaultApi } from '../../lib/vaultApi'
import { useAuth } from '../../context/auth-context'
import type { VaultFile } from '../../types'

export function VaultTrashPage() {
  const auth = useAuth()
  const token = auth.session?.access_token

  const [trashedFiles, setTrashedFiles] = useState<VaultFile[]>([])
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true)

  const loadTrash = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      const res = await vaultApi.getFiles({ status: 'TRASHED', token })
      setTrashedFiles(res.files)
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load trash', err)
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadTrash()
  }, [token])

  const handleRestore = async (file: VaultFile) => {
    try {
      await vaultApi.restoreFile(file.id, token)
      setTrashedFiles((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== file.id))
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to restore file')
    }
  }

  const handlePermanentDelete = async (file: VaultFile) => {
    if (
      !window.confirm(
        `Permanently delete "${file.displayName}"? This will erase the file from storage and cannot be undone.`,
      )
    ) {
      return
    }

    try {
      await vaultApi.deleteFile(file.id, true, true, token)
      setTrashedFiles((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== file.id))
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to permanently delete file')
    }
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '16px' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          padding: '14px 18px',
          background: 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25)',
          borderRadius: '10px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '10px',
          color: 'var(--ink)',
          fontSize: '13px',
        }}
      >
        <AlertTriangle size={18} style={{ color: '#d97706', flexShrink: 0 }} />
        <span>Items in trash do not consume active user quota and can be restored anytime before permanent deletion.</span>
      </div>

      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="directory-empty" style={{ padding: '32px' }}>Loading trash items…</div>
      ) : trashedFiles.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="vault-table-container">
          <table className="vault-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Document</th>
                <th>Category</th>
                <th>Deleted On</th>
                <th style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {trashedFiles.map((file) => (
                <tr key={file.id}>
                  <td>
                    <div className="vault-file-title-cell">
                      <span className="vault-ext-badge">{file.extension.replace('.', '')}</span>
                      <div>
                        <strong style={{ color: 'var(--ink)' }}>{file.displayName}</strong>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{file.originalFilename}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <span className={`vault-badge ${file.category.toLowerCase()}`}>
                      {file.category.replace('_', ' ')}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>{file.deletedAt ? new Date(file.deletedAt).toLocaleDateString() : '—'}</td>
                  <td style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: '8px' }}>
                      <button
                        className="button button-secondary"
                        style={{ height: '30px', fontSize: '11px', padding: '0 10px' }}
                        onClick={() => handleRestore(file)}
                      >
                        <RotateCcw size={12} /> Restore
                      </button>
                      <button
                        className="row-delete-button"
                        title="Permanently Delete"
                        onClick={() => handlePermanentDelete(file)}
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={14} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="directory-empty" style={{ padding: '48px 24px' }}>
          <Trash2 size={36} style={{ color: 'var(--subtle)', margin: '0 auto 10px' }} />
          <h3>Trash is Empty</h3>
          <p>Files you remove from your Vault will appear here before permanent deletion.</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: src/components/vault/VaultUploadDialog.tsx

import { useState, useRef, type FormEvent, type DragEvent } from 'react'
import { UploadCloud, X, AlertCircle, Check } from 'lucide-react'
import { vaultApi } from '../../lib/vaultApi'
import { intelligenceApi } from '../../lib/intelligenceApi'
import { useAuth } from '../../context/auth-context'
import { useCareerData } from '../../context/useCareerData'
import type { VaultFile, VaultFileCategory } from '../../types'
import type { DuplicateFileCheckResult } from '../../lib/intelligence/types'

interface VaultUploadDialogProps {
  initialCategory?: VaultFileCategory
  initialCompanyId?: string
  initialApplicationId?: string
  onClose: () => void
  onSuccess: (file: VaultFile) => void
}

export function VaultUploadDialog({
  initialCategory = 'OTHER',
  initialCompanyId,
  initialApplicationId,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: VaultUploadDialogProps) {
  const auth = useAuth()
  const { data } = useCareerData()
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<File | null>(null)
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<VaultFileCategory>(initialCategory)
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState('')
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
  const [tags, setTags] = useState('')
  const [companyId, setCompanyId] = useState(initialCompanyId || '')
  const [applicationId, setApplicationId] = useState(initialApplicationId || '')
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false)
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState('')
  const [duplicateWarning, setDuplicateWarning] = useState<DuplicateFileCheckResult['existingFile'] | null>(null)
  const [forceNewUpload, setForceNewUpload] = useState(false)
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  const token = auth.session?.access_token

  const handleFile = (file: File) => {
    setSelectedFile(file)
    setDuplicateWarning(null)
    setForceNewUpload(false)

    // Pre-check for duplicate content hash
    intelligenceApi
      .checkDuplicateFile(file, token)
      .then((res) => {
        if (res.isDuplicate && res.existingFile) {
          setDuplicateWarning(res.existingFile)
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {})

    if (!displayName) {
      // Pre-fill displayName with clean filename without extension
      const nameWithoutExt = file.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '').replace(/_/g, ' ')
      setDisplayName(nameWithoutExt)
    }

    // Auto-detect category from filename if currently OTHER
    const lower = file.name.toLowerCase()
    if (category === 'OTHER' || initialCategory === 'OTHER') {
      if (lower.includes('resume') || lower.includes('cv')) {
        setCategory('RESUME')
      } else if (lower.includes('job') || lower.includes('description') || lower.includes('jd')) {
        setCategory('JOB_DESCRIPTION')
      } else if (lower.includes('cover')) {
        setCategory('COVER_LETTER')
      } else if (lower.includes('portfolio')) {
        setCategory('PORTFOLIO')
      } else if (lower.includes('cert')) {
        setCategory('CERTIFICATE')
      }
    }
  }

  const handleReuseExisting = async () => {
    if (!duplicateWarning) return
    setIsSubmitting(true)
    try {
      const existing = await vaultApi.getFile(duplicateWarning.id, token)
      onSuccess(existing)
      onClose()
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Failed to reuse existing file.')
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  const handleDragOver = (e: DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setIsDragging(true)
  }

  const handleDragLeave = () => {
    setIsDragging(false)
  }

  const handleDrop = (e: DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setIsDragging(false)
    if (e.dataTransfer.files?.[0]) {
      handleFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0])
    }
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!selectedFile) {
      setErrorMessage('Please select a file to upload.')
      return
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true)
    setErrorMessage('')

    try {
      const tagList = tags.split(',').map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      const uploaded = await vaultApi.uploadFile(selectedFile, {
        displayName: displayName.trim() || selectedFile.name,
        category,
        description: description.trim() || undefined,
        tags: tagList,
        companyId: companyId || undefined,
        applicationId: applicationId || undefined,
        token,
      })

      onSuccess(uploaded)
      onClose()
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Failed to upload file.')
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="vault-modal-scrim" onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && !isSubmitting && onClose()}>
      <div className="vault-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="upload-dialog-title">
        <div className="vault-modal-header">
          <div>
            <h2 id="upload-dialog-title">Upload to Vault</h2>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: '2px' }}>
              Files are securely encrypted and privately stored in your career vault.
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action-button"
            aria-label="Close"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
          <div className="vault-modal-body">
            {errorMessage && (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: '8px',
                  padding: '10px 14px',
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  background: '#fef2f2',
                  color: '#b91c1c',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  border: '1px solid #fecaca',
                }}
              >
                <AlertCircle size={15} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
                <span>{errorMessage}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {duplicateWarning && !forceNewUpload && (
              <div
                style={{
                  padding: '12px 14px',
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  background: '#fef3c7',
                  border: '1px solid #fde68a',
                  color: '#92400e',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: 'column',
                  gap: '8px',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: '8px' }}>
                  <AlertCircle size={16} style={{ flexShrink: 0, marginTop: '1px' }} />
                  <div>
                    <strong>Duplicate Content Detected:</strong> This file is already stored in your Vault as "<strong>{duplicateWarning.displayName}</strong>" (uploaded {new Date(duplicateWarning.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}).
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="button button-secondary"
                    style={{ fontSize: '11px', height: '28px', padding: '0 10px' }}
                    onClick={() => setForceNewUpload(true)}
                  >
                    Upload as New Copy
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="button button-primary"
                    style={{ fontSize: '11px', height: '28px', padding: '0 10px' }}
                    onClick={handleReuseExisting}
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                  >
                    <Check size={13} /> Reuse Existing File
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Dropzone */}
            <div
              className={`vault-dropzone ${isDragging ? 'dragging' : ''}`}
              onDragOver={handleDragOver}
              onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
              onDrop={handleDrop}
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            >
              <div className="vault-dropzone-icon">
                <UploadCloud size={24} />
              </div>
              {selectedFile ? (
                <div>
                  <strong style={{ color: 'var(--ink)', fontSize: '13px' }}>{selectedFile.name}</strong>
                  <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                    {(selectedFile.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB — Click or drop another file to change
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div>
                  <p style={{ margin: 0, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--ink)', fontSize: '13px' }}>
                    Click to upload or drag and drop
                  </p>
                  <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                    PDF, DOCX, DOC, TXT, PNG, JPG, WEBP (Up to 20 MB)
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
              <input
                ref={fileInputRef}
                type="file"
                style={{ display: 'none' }}
                accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.txt,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.webp"
                onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && handleFile(e.target.files[0])}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Category */}
            <div className="vault-form-field">
              <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="upload-category">
                Document Category <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>*</span>
              </label>
              <select
                id="upload-category"
                className="vault-select-full"
                value={category}
                onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value as VaultFileCategory)}
              >
                <option value="RESUME">Resume</option>
                <option value="JOB_DESCRIPTION">Job Description</option>
                <option value="COVER_LETTER">Cover Letter</option>
                <option value="PORTFOLIO">Portfolio</option>
                <option value="CERTIFICATE">Certificate</option>
                <option value="SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT">Supporting Document</option>
                <option value="OTHER">Other</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Display Name */}
            <div className="vault-form-field">
              <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="upload-display-name">
                Display Name
              </label>
              <input
                id="upload-display-name"
                className="vault-input"
                value={displayName}
                placeholder="e.g. Frontend Lead Resume (2026)"
                onChange={(e) => setDisplayName(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Description */}
            <div className="vault-form-field">
              <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="upload-description">
                Description / Notes
              </label>
              <textarea
                id="upload-description"
                className="vault-textarea"
                rows={2}
                value={description}
                placeholder="Optional notes or context about this document..."
                onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Tags */}
            <div className="vault-form-field">
              <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="upload-tags">
                Tags (comma-separated)
              </label>
              <input
                id="upload-tags"
                className="vault-input"
                value={tags}
                placeholder="Resume, Staff Role, Q1 Target"
                onChange={(e) => setTags(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Associations */}
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr))', gap: '12px' }}>
              <div className="vault-form-field">
                <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="upload-company">
                  Link to Company
                </label>
                <select
                  id="upload-company"
                  className="vault-select-full"
                  value={companyId}
                  onChange={(e) => setCompanyId(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="">(None)</option>
                  {data?.companies?.map((c) => (
                    <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                      {c.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="vault-form-field">
                <label className="vault-field-label" htmlFor="upload-application">
                  Link to Application
                </label>
                <select
                  id="upload-application"
                  className="vault-select-full"
                  value={applicationId}
                  onChange={(e) => setApplicationId(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="">(None)</option>
                  {data?.applications?.map((a) => {
                    const comp = data.companies?.find((c) => c.id === a.companyId)
                    return (
                      <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>
                        {a.jobTitle} {comp ? `(${comp.name})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    )
                  })}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

              onClick={onClose}

  )

    id: z.string(), title: z.string(), eventType: z.string(), companyId: z.string(),
    startsAt: z.string(), location: z.string(), endsAt: z.string(), meetingUrl: z.string(),
    notes: z.string(), contactId: z.string(), applicationId: z.string(),
  })),
  activities: z.array(z.object({
    id: z.string(), type: z.string(), description: z.string(), occurredAt: z.string(),
    companyId: z.string(), contactId: z.string(), applicationId: z.string(),
  })),
})

async function responseError(response: Response) {
  try {
    return new ApiResponseError(apiErrorMessage(await readJsonBody(response), `The server request failed (${response.status}).`), response.status)
  } catch {
    return new ApiResponseError(`The server request failed (${response.status}) with an unreadable error response.`, response.status)
  }
}

function requestFailureMessage(error: unknown, operation: 'load' | 'save') {
  if (error instanceof TypeError) {
    return operation === 'save'
      ? 'CareerOS could not confirm whether your changes were saved. Refresh the workspace before resubmitting.'
      : 'CareerOS could not reach the API. Check that the backend is running, then try again.'
  }
  if (error instanceof Error) return error.message
  return operation === 'load'
    ? 'CareerOS could not load your workspace data. Try again.'
    : 'CareerOS could not save your workspace changes. Try again.'
}

async function loadCareerData(token: string): Promise<CareerData> {
  const response = await fetch('/api/data', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
  if (!response.ok) throw await responseError(response)
  const payload = await readJsonBody(response)
  const parsed = apiDataSchema.safeParse(payload)
  if (!parsed.success) throw new Error('The server returned data in an unsupported format.')
  return parsed.data
}

function requestBody(type: RecordType, fields: Record<string, string>, extra?: Record<string, boolean>) {
  const output: Record<string, string | boolean> = { ...fields, ...extra }
  if (type === 'event') {
    for (const field of ['startsAt', 'endsAt']) {
      const value = fields[field]
      if (value) {
        const date = new Date(value)
        if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) throw new RangeError(`Cannot save an invalid ${field} value.`)
        output[field] = date.toISOString()
      }
    }
  }
  return output
}

export function ApiCareerDataProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const auth = useAuth()
  const [data, setData] = useState<CareerData>(emptyData)
  const [loadedToken, setLoadedToken] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loadRequest, setLoadRequest] = useState(0)
  const [completedLoadRequest, setCompletedLoadRequest] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [mutationCount, setMutationCount] = useState(0)
  const [dataErrorState, setDataErrorState] = useState<{
    token: string
    message: string
    retry: 'load' | 'mutation' | 'refresh'
  } | null>(null)
  const generation = useRef(0)
  const latestDataRequest = useRef(0)
  const failedMutation = useRef<{ token: string; path: string; method: 'POST' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE'; body?: Record<string, string | boolean> } | null>(null)
  const token = auth.user ? auth.session?.access_token : undefined
  const dataLoading = Boolean(token && (loadedToken !== token || completedLoadRequest !== loadRequest)) || mutationCount > 0
  const visibleData = token && loadedToken === token ? data : emptyData
  const dataError = token && dataErrorState?.token === token ? dataErrorState.message : ''
  const dataRetryLabel: CareerDataContextValue['dataRetryLabel'] = token && dataErrorState?.token === token
    ? dataErrorState.retry === 'mutation' ? 'Retry request' : dataErrorState.retry === 'refresh' ? 'Refresh workspace' : 'Try again'
    : 'Try again'

  const reload = useCallback(async (accessToken: string, version: number) => {
    const requestId = ++latestDataRequest.current
    let currentData: CareerData
    try {
      currentData = await loadCareerData(accessToken)
    } catch (error) {
      if (version === generation.current && requestId === latestDataRequest.current) throw error
      return
    }
    if (version === generation.current && requestId === latestDataRequest.current) {
      setData(currentData)
      setLoadedToken(accessToken)
      setDataErrorState(null)
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const version = ++generation.current
    const request = loadRequest
    if (!token) return
    void reload(token, version)
      .then(() => {
        if (version === generation.current) setCompletedLoadRequest(request)
      })
      .catch((error: unknown) => {
        if (version === generation.current) {
          setData(emptyData)
          setDataErrorState({
            token,
            message: requestFailureMessage(error, 'load'),
            retry: 'load',
          })
          setLoadedToken(token)
          setCompletedLoadRequest(request)
        }
      })
    return () => { generation.current += 1 }
  }, [loadRequest, reload, token])

  const mutate = useCallback((path: string, method: 'POST' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE', body?: Record<string, string | boolean>) => {
    if (!token) {
      setDataErrorState({ token: '', message: 'Your session is no longer available. Sign in again to continue.', retry: 'refresh' })
      return
    }
    const version = generation.current
    setMutationCount((count) => count + 1)
    void (async () => {
      const response = await fetch(path, {
        method,
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          ...(body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
        },
        ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}),
      })
      if (!response.ok) throw await responseError(response)
      failedMutation.current = null
      await reload(token, version)
    })().catch((error: unknown) => {
      if (version === generation.current) {
        failedMutation.current = error instanceof ApiResponseError && error.status < 500
          ? { token, path, method, body }
          : null
        setDataErrorState({
          token,
          message: requestFailureMessage(error, 'save'),
          retry: error instanceof ApiResponseError && error.status < 500 ? 'mutation' : 'refresh',
        })
      }
    }).finally(() => {
      setMutationCount((count) => Math.max(0, count - 1))
    })
  }, [reload, token])

  const value = useMemo(() => ({
    data: visibleData,
    dataLoading,
    dataError,
    dataRetryLabel,
    addRecord: (type: RecordType, fields: Record<string, string>) => {
      try {
        mutate(`/api/data/${type}`, 'POST', requestBody(type, fields))
      } catch (error) {
        setDataErrorState({ token: token ?? '', message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not save this record.', retry: 'refresh' })
      }
    },
    updateRecord: (type: RecordType, id: string, fields: Record<string, string>) => {
      try {
        mutate(`/api/data/${type}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, 'PATCH', requestBody(type, fields))
      } catch (error) {
        setDataErrorState({ token: token ?? '', message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not save this record.', retry: 'refresh' })
      }
    },
    deleteRecord: (type: RecordType, id: string) => mutate(`/api/data/${type}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, 'DELETE'),
    retryDataLoad: () => {
      const failed = failedMutation.current
      if (failed && failed.token === token) {
        failedMutation.current = null
        setDataErrorState(null)
        mutate(failed.path, failed.method, failed.body)
        return
      }
      setDataErrorState(null)
      setLoadRequest((request) => request + 1)
    },
    toggleTask: (id: string) => {
      const task = visibleData.tasks.find((item) => item.id === id)
      if (!task) {
        setDataErrorState({ token: token ?? '', message: 'That task is no longer available. Refresh your workspace and try again.', retry: 'refresh' })
        return
      }
      mutate(`/api/data/task/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, 'PATCH', {
        title: task.title, companyId: task.companyId, dueAt: task.dueAt, priority: task.priority,
        done: !task.done, description: task.description, contactId: task.contactId,
        applicationId: task.applicationId, category: task.category,
      })
    },
  }), [dataError, dataLoading, dataRetryLabel, mutate, token, visibleData])

  return <CareerDataContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</CareerDataContext.Provider>
}

import { createContext, useContext } from 'react'
import type { Session } from '@supabase/supabase-js'

export interface ApplicationUser {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
}

export interface AuthContextValue {
  session: Session | null
  user: ApplicationUser | null
  loading: boolean
  provisioning: boolean
  authError: string
  provisioningError: string
  dataMode: 'demo' | 'api'
  signUp: (name: string, email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>
  signIn: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>
  requestPasswordReset: (email: string) => Promise<void>
  updatePassword: (password: string) => Promise<void>
  updateDisplayName: (name: string) => Promise<void>
  signOut: () => Promise<void>
  retryProvisioning: () => void
}

export const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | null>(null)

export function useAuth() {
  const value = useContext(AuthContext)
  if (!value) {
    return {
      session: null,
      user: null,
      loading: false,
      provisioning: false,
      authError: '',
      provisioningError: '',
      dataMode: 'demo' as const,
      signUp: async () => {},
      signIn: async () => {},
      requestPasswordReset: async () => {},
      updatePassword: async () => {},
      updateDisplayName: async () => {},
      signOut: async () => {},
      retryProvisioning: () => {},
    }
  }
  return value
}
