function authHeader(token?: string): Record<string, string> {
  return token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}
}

export const vaultApi = {
  async getFiles(params: {
    category?: string
    status?: string
    search?: string
    extension?: string
    page?: number
    limit?: number
    sortBy?: string
    token?: string
  }): Promise<{ files: VaultFile[]; pagination: { page: number; limit: number; total: number; totalPages: number } }> {
    if (getDataMode() === 'demo') {
      const files = demoVaultStore.getFiles({
        category: params.category,
        status: params.status,
        search: params.search,
      })
      return {
        files,
        pagination: { page: 1, limit: 50, total: files.length, totalPages: 1 },
      }
    }

    const query = new URLSearchParams()
    if (params.category) query.set('category', params.category)
    if (params.status) query.set('status', params.status)
    if (params.search) query.set('search', params.search)
    if (params.extension) query.set('extension', params.extension)
    if (params.page) query.set('page', String(params.page))
    if (params.limit) query.set('limit', String(params.limit))
    if (params.sortBy) query.set('sortBy', params.sortBy)

    const response = await fetch(`/api/vault/files?${query.toString()}`, {
      headers: authHeader(params.token),
    })
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch files: ${response.statusText}`)
    return response.json()
  },

  async getFile(id: string, token?: string): Promise<VaultFile> {
    if (getDataMode() === 'demo') {
      const file = demoVaultStore.getFile(id)
      if (!file) throw new Error('File not found')
      return file
    }

    const response = await fetch(`/api/vault/files/${id}`, {
      headers: authHeader(token),
    })
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch file: ${response.statusText}`)
    return response.json()
  },

  async uploadFile(
    file: File,
    metadata: {
      displayName?: string
      category?: string
      description?: string
      tags?: string[]
      companyId?: string
      applicationId?: string
      documentRole?: string
      token?: string
    },
  ): Promise<VaultFile> {
    if (getDataMode() === 'demo') {
      return demoVaultStore.uploadFile(file, {
        displayName: metadata.displayName,
        category: metadata.category as any,
        description: metadata.description,
        tags: metadata.tags,
      })
    }

    const formData = new FormData()
    if (metadata.category) formData.append('category', metadata.category)
    if (metadata.displayName) formData.append('displayName', metadata.displayName)
    if (metadata.description) formData.append('description', metadata.description)
    if (metadata.tags && metadata.tags.length > 0) formData.append('tags', metadata.tags.join(', '))
    if (metadata.companyId) formData.append('companyId', metadata.companyId)
    if (metadata.applicationId) formData.append('applicationId', metadata.applicationId)
    if (metadata.documentRole) formData.append('documentRole', metadata.documentRole)
    formData.append('file', file)

    const response = await fetch('/api/vault/files/upload', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: authHeader(metadata.token),
      body: formData,
    })
    if (!response.ok) {
      const body = await readJsonBody(response).catch(() => undefined)
      throw new Error(apiErrorMessage(body, `Upload failed with status ${response.status}`))
    }
    return await readJsonBody(response) as VaultFile
  },

  async updateFile(
    id: string,
    patch: {
      displayName?: string
      description?: string | null
      category?: string
      tags?: string[]
      companyId?: string | null
      applicationId?: string | null
    },
    token?: string,
  ): Promise<VaultFile> {

    }

    const response = await fetch(`/api/vault/files/${id}`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: {

        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(patch),
    })
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to update file')
    return response.json()
  },

      demoVaultStore.deleteFile(id, permanent)
      return
    }

    const query = new URLSearchParams()
    if (permanent) query.set('permanent', 'true')
    if (force) query.set('force', 'true')

    const response = await fetch(`/api/vault/files/${id}?${query.toString()}`, {
      method: 'DELETE',
      headers: authHeader(token),
    })
    if (!response.ok) {
      const err = await response.json().catch(() => ({}))
      throw new Error(err.error?.message || 'Failed to delete file')
    }
  },

  async restoreFile(id: string, token?: string): Promise<VaultFile> {

  },

  async getDownloadUrl(id: string, token?: string): Promise<string> {
    if (getDataMode() === 'demo') {
      return `/api/vault/files/${id}/content?download=true`
    }
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/vault/files/${id}/download-url`, {
        headers: authHeader(token),
      })
      if (response.ok) {
        const body = await response.json()
        if (body.downloadUrl) return body.downloadUrl
      }
    } catch {
      // Fallback
    }
    return `/api/vault/files/${id}/download${token ? `?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}` : ''}`
  },

  async downloadFile(id: string, fallbackFilename?: string, token?: string): Promise<void> {
    const downloadUrl = await this.getDownloadUrl(id, token)
    const anchor = document.createElement('a')
    anchor.href = downloadUrl
    if (fallbackFilename) {
      anchor.download = fallbackFilename
    }
    anchor.target = '_blank'
    anchor.rel = 'noopener noreferrer'
    document.body.appendChild(anchor)
    anchor.click()
    document.body.removeChild(anchor)
  },

import type {
  CompanyResource,
  JobDescription,
  ResumeGroup,

// In-memory persistent state for demo mode
let demoFiles = [...initialFiles]
let demoResumeGroups = [...initialResumeGroups]
let demoJobDescriptions = [...initialJobDescriptions]
let demoResources = { ...initialCompanyResources }

export const demoVaultStore = {
  getFiles(filters?: { category?: string; status?: string; search?: string }) {
    let list = demoFiles.filter((f) => f.status !== 'DELETED')
    if (filters?.status && filters.status !== 'ALL') {
      list = list.filter((f) => f.status === filters.status)
    } else if (!filters?.status) {
      list = list.filter((f) => f.status === 'ACTIVE')
    }
    if (filters?.category && filters.category !== 'ALL') {
      list = list.filter((f) => f.category === filters.category)
    }
    if (filters?.search) {
      const q = filters.search.toLowerCase()
      list = list.filter(
        (f) =>
          f.displayName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          f.originalFilename.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (f.description && f.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
          f.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
      )
    }
    return list
  },

  getFile(id: string) {
    return demoFiles.find((f) => f.id === id) || null
  },

  uploadFile(file: File, metadata: Partial<VaultFile>) {
    const ext = '.' + file.name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase()
    const newFile: VaultFile = {
      id: `demo-file-${Date.now()}`,
      originalFilename: file.name,
      displayName: metadata.displayName || file.name,
      storagePath: `demo/user/${file.name}`,
      mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
      extension: ext,
      fileSizeBytes: file.size,
      category: metadata.category || 'OTHER',
      description: metadata.description || null,
      tags: metadata.tags || [],
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    }
    demoFiles.unshift(newFile)
    return newFile
  },

  updateFile(id: string, patch: Partial<VaultFile>) {
    const file = demoFiles.find((f) => f.id === id)
    if (file) {
      Object.assign(file, patch)
    }
    return file || null
  },

  deleteFile(id: string, permanent: boolean = false) {
    const file = demoFiles.find((f) => f.id === id)
    if (!file) return false
    if (permanent || file.status === 'TRASHED') {
      demoFiles = demoFiles.filter((f) => f.id !== id)
    } else {
      file.status = 'TRASHED'
      file.deletedAt = new Date().toISOString()
    }
    return true
  },

  restoreFile(id: string) {
    const file = demoFiles.find((f) => f.id === id)
    if (file) {
      file.status = 'ACTIVE'
      file.deletedAt = null
    }
    return file || null
  },

  getResumeGroups(includeArchived: boolean = false) {
    return demoResumeGroups.filter((g) => includeArchived || !g.isArchived)
  },

  createResumeGroup(data: { name: string; targetRole?: string; description?: string; skills?: string[] }) {
    const group: ResumeGroup = {
      id: `group-${Date.now()}`,
      name: data.name,
      targetRole: data.targetRole || null,
      description: data.description || null,
      skills: data.skills || [],
      isArchived: false,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      versions: [],
    }
    demoResumeGroups.unshift(group)
    return group
  },

  uploadResumeVersion(
    groupId: string,
    file: File,
    metadata: { versionLabel?: string; description?: string; skills?: string[]; isCurrent?: boolean },
  ) {
    const group = demoResumeGroups.find((g) => g.id === groupId)
    if (!group) throw new Error('Resume group not found.')

    const vaultFile = this.uploadFile(file, {
      displayName: `${group.name} (${metadata.versionLabel || 'New Version'})`,
      category: 'RESUME',
      description: metadata.description,
      tags: metadata.skills || [],
    })

    const nextVer = group.versions.length + 1
    const isCurrent = metadata.isCurrent ?? (group.versions.length === 0)

    if (isCurrent) {
      for (const v of group.versions) {
        v.isCurrent = false
      }
    }

    const version: ResumeVersion = {
      id: `ver-${Date.now()}`,
      resumeGroupId: groupId,
      vaultFileId: vaultFile.id,
      versionNumber: nextVer,
      versionLabel: metadata.versionLabel || `v${nextVer}.0`,
      description: metadata.description || null,
      skills: metadata.skills || [],
      isCurrent,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      vaultFile,
    }

    group.versions.unshift(version)
    return version
  },

  setCurrentResumeVersion(groupId: string, versionId: string) {
    const group = demoResumeGroups.find((g) => g.id === groupId)
    if (!group) return null
    for (const v of group.versions) {
      v.isCurrent = v.id === versionId
    }
    return group
  },

  getJobDescriptions() {
    return [...demoJobDescriptions]
  },

  createJobDescription(data: Partial<JobDescription>, file?: File) {
    let vaultFile: VaultFile | undefined
    if (file) {
      vaultFile = this.uploadFile(file, {
        displayName: `JD — ${data.title}`,
        category: 'JOB_DESCRIPTION',
      })
    }

    const jd: JobDescription = {
      id: `jd-${Date.now()}`,
      title: data.title || 'Untitled Role',
      companyId: data.companyId || null,
      applicationId: data.applicationId || null,
      vaultFileId: vaultFile?.id || data.vaultFileId || null,
      location: data.location || null,
      experienceLevel: data.experienceLevel || null,
      employmentType: data.employmentType || null,
      sourceUrl: data.sourceUrl || null,
      careerPageUrl: data.careerPageUrl || null,
      applicationDeadline: data.applicationDeadline || null,
      responsibilities: data.responsibilities || null,
      requiredSkills: data.requiredSkills || [],
      preferredSkills: data.preferredSkills || [],
      descriptionText: data.descriptionText || null,
      notes: data.notes || null,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      vaultFile,
    }

    demoJobDescriptions.unshift(jd)
    return jd
  },

  deleteJobDescription(id: string) {
    demoJobDescriptions = demoJobDescriptions.filter((j) => j.id !== id)
    return true
  },

  getCompanyResources(companyId: string) {
    const links = demoResources[companyId] || []
    const documents = demoFiles
      .filter((f) => f.status === 'ACTIVE' && f.companyDocuments?.some((c) => c.companyId === companyId))
      .map((f) => ({ id: `cd-${f.id}`, companyId, vaultFileId: f.id, vaultFile: f, createdAt: f.createdAt }))
    const jobDescriptions = demoJobDescriptions.filter((j) => j.companyId === companyId)

    return { links, documents, jobDescriptions }
  },

  createCompanyResource(companyId: string, resource: Partial<CompanyResource>) {
    if (!demoResources[companyId]) demoResources[companyId] = []
    const res: CompanyResource = {
      id: `res-${Date.now()}`,
      companyId,
      title: resource.title || 'Link',
      url: resource.url || 'https://',
      description: resource.description || null,
      resourceType: resource.resourceType || 'OTHER',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    }
    demoResources[companyId].push(res)
    return res
  },

  deleteCompanyResource(companyId: string, resourceId: string) {
    if (demoResources[companyId]) {
      demoResources[companyId] = demoResources[companyId].filter((r) => r.id !== resourceId)
    }
    return true
  },

  getStorageSummary(): StorageSummary {
    const active = demoFiles.filter((f) => f.status === 'ACTIVE')
    const usedBytes = active.reduce((acc, f) => acc + f.fileSizeBytes, 0)
    const totalQuotaBytes = 100 * 1024 * 1024 // 100MB
    const remainingQuotaBytes = Math.max(0, totalQuotaBytes - usedBytes)
    const usagePercentage = Math.min(100, Math.round((usedBytes / totalQuotaBytes) * 100))

    return {
      usedBytes,
      totalQuotaBytes,
      remainingQuotaBytes,
      fileCount: active.length,
      usagePercentage,
      maxFileSizeBytes: 20 * 1024 * 1024,
    }
  },

  getApplicationDocuments(applicationId: string) {
    const list: any[] = []
    for (const f of demoFiles) {
      if (f.status !== 'ACTIVE') continue
      for (const ad of f.applicationDocuments || []) {
        if (ad.applicationId === applicationId) {
          list.push({
            id: ad.id,
            applicationId,
            vaultFileId: f.id,
            vaultFile: f,
            documentRole: ad.documentRole || 'SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT',
            createdAt: f.createdAt,
          })
        }
      }
    }
    return list
  },

  linkApplicationDocument(applicationId: string, data: { vaultFileId: string; resumeVersionId?: string | null; documentRole?: string; notes?: string | null }) {
    const file = demoFiles.find((f) => f.id === data.vaultFileId)
    const docId = `appdoc-${Date.now()}`
    if (file) {
      if (!file.applicationDocuments) file.applicationDocuments = []
      file.applicationDocuments.push({
        id: docId,
        applicationId,
        documentRole: data.documentRole || 'SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT',
      })
    }
    return {
      id: docId,
      applicationId,
      vaultFileId: data.vaultFileId,
      vaultFile: file,
      resumeVersionId: data.resumeVersionId,
      documentRole: data.documentRole || 'SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT',
      notes: data.notes,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    }
  },

  unlinkApplicationDocument(applicationId: string, documentId: string) {
    for (const f of demoFiles) {
      if (f.applicationDocuments) {
        f.applicationDocuments = f.applicationDocuments.filter((ad) => ad.id !== documentId && ad.applicationId !== applicationId)
      }
    }
    return true
  },
}

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react'
import { Link, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useAuth } from '../context/auth-context'
import { isSupabaseConfigured } from '../lib/supabase'

type AuthPageKind = 'login' | 'signup' | 'forgot-password' | 'recovery' | 'confirm'

const headings: Record<AuthPageKind, string> = {
  login: 'Welcome back',
  signup: 'Create your account',
  'forgot-password': 'Reset your password',
  recovery: 'Choose a new password',
  confirm: 'Confirm your email',
}

export function AuthPage({ page }: { page: AuthPageKind }) {
  const auth = useAuth()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const location = useLocation()
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('')

  const submit = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault()
    setError('')
    setNotice('')
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget)
    const email = String(form.get('email') ?? '').trim()
    const password = String(form.get('password') ?? '')
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      if (page === 'signup') {
        const name = String(form.get('name') ?? '').trim()
        if (password.length < 8) throw new Error('Use a password with at least 8 characters.')
        if (password !== String(form.get('confirmPassword') ?? '')) throw new Error('The passwords do not match.')
        await auth.signUp(name, email, password)
        setNotice('Check your email for a confirmation link before signing in.')
      } else if (page === 'login') {
        await auth.signIn(email, password)
        navigate('/', { replace: true })
      } else if (page === 'forgot-password') {
        await auth.requestPasswordReset(email)
        setNotice('If an account exists for that address, a password reset link is on its way.')
      } else if (page === 'recovery') {
        if (password.length < 8) throw new Error('Use a password with at least 8 characters.')
        if (password !== String(form.get('confirmPassword') ?? '')) throw new Error('The passwords do not match.')
        await auth.updatePassword(password)
        setNotice('Your password has been updated. You can continue to your workspace.')
      }
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Something went wrong. Please try again.')
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  const configured = isSupabaseConfigured
  const authReady = auth.loading ? <p className="auth-message" role="status">Restoring your session…</p> : null
  const showPasswordFields = page === 'signup' || page === 'login' || page === 'recovery'
  const returnToLogin = page !== 'login'

  return (
    <main className="auth-page">
      <section className="auth-card" aria-labelledby="auth-title">
        <Link className="auth-brand" to="/">careeros</Link>
        <p className="eyebrow">CAREEROS WORKSPACE</p>
        <h1 id="auth-title">{headings[page]}</h1>
        {page === 'confirm' ? (
          <div className="auth-message" role="status">
            {auth.loading ? 'Checking your confirmation…' : auth.session
              ? 'Your email is confirmed. You can continue to your workspace.'
              : 'Use the confirmation link sent to your email. If it has expired, request a new link by signing up again or contact support.'}
          </div>
        ) : page === 'recovery' && !auth.session && !auth.loading ? (
          <div className="auth-message" role="alert">
            This recovery link is invalid or expired. Request a new password reset link.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={submit} className="auth-form">
            {page === 'signup' && <label className="form-field"><span>Your name</span><input name="name" autoComplete="name" required maxLength={100} /></label>}
            {(page === 'login' || page === 'signup' || page === 'forgot-password') && (
              <label className="form-field"><span>Email</span><input name="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" required /></label>
            )}
            {showPasswordFields && <label className="form-field"><span>Password</span><input name="password" type="password" autoComplete={page === 'login' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password'} required minLength={8} /></label>}
            {(page === 'signup' || page === 'recovery') && <label className="form-field"><span>Confirm password</span><input name="confirmPassword" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" required minLength={8} /></label>}
            {!configured && <p className="auth-message" role="alert">Authentication is not configured. Set the public Supabase URL and publishable key in the frontend environment, and configure the same project in `backend/.env`.</p>}
            {auth.authError && <p className="auth-error" role="alert">{auth.authError}</p>}
            {error && <p className="auth-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
            {notice && <p className="auth-message" role="status">{notice}</p>}
            {authReady}
            <button className="button button-primary auth-submit" type="submit" disabled={busy || !configured || auth.loading}>
              {busy ? 'Please wait…' : page === 'signup' ? 'Create account' : page === 'login' ? 'Sign in' : page === 'forgot-password' ? 'Send reset link' : 'Update password'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
        {page === 'confirm' && auth.session && <Link className="button button-primary auth-submit auth-link-button" to="/">Continue to CareerOS</Link>}
        {page === 'recovery' && !auth.session && !auth.loading && <Link className="button button-primary auth-submit auth-link-button" to="/auth/forgot-password">Request another link</Link>}
        <nav className="auth-links" aria-label="Authentication links">
          {returnToLogin && <Link to="/auth/login">Sign in</Link>}
          {page === 'login' && <Link to="/auth/forgot-password">Forgot password?</Link>}
          {page === 'login' && <Link to="/auth/signup">Create an account</Link>}
          {page === 'signup' && <Link to="/auth/login">Already have an account?</Link>}
          {page === 'forgot-password' && <Link to="/auth/signup">Create an account</Link>}
        </nav>
        {location.pathname.startsWith('/auth/') && auth.dataMode === 'demo' && (
          <p className="auth-demo-note">Demo mode is active. The existing browser-local workspace remains available.</p>
        )}
      </section>
    </main>
  )
}

import { useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { addDays, format, isBefore, parseISO, startOfDay } from 'date-fns'
import { ArrowRight, BriefcaseBusiness, CalendarClock, Check, Clock3, Plus } from 'lucide-react'
import { useNavigate, useOutletContext } from 'react-router-dom'
import { getCompanyName } from '../data/demo'
import { useCareerData } from '../context/useCareerData'
import { useAuth } from '../context/auth-context'
import { MonthlyCalendar } from '../components/MonthlyCalendar'
import { RecordDialog } from '../components/RecordDialog'
import { getUpcomingFollowUps } from '../lib/followUps'
import { DashboardInsightsSection } from '../components/DashboardInsightsSection'
import type { AppShellContext, RecordType } from '../types'

const dateLabel = (value: string) => value ? format(parseISO(value), 'MMM d') : '—'
const activeStatuses = ['Saved', 'Applied', 'Assessment', 'Interview']

export function Dashboard() {
  const { data, toggleTask, deleteRecord } = useCareerData()
  const auth = useAuth()
  const { openAdd } = useOutletContext<AppShellContext>()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const [now] = useState(() => new Date())
  const [editRecord, setEditRecord] = useState<{ type: RecordType; id: string } | null>(null)
  const today = startOfDay(now)
  const active = data.applications.filter((application) => activeStatuses.includes(application.status)).length
  const upcomingInterviews = data.events.filter((event) => event.eventType === 'Interview' && parseISO(event.startsAt) >= now).length
  const followUps = useMemo(() => getUpcomingFollowUps(data), [data])
  const upcomingActions = followUps.slice(0, 5)
  const followUpsDue = followUps.filter((action) => isBefore(parseISO(action.dueAt), addDays(today, 1))).length
  const recentApplications = useMemo(() => data.applications
    .slice()
    .sort((first, second) => second.appliedAt.localeCompare(first.appliedAt))
    .slice(0, 5), [data.applications])
  const greeting = now.getHours() < 12 ? 'Good morning' : now.getHours() < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening'
  const metadataName = auth.session?.user.user_metadata?.full_name
  const greetingName = typeof metadataName === 'string' && metadataName.trim()
    ? metadataName.trim()
    : auth.user?.name.trim() || auth.user?.email.split('@')[0] || 'there'

  const openCalendarItem = (type: RecordType, id: string) => setEditRecord({ type, id })
  const deleteEvent = (id: string) => {
    if (window.confirm('Delete this event? This action cannot be undone.')) deleteRecord('event', id)
  }

  return <div className="dashboard-page">
    <section className="welcome-row dashboard-welcome">
      <div><p className="eyebrow">{format(now, 'EEEE, MMMM d')}</p><h1>{greeting}, {greetingName}</h1><p className="welcome-subtitle">A clear view of your opportunities and what to do next.</p></div>
      <button className="button button-primary" onClick={() => openAdd('application')}><Plus size={16} /> Add application</button>
    </section>

    <section className="metrics-grid" aria-label="Career overview">
      <MetricCard label="Total applications" value={data.applications.length} icon={<BriefcaseBusiness size={17} />} tone="violet" onClick={() => navigate('/applications')} />
      <MetricCard label="Active applications" value={active} icon={<ArrowRight size={17} />} tone="blue" onClick={() => navigate('/applications')} />
      <MetricCard label="Upcoming interviews" value={upcomingInterviews} icon={<CalendarClock size={17} />} tone="green" onClick={() => navigate('/calendar')} />
      <MetricCard label="Follow-ups due" value={followUpsDue} icon={<Clock3 size={17} />} tone="amber" onClick={() => navigate('/tasks')} />
    </section>

    <DashboardInsightsSection />

    <section className="dashboard-focus-grid">
      <article className="panel dashboard-calendar-panel">
        <MonthlyCalendar
          data={data}
          compact
          onAdd={openAdd}
          onOpen={openCalendarItem}
          onDeleteEvent={deleteEvent}
        />
      </article>
      <article className="panel dashboard-actions-panel">
        <PanelHeading title="Your next steps" subtitle="Open tasks and follow-ups" trailing={<button className="text-action" onClick={() => openAdd('task')}>Add task <Plus size={13} /></button>} />
        {upcomingActions.length ? <div className="task-list">
          {upcomingActions.map((action) => {
            const overdue = isBefore(parseISO(action.dueAt), today)
            return <div className={`task-row ${overdue ? 'task-overdue' : ''}`} key={`${action.recordType}-${action.id}`}>
              {action.recordType === 'task' ? <button className="task-check" aria-label="Mark task complete" onClick={() => toggleTask(action.id)}><Check size={12} /></button> : <span className="followup-action-symbol" aria-hidden="true"><Clock3 size={13} /></span>}
              <button className="task-copy task-open-button" onClick={() => openCalendarItem(action.recordType, action.id)}><strong>{action.title}</strong><span>{getCompanyName(data, action.companyId)}</span></button>
              <div className="task-meta"><span className={action.priority ? `priority priority-${action.priority.toLowerCase()}` : 'followup-label'}>{action.priority ?? 'Follow-up'}</span>{action.recordType === 'task' && <span className="task-status-open">Open</span>}<time>{overdue ? 'Overdue' : dateLabel(action.dueAt)}</time></div>
            </div>
          })}
        </div> : <EmptyState text="No open follow-ups. Add a task to plan your next move." action="Add task" onAction={() => openAdd('task')} />}
        <button className="panel-footer-action" onClick={() => navigate('/tasks')}>View all tasks <ArrowRight size={14} /></button>
      </article>
    </section>

    <article className="panel applications-panel dashboard-recent-panel">
      <PanelHeading title="Recent applications" subtitle="Your latest opportunities" trailing={<button className="text-action" onClick={() => navigate('/applications')}>View all <ArrowRight size={14} /></button>} />
      {recentApplications.length ? <div className="application-table-wrap"><table className="application-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Company / role</th><th>Date applied</th><th>Status</th><th>Next step</th><th /></tr></thead>
        <tbody>{recentApplications.map((application) => (
          <tr key={application.id}>
            <td><button className="company-cell application-row-open" aria-label={`Open ${application.jobTitle} at ${getCompanyName(data, application.companyId)}`} onClick={() => setEditRecord({ type: 'application', id: application.id })}><span className="company-avatar">{getCompanyName(data, application.companyId).slice(0, 1)}</span><span><strong>{getCompanyName(data, application.companyId)}</strong><small>{application.jobTitle}</small></span></button></td>
            <td className="date-cell">{dateLabel(application.appliedAt)}</td>
            <td><span className={`status-badge status-${application.status.toLowerCase()}`}><i />{application.status}</span></td>
            <td className="next-action-cell">{application.nextAction || '—'}</td>
            <td><button className="row-arrow" aria-label={`Edit ${application.jobTitle}`} onClick={() => setEditRecord({ type: 'application', id: application.id })}><ArrowRight size={15} /></button></td>
          </tr>
        ))}</tbody>
      </table></div> : <EmptyState text="Your applications will appear here. Add an opportunity to start tracking its progress." action="Add application" onAction={() => openAdd('application')} />}
    </article>
    {editRecord && <RecordDialog type={editRecord.type} recordId={editRecord.id} onClose={() => setEditRecord(null)} />}
  </div>
}

function MetricCard({ label, value, icon, tone, onClick }: { label: string; value: number; icon: ReactNode; tone: string; onClick: () => void }) {
  return <button className="metric-card" onClick={onClick}><span className="metric-top"><span>{label}</span><i className={`metric-icon ${tone}`}>{icon}</i></span><span className="metric-value">{value}</span><span className="metric-card-hint">View details <ArrowRight size={13} /></span></button>
}

function PanelHeading({ title, subtitle, trailing }: { title: string; subtitle: string; trailing?: ReactNode }) {
  return <div className="panel-heading"><div><h2>{title}</h2><p>{subtitle}</p></div>{trailing}</div>
}

function EmptyState({ text, action, onAction }: { text: string; action?: string; onAction?: () => void }) {
  return <div className="empty-state"><span><Clock3 size={16} /></span><p>{text}</p>{action && onAction && <button className="text-action" onClick={onAction}>{action} <Plus size={13} /></button>}</div>
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { format, isAfter, isBefore, isSameDay, parseISO, startOfDay, startOfToday } from 'date-fns'
import { ArrowDownUp, ArrowRight, CalendarDays, Check, Circle, Download, Pencil, Plus, Search, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { useLocation, useOutletContext, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import { getCompanyName } from '../data/demo'
import { useCareerData } from '../context/useCareerData'
import { useAuth } from '../context/auth-context'
import type { AppShellContext, RecordType } from '../types'
import { RecordDialog } from '../components/RecordDialog'
import { MonthlyCalendar } from '../components/MonthlyCalendar'
import { taskDueDateLabel } from '../lib/taskDueDate'
import { useTheme } from '../context/useTheme'

interface DirectoryRow {
  id: string
  type: RecordType
  name: string
  subtitle: string
  company: string
  status: string
  date: string
  location: string
  tags?: string[]
}

const routeConfig: Record<string, { type: RecordType; title: string; description: string; addLabel: string }> = {
  '/companies': { type: 'company', title: 'Companies', description: 'Keep the organizations on your radar in one place.', addLabel: 'Add company' },
  '/contacts': { type: 'contact', title: 'Contacts', description: 'Build meaningful professional connections over time.', addLabel: 'Add contact' },
  '/applications': { type: 'application', title: 'Applications', description: 'A clear view of every opportunity in your search.', addLabel: 'Add application' },
}

export function DirectoryPage() {
  const { pathname } = useLocation()
  const config = routeConfig[pathname] ?? routeConfig['/applications']
  const { data, deleteRecord } = useCareerData()
  const { openAdd } = useOutletContext<AppShellContext>()
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const query = searchParams.get('q') ?? ''
  const [sortAscending, setSortAscending] = useState(config.type !== 'application')
  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState(config.type === 'application' ? 'date' : 'name')
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('All')
  const [companyFilter, setCompanyFilter] = useState('All companies')
  const [industryFilter, setIndustryFilter] = useState('All industries')
  const [tagFilter, setTagFilter] = useState('All tags')
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const rows: DirectoryRow[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (config.type === 'company') return data.companies.map((company) => ({
      id: company.id, type: 'company', name: company.name, subtitle: company.industry || 'Industry not set', company: company.size || 'Size not set',
      status: '', date: company.createdAt, location: company.location, tags: company.tags,
    }))
    if (config.type === 'contact') return data.contacts.map((contact) => ({
      id: contact.id, type: 'contact', name: contact.name, subtitle: contact.jobTitle || 'Role not set', company: getCompanyName(data, contact.companyId),
      status: contact.status, date: contact.lastContactedAt, location: '', tags: contact.tags,
    }))
    return data.applications.map((application) => ({
      id: application.id, type: 'application', name: application.jobTitle, subtitle: application.nextAction || 'No next action yet', company: getCompanyName(data, application.companyId),
      status: application.status, date: application.appliedAt, location: application.location,
    }))
  }, [config.type, data])
  const filteredRows = rows.filter((row) => `${row.name} ${row.subtitle} ${row.company} ${row.location} ${(row.tags ?? []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase()))
    .filter((row) => statusFilter === 'All' || row.status === statusFilter)
    .filter((row) => config.type === 'company' ? industryFilter === 'All industries' || row.subtitle === industryFilter : companyFilter === 'All companies' || row.company === companyFilter)
    .filter((row) => tagFilter === 'All tags' || row.tags?.includes(tagFilter))
    .sort((first, second) => {
      const firstValue = sortField === 'date' ? first.date : first.name
      const secondValue = sortField === 'date' ? second.date : second.name
      return sortAscending ? firstValue.localeCompare(secondValue) : secondValue.localeCompare(firstValue)
    })
  const statusOptions = config.type === 'application' ? ['Saved', 'Applied', 'Assessment', 'Interview', 'Offer', 'Rejected'] : config.type === 'contact' ? ['Connected', 'Requested', 'Not connected'] : []
  const industryOptions = [...new Set(data.companies.map((company) => company.industry).filter(Boolean))]
  const tagOptions = [...new Set(rows.flatMap((row) => row.tags ?? []))]

  const remove = (row: DirectoryRow) => {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(`Delete ${row.name}? This action cannot be undone.`)
    if (confirmed) deleteRecord(row.type, row.id)
  }

  return (
    <section className="directory-page">
      <div className="page-title-row"><div><p className="eyebrow">YOUR CAREER WORKSPACE</p><h1>{config.title}</h1><p className="page-description">{config.description}</p></div><button className="button button-primary" onClick={() => openAdd(config.type)}><Plus size={16} /> {config.addLabel}</button></div>
      <div className="panel directory-panel">
        <div className="directory-toolbar">
          <label className="table-search directory-search"><Search size={15} /><input placeholder={`Search ${config.title.toLowerCase()}...`} aria-label={`Search ${config.title}`} value={query} onChange={(event) => setSearchParams(event.target.value ? { q: event.target.value } : {})} /></label>
          <div className="directory-filters">
            {config.type === 'company' ? <select aria-label="Filter by industry" value={industryFilter} onChange={(event) => setIndustryFilter(event.target.value)}><option>All industries</option>{industryOptions.map((industry) => <option key={industry}>{industry}</option>)}</select> : <select aria-label="Filter by company" value={companyFilter} onChange={(event) => setCompanyFilter(event.target.value)}><option>All companies</option>{data.companies.map((company) => <option key={company.id}>{company.name}</option>)}</select>}
            {(config.type === 'company' || config.type === 'contact') && <select aria-label="Filter by tag" value={tagFilter} onChange={(event) => setTagFilter(event.target.value)}><option>All tags</option>{tagOptions.map((tag) => <option key={tag}>{tag}</option>)}</select>}
            {statusOptions.length > 0 && <select aria-label="Filter by status" value={statusFilter} onChange={(event) => setStatusFilter(event.target.value)}><option value="All">All statuses</option>{statusOptions.map((status) => <option key={status}>{status}</option>)}</select>}
            <select aria-label="Sort records" value={sortField} onChange={(event) => setSortField(event.target.value)}>{config.type === 'company' ? <><option value="name">Name</option><option value="date">Date added</option></> : config.type === 'contact' ? <><option value="name">Name</option><option value="date">Last contacted</option></> : <><option value="date">Application date</option><option value="name">Role</option></>}</select>
            <button className="sort-button" aria-label="Toggle sort direction" onClick={() => setSortAscending((value) => !value)}><ArrowDownUp size={14} /></button>
          </div>
        </div>
        {filteredRows.length ? <div className="directory-table-wrap"><table className="directory-table"><thead><tr><th>{config.type === 'application' ? 'Role' : 'Name'}</th><th>{config.type === 'company' ? 'Industry' : 'Company'}</th><th>{config.type === 'application' ? 'Status' : config.type === 'contact' ? 'Connection' : 'Size'}</th><th>{config.type === 'company' ? 'Location' : config.type === 'contact' ? 'Last contacted' : 'Applied'}</th><th /></tr></thead>
          <tbody>{filteredRows.map((row) => <tr key={row.id}>
            <td><button className="company-cell directory-row-open" aria-label={`Edit ${row.name}`} onClick={() => setEditing(row.id)}><span className="company-avatar">{row.name.slice(0, 1)}</span><span><strong>{row.name}</strong><small>{row.type === 'company' ? row.location : row.subtitle}</small></span></button></td>
            <td>{row.type === 'company' ? row.subtitle : row.company}</td>
            <td>{row.status ? <span className={`status-badge status-${row.status.toLowerCase()}`}><i />{row.status}</span> : row.company}</td>
            <td className="date-cell">{row.type === 'company' ? row.location : row.date ? format(parseISO(row.date), 'MMM d, yyyy') : '—'}</td>
            <td><div className="row-actions"><button className="row-action-button" onClick={() => setEditing(row.id)}>Edit</button><button className="row-delete-button" aria-label={`Delete ${row.name}`} onClick={() => remove(row)}><Trash2 size={14} /></button></div></td>
          </tr>)}</tbody></table></div> : <div className="directory-empty"><span><Search size={20} /></span><h3>{rows.length ? 'No matching records' : `No ${config.title.toLowerCase()} yet`}</h3><p>{rows.length ? 'Try adjusting your search or filters.' : `Add your first ${config.type} to start organizing your career search.`}</p>{!rows.length && <button className="button button-secondary" onClick={() => openAdd(config.type)}><Plus size={15} /> {config.addLabel}</button>}</div>}
      </div>
      {editing && <RecordDialog type={config.type} recordId={editing} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} />}
    </section>
  )
}

export function TasksPage() {
  const { data, toggleTask, deleteRecord } = useCareerData()
  const { openAdd } = useOutletContext<AppShellContext>()
  const today = startOfToday()
  const open = data.tasks.filter((task) => !task.done).sort((first, second) => first.dueAt.localeCompare(second.dueAt))
  const completed = data.tasks.filter((task) => task.done)
  const [timeFilter, setTimeFilter] = useState('All open')
  const [priorityFilter, setPriorityFilter] = useState('All priorities')
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const visibleOpen = open.filter((task) => {
    const dueDate = parseISO(task.dueAt)
    const matchesTime = timeFilter === 'All open'
      || (timeFilter === 'Overdue' && isBefore(dueDate, today))
      || (timeFilter === 'Today' && isSameDay(dueDate, today))
      || (timeFilter === 'Upcoming' && isAfter(startOfDay(dueDate), today))
    return matchesTime && (priorityFilter === 'All priorities' || task.priority === priorityFilter)
  })
  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    if (window.confirm('Delete this task? This action cannot be undone.')) deleteRecord('task', id)
  }
  return <section className="directory-page">
    <div className="page-title-row"><div><p className="eyebrow">STAY ON TRACK</p><h1>Tasks & follow-ups</h1><p className="page-description">A manageable list of thoughtful next steps.</p></div><button className="button button-primary" onClick={() => openAdd('task')}><Plus size={16} /> Add task</button></div>
    <div className="tasks-layout">
      <div className="panel task-board"><PanelTitle title="To do" count={open.length} /><div className="task-board-filters"><select aria-label="Filter tasks by date" value={timeFilter} onChange={(event) => setTimeFilter(event.target.value)}><option>All open</option><option>Today</option><option>Upcoming</option><option>Overdue</option></select><select aria-label="Filter tasks by priority" value={priorityFilter} onChange={(event) => setPriorityFilter(event.target.value)}><option>All priorities</option><option>High</option><option>Medium</option><option>Low</option></select></div><div className="full-task-list">{visibleOpen.map((task) => {
        const overdue = isBefore(parseISO(task.dueAt), today)
        return <div className="full-task-row" key={task.id}><button className="task-check" aria-label="Mark task complete" onClick={() => toggleTask(task.id)}><Check size={12} /></button><div className="full-task-copy"><strong>{task.title}</strong><span>{getCompanyName(data, task.companyId)}</span></div><span className={`priority priority-${task.priority.toLowerCase()}`}>{task.priority}</span><time className={overdue ? 'overdue-date' : ''}>{overdue ? 'Overdue' : taskDueDateLabel(task.dueAt)}</time><button className="row-delete-button" aria-label={`Edit task ${task.title}`} onClick={() => setEditing(task.id)}><Pencil size={14} /></button><button className="row-delete-button" aria-label={`Delete ${task.title}`} onClick={() => handleDelete(task.id)}><Trash2 size={14} /></button></div>
      })}{!visibleOpen.length && <DirectoryEmpty text={open.length ? 'No tasks match these filters.' : 'Nothing on your list. You’re all caught up.'} />}</div></div>
      <div className="panel task-board"><PanelTitle title="Completed" count={completed.length} /><div className="full-task-list">{completed.map((task) => <div className="full-task-row completed-task" key={task.id}><button className="task-check checked" aria-label="Reopen task" onClick={() => toggleTask(task.id)}><Check size={12} /></button><div className="full-task-copy"><strong>{task.title}</strong><span>{getCompanyName(data, task.companyId)}</span></div><button className="row-delete-button" aria-label={`Edit task ${task.title}`} onClick={() => setEditing(task.id)}><Pencil size={14} /></button><button className="row-delete-button" aria-label={`Delete ${task.title}`} onClick={() => handleDelete(task.id)}><Trash2 size={14} /></button></div>)}{!completed.length && <DirectoryEmpty text="Completed tasks will appear here." />}</div></div>
    </div>
    {editing && <RecordDialog type="task" recordId={editing} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} />}
  </section>
}

export function SettingsPage() {
  const { data } = useCareerData()
  const auth = useAuth()
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme()
  const demoMode = auth.dataMode === 'demo'
  const exportDemoData = () => {
    const file = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' })
    const downloadUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file)
    const link = document.createElement('a')
    link.href = downloadUrl
    link.download = `careeros-${demoMode ? 'demo' : 'workspace'}-${format(new Date(), 'yyyy-MM-dd')}.json`
    link.click()
    URL.revokeObjectURL(downloadUrl)
  }
  return <section className="directory-page"><div className="page-title-row"><div><p className="eyebrow">PREFERENCES</p><h1>Settings</h1><p className="page-description">{demoMode ? 'Manage this local demo workspace.' : 'Manage your private CareerOS workspace.'}</p></div></div>

'Your records are saved only in this browser using local storage. No account or server sync is configured.' : 'Your records are loaded from the authenticated CareerOS API and scoped to your account.'}</p><span className="settings-status"><i /> {demoMode ? 'Local demo mode' : 'Authenticated API mode'}</span></div></article>
      <article className="panel settings-card"><div className="settings-icon"><CalendarDays size={18} /></div><div><h2>Workspace summary</h2><p>{data.companies.length} companies · {data.contacts.length} contacts · {data.applications.length} applications</p><span className="settings-status">Sample data can be edited or removed at any time.</span></div></article>
      <article className="panel settings-card"><div className="settings-icon"><CalendarDays size={18} /></div><div><h2>Appearance</h2><p>Choose the display theme for this browser.</p><button className="button button-secondary" onClick={toggleTheme}>Switch to {theme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light'} mode</button></div></article>
      <article className="panel settings-card"><div className="settings-icon"><Download size={18} /></div><div><h2>{demoMode ? 'Export demo data' : 'Export workspace data'}</h2><p>{demoMode ? 'Download a JSON backup of the records saved in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.' : 'Download a JSON backup of the records in your private workspace.'}</p><button className="button button-secondary" onClick={exportDemoData}>Download backup</button></div></article>
      <article className="panel settings-card"><div className="settings-icon"><ArrowRight size={18} /></div><div><h2>{demoMode ? 'Coming next' : 'Workspace access'}</h2><p>{demoMode ? 'Secure accounts, shared database storage, reminders and calendar integrations are planned for a future milestone.' : 'Sign-in, email confirmation, and account-scoped API access are enabled for this workspace.'}</p><span className="settings-status">{demoMode ? 'No backend authentication or sync is active.' : 'Your records are private to your authenticated account.'}</span></div></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  displayName: z.string().trim().min(1, 'Display name is required.').max(120, 'Use 120 characters or fewer.'),
  firstName: z.string().trim().max(100, 'Use 100 characters or fewer.'),
  lastName: z.string().trim().max(100, 'Use 100 characters or fewer.'),
  phone: z.string().trim().max(40, 'Use 40 characters or fewer.').refine((value) => !value || /^\+?[0-9\s().-]{7,40}$/.test(value), 'Enter a valid phone number.'),
  location: z.string().trim().max(160, 'Use 160 characters or fewer.'),
  headline: z.string().trim().max(180, 'Use 180 characters or fewer.'),
  bio: z.string().trim().max(2000, 'Use 2,000 characters or fewer.'),
  currentRole: z.string().trim().max(160, 'Use 160 characters or fewer.'),
  skills: z.string().max(2400, 'Use 2,400 characters or fewer.').refine(
    (value) => value.split(',').map((skill) => skill.trim()).filter(Boolean).length <= 40,
    'Add no more than 40 skills.',
  ),
  linkedinUrl: urlField('Enter a valid LinkedIn URL.'),
  githubUrl: urlField('Enter a valid GitHub URL.'),
  portfolioUrl: urlField('Enter a valid portfolio URL.'),
})

function urlField(message: string) {
  return z.string().trim().max(500, 'Use 500 characters or fewer.').refine((value) => {
    if (!value) return true
    try {
      const url = new URL(value)
      return url.protocol === 'https:' || url.protocol === 'http:'
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }, message)
}

type ProfileForm = z.infer<typeof profileSchema>
type Profile = ProfileForm & { email: string; createdAt: string }

const blankForm: ProfileForm = {
  displayName: '',
  firstName: '',
  lastName: '',
  phone: '',
  location: '',
  headline: '',
  bio: '',
  currentRole: '',
  skills: '',
  linkedinUrl: '',
  githubUrl: '',
  portfolioUrl: '',
}

const profileResponseSchema = z.object({
  displayName: z.string(),
  email: z.string(),
  firstName: z.string(),
  lastName: z.string(),
  phone: z.string(),
  location: z.string(),
  headline: z.string(),
  bio: z.string(),
  currentRole: z.string(),
  skills: z.array(z.string()),
  linkedinUrl: z.string(),
  githubUrl: z.string(),
  portfolioUrl: z.string(),
  createdAt: z.string(),
})

function formFromProfile(profile: z.infer<typeof profileResponseSchema>): Profile {
  return {
    displayName: profile.displayName,
    email: profile.email,
    firstName: profile.firstName,
    lastName: profile.lastName,
    phone: profile.phone,
    location: profile.location,
    headline: profile.headline,
    bio: profile.bio,
    currentRole: profile.currentRole,
    skills: profile.skills.join(', '),
    linkedinUrl: profile.linkedinUrl,
    githubUrl: profile.githubUrl,
    portfolioUrl: profile.portfolioUrl,
    createdAt: profile.createdAt,
  }
}

function formFromSaved(profile: Profile): ProfileForm {
  return { ...profile }
}

function initials(name: string) {
  return name.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? '').join('') || 'C'
}

async function responseMessage(response: Response) {
  try {
    return apiErrorMessage(await readJsonBody(response), `The server request failed (${response.status}).`)
  } catch {
    return `The server returned an unreadable response (${response.status}).`
  }
}

export function ProfilePage() {
  const auth = useAuth()
  const outletContext = useOutletContext<AppShellContext | undefined>()
  const setProfileUnsavedChanges = outletContext?.setProfileUnsavedChanges
  const token = auth.session?.access_token
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<Profile | null>(null)
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ProfileForm>(blankForm)
  const [savedForm, setSavedForm] = useState<ProfileForm>(blankForm)
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Partial<Record<keyof ProfileForm, string>>>({})
  const [loadedToken, setLoadedToken] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false)
  const [errorState, setErrorState] = useState<{ token: string; message: string } | null>(null)
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')
  const error = auth.dataMode === 'api' && token && errorState?.token === token ? errorState.message : ''
  const loading = auth.dataMode === 'api' && Boolean(token) && loadedToken !== token && !error

  const dirty = useMemo(() => JSON.stringify(form) !== JSON.stringify(savedForm), [form, savedForm])

  useEffect(() => () => setProfileUnsavedChanges?.(false), [setProfileUnsavedChanges])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (auth.dataMode !== 'api' || !token) return
    let active = true
    void fetch('/api/profile', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
      .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(await responseMessage(response))
        const parsed = profileResponseSchema.safeParse(await readJsonBody(response))
        if (!parsed.success) throw new Error('The server returned profile data in an unsupported format.')
        const nextProfile = formFromProfile(parsed.data)
        if (active) {
          setProfile(nextProfile)
          setForm(formFromSaved(nextProfile))
          setSavedForm(formFromSaved(nextProfile))
          setLoadedToken(token)
          setErrorState(null)
        }
      })
      .catch((cause: unknown) => {
        if (active) setErrorState({
          token,
          message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'CareerOS could not load your profile.',
        })
      })
    return () => { active = false }
  }, [auth.dataMode, token])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!editing || !dirty) return
    const warnBeforeLeaving = (event: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
      event.preventDefault()
      event.returnValue = ''
    }
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', warnBeforeLeaving)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', warnBeforeLeaving)
  }, [dirty, editing])

  const updateField = (field: keyof ProfileForm, value: string) => {
    const updatedForm = { ...form, [field]: value }
    setForm(updatedForm)
    setProfileUnsavedChanges?.(JSON.stringify(updatedForm) !== JSON.stringify(savedForm))
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: undefined }))
    setMessage('')
  }

  const cancelEditing = () => {
    if (dirty && !window.confirm('Discard your unsaved profile changes?')) return
    setForm(savedForm)
    setProfileUnsavedChanges?.(false)
    setErrors({})
    setErrorState(null)
    setMessage('')
    setEditing(false)
  }

  const saveProfile = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault()
    setErrorState(null)
    setMessage('')
    const parsed = profileSchema.safeParse(form)
    if (!parsed.success) {
      const nextErrors: Partial<Record<keyof ProfileForm, string>> = {}
      for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
        const field = issue.path[0]
        if (typeof field === 'string' && field in blankForm) nextErrors[field as keyof ProfileForm] = issue.message
      }
      setErrors(nextErrors)
      return
    }
    if (!token || !profile) {
      setErrorState({ token: token ?? '', message: 'Your secure session is not available. Sign in again to edit your profile.' })
      return
    }
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      const values = parsed.data
      const response = await fetch('/api/profile', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...values,
          skills: values.skills.split(',').map((skill) => skill.trim()).filter(Boolean),
        }),
      })
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(await responseMessage(response))
      const parsedResponse = profileResponseSchema.safeParse(await readJsonBody(response))
      if (!parsedResponse.success) throw new Error('The server returned profile data in an unsupported format.')
      const updatedProfile = formFromProfile(parsedResponse.data)
      setProfile(updatedProfile)
      setForm(formFromSaved(updatedProfile))
      setSavedForm(formFromSaved(updatedProfile))
      setProfileUnsavedChanges?.(false)
      setEditing(false)
      try {
        await auth.updateDisplayName(updatedProfile.displayName)
      } catch {
        setMessage('Your profile was saved. Your sign-in display name could not be refreshed yet.')
        return
      }
      setMessage('Profile changes saved.')
    } catch (cause) {
      setErrorState({
        token: token ?? '',
        message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'CareerOS could not save your profile. Try again.',
      })
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  if (auth.dataMode !== 'api') {
    const demoName = auth.session?.user.user_metadata?.full_name
    const name = typeof demoName === 'string' && demoName.trim() ? demoName.trim() : auth.user?.name ?? 'CareerOS member'
    return <section className="profile-page">
      <header className="page-title-row"><div><p className="eyebrow">Account</p><h1>My profile</h1><p className="page-description">Your professional details in CareerOS.</p></div></header>
      <article className="panel profile-readonly">
        <div className="profile-avatar">{initials(name)}</div>
        <div><h2>{name}</h2><p>{auth.user?.email ?? auth.session?.user.email ?? 'Browser-local demo account'}</p></div>
        <p className="profile-setup-note">Profile editing is available in authenticated API mode. Demo workspace data remains local to this browser.</p>
      </article>
    </section>
  }

  if (loading) return <div className="workspace-loading" role="status"><span className="loading-spinner" /> Loading your profile…</div>
  if (error && !profile) {
    return <section className="profile-page">
      <ProfilePageHeader />
      <div className="data-error" role="alert"><h2>Profile unavailable</h2><p>{error}</p><button className="button button-secondary" onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>Reload profile</button></div>
    </section>
  }
  if (!profile) return null

  const skillList = profile.skills.split(',').map((skill) => skill.trim()).filter(Boolean)

  return <section className="profile-page">
    <ProfilePageHeader />
    {error && <p className="profile-alert" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    {message && <p className="profile-success" role="status"><Check size={15} />{message}</p>}
    {!editing
      ? <>
        <article className="panel profile-hero">
          <div className="profile-avatar">{initials(profile.displayName)}</div>
          <div className="profile-hero-copy">
            <p className="profile-eyebrow">Career profile</p>
            <h2>{profile.displayName}</h2>
            <p className="profile-headline">{profile.headline || 'Add a professional headline to introduce yourself.'}</p>
            <div className="profile-meta"><span>{profile.email}</span>{profile.location && <span><MapPin size={14} />{profile.location}</span>}</div>
          </div>
          <button className="button button-primary profile-edit-button" onClick={() => { setEditing(true); setErrorState(null); setMessage('') }}><Pencil size={15} /> Edit profile</button>
        </article>
        <div className="profile-grid">
          <article className="panel profile-section">
            <div className="profile-section-heading"><span className="profile-section-icon"><UserRound size={17} /></span><div><h2>About</h2><p>A little more about you</p></div></div>
            {profile.bio ? <p className="profile-bio">{profile.bio}</p> : <p className="profile-empty">Add a short bio to help people understand your background and goals.</p>}
            <dl className="profile-details">
              <div><dt>Phone</dt><dd>{profile.phone || 'Not added'}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Location</dt><dd>{profile.location || 'Not added'}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Current role or education</dt><dd>{profile.currentRole || 'Not added'}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Member since</dt><dd>{format(parseISO(profile.createdAt), 'MMMM yyyy')}</dd></div>
            </dl>
          </article>
          <article className="panel profile-section">
            <div className="profile-section-heading"><span className="profile-section-icon"><BriefcaseBusiness size={17} /></span><div><h2>Skills & links</h2><p>Professional highlights</p></div></div>
            <div className="profile-skills">{skillList.length ? skillList.map((skill) => <span key={skill}>{skill}</span>) : <p className="profile-empty">Add skills that reflect your strengths.</p>}</div>
            <div className="profile-links">
              <ProfileLink href={profile.linkedinUrl} icon={<AtSign size={15} />} label="LinkedIn" />
              <ProfileLink href={profile.githubUrl} icon={<Code2 size={15} />} label="GitHub" />
              <ProfileLink href={profile.portfolioUrl} icon={<Globe size={15} />} label="Portfolio" />
            </div>
          </article>
        </div>
        <p className="profile-storage-note">Avatar uploads are not configured for this workspace. Your initials are shown instead.</p>
      </>
      : <form className="panel profile-form" onSubmit={(event) => { void saveProfile(event) }} noValidate>
        <div className="profile-form-heading"><div><h2>Edit your profile</h2><p>These details are saved to your CareerOS account.</p></div><div className="profile-form-actions"><button type="button" className="button button-secondary" onClick={cancelEditing} disabled={saving}>Cancel</button><button type="submit" className="button button-primary" disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save changes'}</button></div></div>
        <div className="profile-form-grid">
          <ProfileField label="Display name" name="displayName" value={form.displayName} error={errors.displayName} onChange={updateField} required />
          <ProfileField label="Email address" name="email" value={profile.email} disabled />
          <ProfileField label="First name" name="firstName" value={form.firstName} error={errors.firstName} onChange={updateField} />
          <ProfileField label="Last name" name="lastName" value={form.lastName} error={errors.lastName} onChange={updateField} />
          <ProfileField label="Phone" name="phone" type="tel" value={form.phone} error={errors.phone} onChange={updateField} />
          <ProfileField label="Location" name="location" value={form.location} error={errors.location} onChange={updateField} />
          <ProfileField label="Professional headline" name="headline" value={form.headline} error={errors.headline} onChange={updateField} />
          <ProfileField label="Current role or education" name="currentRole" value={form.currentRole} error={errors.currentRole} onChange={updateField} />
          <ProfileField label="LinkedIn URL" name="linkedinUrl" type="url" value={form.linkedinUrl} error={errors.linkedinUrl} onChange={updateField} />
          <ProfileField label="GitHub URL" name="githubUrl" type="url" value={form.githubUrl} error={errors.githubUrl} onChange={updateField} />
          <ProfileField label="Portfolio URL" name="portfolioUrl" type="url" value={form.portfolioUrl} error={errors.portfolioUrl} onChange={updateField} />
          <ProfileField label="Skills" name="skills" value={form.skills} error={errors.skills} onChange={updateField} hint="Separate skills with commas." />
          <ProfileField label="About" name="bio" value={form.bio} error={errors.bio} onChange={updateField} multiline />
        </div>
        {dirty && <p className="profile-unsaved-note">You have unsaved changes. Cancel will ask before discarding them.</p>}
        <div className="profile-form-actions profile-form-actions-bottom"><button type="button" className="button button-secondary" onClick={cancelEditing} disabled={saving}>Cancel</button><button type="submit" className="button button-primary" disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save changes'}</button></div>
      </form>}
  </section>
}

function ProfilePageHeader() {
  return <header className="page-title-row"><div><p className="eyebrow">Account</p><h1>My profile</h1><p className="page-description">Your professional details in CareerOS.</p></div></header>
}

function ProfileLink({ href, icon, label }: { href: string; icon: ReactNode; label: string }) {
  return href
    ? <a href={href} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{icon}<span>{label}</span><ArrowUpRight size={13} /></a>
    : <span className="profile-link-empty">{icon}<span>{label} not added</span></span>
}

function ProfileField({
  label, name, value, error, hint, type = 'text', multiline = false, required = false, disabled = false, onChange,
}: {
  label: string
  name: keyof ProfileForm | 'email'
  value: string
  error?: string
  hint?: string
  type?: string
  multiline?: boolean
  required?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  onChange?: (field: keyof ProfileForm, value: string) => void
}) {
  const id = `profile-${name}`
  return <label className={`profile-field ${multiline ? 'profile-field-full' : ''}`} htmlFor={id}>
    <span>{label}{required && <i aria-hidden="true"> *</i>}</span>
    {multiline
      ? <textarea id={id} name={name} value={value} maxLength={2000} rows={5} aria-invalid={Boolean(error)} aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-error` : undefined} onChange={(event) => { if (name !== 'email') onChange?.(name, event.target.value) }} />
      : <input id={id} name={name} type={type} value={value} disabled={disabled} maxLength={name === 'bio' ? 2000 : 500} aria-invalid={Boolean(error)} aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-error` : hint ? `${id}-hint` : undefined} onChange={(event) => { if (name !== 'email') onChange?.(name, event.target.value) }} />}
    {hint && <small id={`${id}-hint`}>{hint}</small>}
    {error && <small className="profile-field-error" id={`${id}-error`} role="alert">{error}</small>}
  </label>
}

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import {
  LayoutDashboard,
  FileText,
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  Files,
  Trash2,
  UploadCloud,
} from 'lucide-react'
import '../components/vault/vault.css'
import { VaultOverview } from '../components/vault/VaultOverview'
import { AllDocumentsPage } from '../components/vault/AllDocumentsPage'
import { ResumeVaultPage } from '../components/vault/ResumeVaultPage'
import { JobDescriptionsPage } from '../components/vault/JobDescriptionsPage'
import { VaultTrashPage } from '../components/vault/VaultTrashPage'
import { VaultUploadDialog } from '../components/vault/VaultUploadDialog'
import { VaultSearchSection } from '../components/vault/VaultSearchSection'
import type { VaultFile } from '../types'

export type VaultTab = 'overview' | 'resumes' | 'jobs' | 'all' | 'trash'

export function VaultPage() {
  const location = useLocation()
  const navigate = useNavigate()

  // Determine active tab from URL path
  const getTabFromPath = (path: string): VaultTab => {
    if (path.includes('/vault/resumes')) return 'resumes'
    if (path.includes('/vault/jobs')) return 'jobs'
    if (path.includes('/vault/all')) return 'all'
    if (path.includes('/vault/trash')) return 'trash'
    return 'overview'
  }

  const activeTab = getTabFromPath(location.pathname)
  const [isUploadDialogOpen, setIsUploadDialogOpen] = useState(false)
  const [refreshTrigger, setRefreshTrigger] = useState(0)

  const handleTabChange = (tab: VaultTab) => {
    if (tab === 'overview') navigate('/vault')
    else navigate(`/vault/${tab}`)
  }

  const handleUploadSuccess = (_file: VaultFile) => {
    setRefreshTrigger((prev) => prev + 1)
  }

  return (
    <section className="vault-container">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <div className="vault-header">
        <div className="vault-title-group">
          <p className="eyebrow">CAREEROS VAULT</p>
          <h1>Career Document Vault</h1>
          <p>
            Centralized private career asset storage with immutable version history and cross-module synchronization.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="vault-header-actions">
          <button className="button button-primary" onClick={() => setIsUploadDialogOpen(true)}>
            <UploadCloud size={15} /> Upload File
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sub-navigation Tabs */}
      <div className="vault-nav-tabs">
        <button
          className={`vault-tab-button ${activeTab === 'overview' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => handleTabChange('overview')}
        >
          <LayoutDashboard size={15} /> Overview
        </button>

        <button
          className={`vault-tab-button ${activeTab === 'resumes' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => handleTabChange('resumes')}
        >
          <FileText size={15} /> Resumes
        </button>

        <button
          className={`vault-tab-button ${activeTab === 'jobs' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => handleTabChange('jobs')}
        >
          <BriefcaseBusiness size={15} /> Job Descriptions
        </button>

        <button
          className={`vault-tab-button ${activeTab === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => handleTabChange('all')}
        >
          <Files size={15} /> All Documents
        </button>

        <button
          className={`vault-tab-button ${activeTab === 'trash' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => handleTabChange('trash')}
        >
          <Trash2 size={15} /> Trash
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Full-Text and Metadata Document Search */}
      <VaultSearchSection />

      {/* Content Area */}
      <div key={refreshTrigger} style={{ minHeight: '400px' }}>
        {activeTab === 'overview' && (
          <VaultOverview
            onNavigateTab={(tab) => handleTabChange(tab)}
            onOpenUpload={() => setIsUploadDialogOpen(true)}
            onOpenNewResumeGroup={() => handleTabChange('resumes')}
            onOpenNewJobDescription={() => handleTabChange('jobs')}
          />
        )}

        {activeTab === 'resumes' && <ResumeVaultPage />}

        {activeTab === 'jobs' && <JobDescriptionsPage />}

        {activeTab === 'all' && (
          <AllDocumentsPage onOpenUpload={() => setIsUploadDialogOpen(true)} />
        )}

        {activeTab === 'trash' && <VaultTrashPage />}
      </div>

      {/* Global Upload Dialog */}
      {isUploadDialogOpen && (
        <VaultUploadDialog
          initialCategory={activeTab === 'resumes' ? 'RESUME' : activeTab === 'jobs' ? 'JOB_DESCRIPTION' : 'OTHER'}
          onClose={() => setIsUploadDialogOpen(false)}
          onSuccess={handleUploadSuccess}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  )
}
